MOON ROCKET and VENUS ROCKET with COLOR SCORING FEATURE
- When Rocket Colors Match, Score Values Increase
- Ball zooms upward thru either rocket to top of playfield for added scoring
- Ball going over center playfield button, when lit, scores "EXTRA BALL"
- Illuminated "BALL COUNT" and "GAME OVER", Next to Shooter
games.name: Astronaut

games.description:
Atari 2600 is based on "Skatebord" table from 1980

1977's Memory of the famous game Frogger, Space Invaders, Phoenix, Moon Patrol, Pac Man, Missle Command and more.
games.name: Atari 2600

games.description:
Origian table designed in 2020

this table is inspired by the game centripede on the Atari 2600 console
games.name: Atari Centipede Pinball

games.description:
The Atarians was the first arcade pinball machine from Video Game pioneer Atari. It was designed by Bob Jonesi with art by George Opperman, and released in 1976.

As a premiere pinball, The Atarians is notable for some unusual design decisions, such as the two pairs of stacked flippers and the use of inductive under-playfield sensors instead of rollover switches.
games.name: Atarians

games.description:
Single player wedgehead cabinet design. Two pop bumpers at the top of the playfield, two slingshots, two 3" flippers, a bank of 10 drop targets on the left, and on the right a dual lane of rollover switches.

This dual row of vertical rollovers was used in other games like Gottlieb Sheriff pinball and Gottlieb Lawman. In fact, Gottlieb Atlantis pinball is basically the one player version of Gottlieb's Sheriff/Lawman.

Skill shot: plunge the lit yellow lane. Note the lane changes with top slingshot hits, so allow for and count your bounces!

Note the right flipper has up-and-outlane risk. Don't make the mistake of holding the right flipper up when the ball is coming fast towards it and having the ball roll up and out the right side.

Hit drop targets in pairs [5000 vs. 500], shoot lit yellow lanes [3000 vs. 500] and targets [3000 vs. 500].
games.name: Atlantis (Gottlieb)

games.description: Atlantis (LTD do Brasil, 1977–78) is an underwater-themed pinball table featuring a sea-green playfield, aquatic artwork, drop targets, and rollovers. This virtual table offers restored visuals and authentic electro-mechanical gameplay physics.
games.name: Atlantis (LTD do Brasil)

games.description: Atleta is a Spanish pinball machine with an athletics theme.
games.name: Atleta

games.description:
Base bonus is earned for each A-T-T-I-L-A drop target, each top lane, and three captive balls hits, to complete the 4x3 grid in the center of the game.

Completing lines in the grid, e.g. A-T-T or A-I-T-H, scores more 25K for a row, 50K for a column. Shooting the captive ball to complete T-H-E or completing the top H-U-N lanes advances your bonus multiplier.

A good bonus on this game trumps any other playing strategy. You need to spread your shots around and kind of get everything once. It's much more balanced shot-objective-wise than most games, even though most of the shots feed into end of ball bonus rather than during-ball scoring.
games.name: Attila The Hun

games.description:
Austin Powers is an arcade pinball game designed by Lonnie Ropp and John Borg, and released in 2001 by Stern Pinball. Based on the first two movies in the Austin Powers comedy series, the game has you accompany the British super-spy as he battles Dr. Evil and his forces across time.

Foil Fat Bastard behind the toilet, spin Mini-Me into submission, then use the right loop to defeat the other Henchmen. Bash Dr. Evil to restore Austin's mojo, shoot the center ramp to activate the Time Machine, and fire the Big Frickin' Laser at Washington DC when it swings out from the bottom of the playfield.

If you're groovy enough, you can stop the Subeterranian Drill, take down Virtucon, and destroy Dr. Evil's Moon Base all while Austin dances away.
games.name: Austin Powers

games.description:
As one would expect, the game follows the highlights of the movie, recreating Jake Sully's encounters with the natives of Pandora and their resistance against the Unobtainium mining plans of Colonel Quaritch and the RDA. As Jake, the player will ride a giant Banshee, befriend the Na'vi, collect the seeds from the Tree of Souls, and play with the helicoradian plants.

Receive gifts from Eywa, battle the Valkyrie bomber, topple Quaritch's AMP suit, then lead the Na'vi in the Final Battle for the fate of the planet.
games.name: Avatar

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2022.

This table is based on the band Avenged Sevenfold. An American heavy metal band formed in 1999 in California, for the story, the table is called Lodger's Strawman, which apparently never came out.
games.name: Avenged Sevenfold

games.description:
The Avengers (Stern, 2012) is a fast-paced pinball machine featuring Marvel's superhero team. With vibrant comic-style artwork, multiball action, and unique features like the spinning Tesseract cube and Hulk bash toy, it delivers an intense, action-packed experience.

Related machines: The Avengers, The Avengers (LE), The Avengers (Premium), The Avengers Hulk (LE)
games.name: Avengers

games.description: Original table, designed in 2023. Inspired by the classic 3D Pinball Space Cadet from Windows XP, this custom creation pays tribute to The Avengers — the iconic British spy series that aired from 1961 to 1969. Blending retro sci-fi aesthetics with stylish espionage themes, the table features fast-paced gameplay, bold visuals, and a nostalgic nod to Steed and Peel's thrilling adventures.
games.name: Avengers - TV Series

games.description: A vibrant, comic-inspired virtual pinball table based on Stern's 2012 Avengers LE. Designed by jpsalas, it features dynamic gameplay with multiple multiball modes, a spinning cube, and a Hulk figurine. The table showcases classic 1960s and 1970s Marvel comic art, offering a nostalgic yet modern pinball experience.
games.name: Avengers Classic LE

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2022. It is based on Genie from Gottlieb in 1979.

This table is inspired by the American space opera television series Babylon 5 on 1993
games.name: Babylon 5

games.description:
Back To The Future is an arcade pinball game based on the Back to the Future film trilogy.
The Back To The Future playfield is divided chronologically, with Hill Valley of 1885 on the left and the Hill Valley of 2015 on the right. While the player tries to raise his score by going between the past, the future, Biff's casino, and the clock tower, caught in the middle are the DeLorean, Doc Brown, and Marty (notably not played by Michael J. Fox).
games.name: Back To The Future

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2022. It is based on Bad Girls from Premier in 1988.

This table is inspired by Michael Jackson's third album : Bad
games.name: Bad

games.description:
The game is themed around the life of a cat and the things they tend to do that annoy people. The object of the game is to spell out "BAD CATS" and accumulate the progressive jackpot that begins at 1 million points, among other things.

Unusual for its era, the table Bad Cats doesn't have a multi-ball.
games.name: Bad Cats

games.description: The theme is a game of Pool Billiards played in the late 80's by a couple of -you guessed it- Bad Girls. The backbox shows one of Gottlieb's infamous photographic translites of the late 80's, making sure there's no mistake about when the machine was produced. The playfield is almost a mirrored copy of Bally's Eight Ball Deluxe's playfield. With enhancements like two spinners, multiball (2) and a Vari-Target, it does have its own feel and flow to it. The main object of the game is to sink the pool balls by dropping the drop targets, finishing with the 8-ball. After that, you can earn a big bonus by spelling RERACK by hitting the targets behind the drop targets within a certain amount of time.
games.name: Bad Girls

games.description: This is an original table designed in 2024. It is a complete RE-SKIN of Gottlieb's 1988 Bad Girls, reimagined with anime-style girls. The visual makeover brings a fresh, colorful aesthetic that blends retro pinball charm with a modern, stylish flair. The result is a visually striking and fun-to-play table that keeps the spirit of the original while offering a totally new vibe for fans of both pinball and pretty anime girls.
games.name: Bad Girls ReSkin

games.description:
Balls-A-Poppin was the first flipper machine to feature multiball play. An earlier flipperless electromechanical pinball machine that also featured multiball play was Dudley-Clark Co.'s 1934 'Live Power'.

Compare this playfield design to the narrow-body Gottlieb's 1956 'Toreador' which came out shortly before this game. The playfield design was used again on Bally's 1957 'Circus'.
games.name: Balls-A-Poppin

games.description:
Bally's TV game show-based pinball machine is dripping with cheese. The 1980s-style American game show host loudly invites you to try your luck on the table and win big, but you'll need to keep your wits about you! The complex playfield is designed around that massive centre ramp.

Move around the playfield, boost your score and collect prizes. Shoot the ramps for extra points, light up the scoring wheel and keep hitting those targets. We can't promise you'll win a car, but you'll rack up thousands of points by catching ramps, using the orbits and hitting the spinner. Finally, go for the jackpot by unlocking the 2-ball Multi-ball mode, then illuminate the 'APPLAUSE' sign at the top of the backboard and enjoy the glory!
games.name: Bally Game Show, The

games.description: Ballyhoo, released in 1932 by Bally, is one of the earliest commercially successful pinball machines. Inspired by the popular magazine of the same name, the game features a colorful playfield with a carnival theme. Players launch a steel ball onto the board, aiming to hit scoring holes using gravity and skill. With no flippers and simple mechanical scoring, Ballyhoo captures the charm of early pinball and marks the beginning of Bally's long legacy in arcade gaming.
games.name: Ballyhoo

games.description: Ballyhoo, released in 1932 by Bally, is one of the earliest commercially successful pinball machines. Inspired by the popular magazine of the same name, the game features a colorful playfield with a carnival theme. Players launch a steel ball onto the board, aiming to hit scoring holes using gravity and skill. With no flippers and simple mechanical scoring, Ballyhoo captures the charm of early pinball and marks the beginning of Bally's long legacy in arcade gaming.
games.name: Ballyhoo

games.description:
Band Wagon is a pinball machine from March 1965, manufactured by Bally. A version was also produced in German (for export to Germany).
Get on the Big Money Band Wagon with the Bally's Band Wagon flipper. Progressive Light-Up insures tantalizing "came-close-try-again" play appeal, resulting in long sessions of repeat play, up to 4 players. Targets 1,2,3 light before each ball is shot. Hitting first 3 targets, when lit, opens Bottom Free-ball Gate and lights Target 4. Hitting Target 4, when lit, opens Top Free-Ball Gate and lights target 5. Hitting Target 5, when lit, lights Special.
games.name: Band Wagon

games.description: 'Bank-A-Ball' was the first pinball machine produced with flipper return lanes, which are wireforms that allow the ball to roll behind the slingshot and towards a waiting flipper. According to the book All About Pinball, Paradise and its add-a-ball version Pleasure Isle were the first games designed to have return lanes. However, Gottlieb rescheduled the production of Bank-A-Ball so that it could be released first.
games.name: Bank A Ball

games.description: Bank Shot is the Gottlieb wedge Head with a billiards theme. Enjoy timeless artwork and traditional play as silverball was meant to be.
games.name: Bank Shot

games.description:
Banzai Run was released in 1988 by Williams Electronics, and is notable for its continuous playfield, which extends vertically into the backbox. The game itself is centered on the 1988 Banzai Run Supercross race on the notorious Banzai Hill track.

As an up-and-coming racer, you are up against four rivals: Green Machine, Yellow Belly, Blue Beard, and Red Hot. Build up laps on the lower playfield, then hit the twelve color-coded targets to challenge each racer and access the hill. Once that's done, ride the Ball Lifter to the vertical playfield to defeat the challengers, then take on the King of the Hill in a light-and-sound spectacular.
games.name: Banzai Run

games.description:
Banzai Run was released in 1988 by Williams Electronics, and is notable for its continuous playfield, which extends vertically into the backbox. The game itself is centered on the 1988 Banzai Run Supercross race on the notorious Banzai Hill track.

As an up-and-coming racer, you are up against four rivals: Green Machine, Yellow Belly, Blue Beard, and Red Hot. Build up laps on the lower playfield, then hit the twelve color-coded targets to challenge each racer and access the hill. Once that's done, ride the Ball Lifter to the vertical playfield to defeat the challengers, then take on the King of the Hill in a light-and-sound spectacular.
games.name: Banzai Run

games.description:
“Don't call me Babe!” Crash the tolls, battle the notorious “Big Fatso” and find the elusive contact lenses in this pinball based on the cult Pamela Anderson film Barb Wire.

This is the last pinball made by Gottlieb before they went out of business.
games.name: Barb Wire

games.description: Barbarella was inspired from character with same title in a French science-fiction comic strip created in 1962 by Jean-Claude Forest. The strips were published as a comic book in 1964 and adapted into a Hollywood movie in 1968.
games.name: Barbarella

games.description: Barnstorming is an original, vintage-style virtual pinball table. It captures the charm of a 1970s electromechanical machine: simple, skillful, and surprisingly challenging. No flashy modern mechanics, just classic shoots, rollovers, and bumpers. Players who appreciate minimalist but engaging tables will find plenty to enjoy.
games.name: Barnstorming

games.description: Barracora is a Physical Pinball Table released in 1981 by Williams Electronics. When pinball enthusiasts talk about "pinball art", Barracora is a name that frequently surfaces, as the eye-catching merwoman is the first and most memorable aspect of the game. Drawing inspiration from H. R. Giger's works (most notably the painting "Li I"), Doug Watson drew a model's facenote morphing into a predatory fish against a landscape of teeth, then dubbed her "Barracuda". Williams' President Mike Stroll loved the artwork but thought the name was too harsh, so the woman (and the game) was quickly rechristened "Barracora".
games.name: Barracora

games.description:
Original table, designed by theGhost787 in 2017

Bart Vs. The Space Mutants. Simple pinball game with Simpsons theme. Includes scoring, doughnut bumpers, lots of sound effects.

Moe's Bar is Celebrating 2017 new years and Aliens have taken over the earth. You are Bart. Put on your X ray Glasses so you can see the aliens.
games.name: Bart Vs The Space Mutants

games.description:
"Just like the Real Thing!", the flyer says. This Baseball themed pinball by Gottlieb features Vari-Targets which scores singles, doubles, triples or Home Runs depending on how hard you hit it. The six Rollovers score singles, doubles, triples and Home Runs as well. Three rollovers and six BALL targets put "Men on Base".
The Pitch rollover lanes guide the ball directly to the flippers for shots at the Vari-Targets.
The new STAR type rollover lights indicate Men on Base and score 10 points. High point scoring and total Runs-Batted-In scoring for the dual scoring, with the maximum score displayed being 9,999 points. All the action, appeal and interest a player could ask for...
According to Pinball Snapshots, this is the first American game to have the "star" rollover button.
The add-a-ball version of this game is Gottlieb's 1970 'Batter Up'.
games.name: Baseball

games.description: Basketball is a Spanish pinball table manufactured by IDSA (Ideas y Diseños, Sociedad Anónima, of Madrid). The table's theme is basketball and the artwork features human and extraterrestrial athlets.
games.name: Basketball

games.description: As the game cabinet and backglass indicate, this is a licensed game based on the first Tim Burton movie with Michael Keaton and Jack Nicholson. The game makes no attempt to recreate the movie's plot or events, but simply takes the player on a tour of various locales from the film. Escape to the Batcave with Vicky Vale, climb the scaffolding of the Axis Chemical Factory, and hit both young Jack and old Jack for two million points. Knock down the entrance to the Flugelheim Museum to start multiball, then finish off the Joker with a one-two punch to the eyes and mouth.
games.name: Batman

games.description: As the game cabinet and backglass indicate, this is a licensed game based on the first Tim Burton movie with Michael Keaton and Jack Nicholson. The game makes no attempt to recreate the movie's plot or events, but simply takes the player on a tour of various locales from the film. Escape to the Batcave with Vicky Vale, climb the scaffolding of the Axis Chemical Factory, and hit both young Jack and old Jack for two million points. Knock down the entrance to the Flugelheim Museum to start multiball, then finish off the Joker with a one-two punch to the eyes and mouth.
games.name: Batman

games.description:
Original table, designed by luvthecubs in 2018

This is a re-themed version of JP Salas' and Onevox's Williams The Flash (1979). This is definitely not to be confused with the Stern version. Thanks to JP and Onevox for giving me a great machine to mod and learn from.
games.name: Batman 66

games.description: BATMAN pinball offers many exciting features, including: The Joker's Reveal Mechanism, a mechanical cylinder that rotates to reveal and fight a taunting Joker; Scarecrow's Crane, a mechanical crane featuring a spring-attach pinball which the player can strike with the pinball; the BATMOBILE Bridge, a teeter totter mechanism that races a pinball against a Hot Wheels BATMOBILE; an upper mini-playfield; and lots of multi-ball action.
games.name: Batman Dark Knight

games.description:
This is a very brash and flamboyant game, where the goal is to take down Two-Face and The Riddler by completing various scenes from the film. Go on a Gotham City crime spree, race the Batmobile across rooftops, survive the Brain Drain, and collect the Riddler's Mystery Boxes.

You'll also get to defuse the bomb at the circus, lock pinballs in the Batcave, and launch pinballs from the Batwing at playfield targets.

Complete all six Gotham Events, then light up the Bat Signals and match Two-Face's two heads for a chance at FOREVER, a multiball frenzy that lasts... as long as you can manage.

The game features sound clips from the movie, as well as new custom speech recorded specifically for the machine by Tommy Lee Jones (Two-Face) and Chris O'Donnell (Robin), and supports up to six players. It even includes a "doubles mode" where two-player teams compete against each other, and a "guaranteed minimum time" mode for beginners.
games.name: Batman Forever

games.description:
This is an add-a-ball, and features a pair of vari-targets. You get points for various features and also can score runs using normal baseball rules. Rollover buttons and also a backglass animation show runners on base. Scoring a certain amount of points (30,000 or 50,000) adds an extra ball, as does various numbers of runs.

The replay version of this game is Gottlieb's 1970 'Baseball'.
games.name: Batter Up

games.description:
Set in the sun and surf of Southern California, the game casts the player as one of the Baywatch lifeguards, working with Mitch, C.J., Stephanie, Matt, and Caroline on various beachside adventures. Perform CPR on drowning victims, rescue trapped Divers, and watch out for the Tidal Wave. Visit Venice Beach and Shark Cove, go jet skiing, then activate the automatic Shark Fin Flipper to help out during Tourist Season.

Lock pinballs in the Guard Tower for multiball, prove yourself in the Ironman Competition, collect all the vehicles for the Search and Rescue, then ride out the Earthquake and look great while doing so. The large DMD features near-photorealistic animated clips, while David Hasselhoff provides custom voice work. Up to six players can compete, including an option for two-on-two "doubles mode".
games.name: Baywatch

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2018.

This table is inspired by the video slot machine IGT's "Catch a Wave"
games.name: Beach Bums

games.description:
It's about time!

The clock pounds...the lights scramble...the sound accelerates with every tick of the timer. A stopwatch sets the pace for each player in a breathless race against time. Bally Midway introduces its most colorful new pinball challenge-a hi-gear game where the only way to win is to beat the clock!
games.name: Beat The Clock

games.description:
Beat Time Pinball was originally built to exploit the Beatles.

Williams tested the market with a limited number of Bootles machines. Very rare and beautiful original machine which has been serviced in 1967 when the Beatles were the most popular rock group in America, Williams Electronics of Chicago decided to cash in on the Beatles popularity and market a pinball machine featuring the four lads from Liverpool. 

They named the machine “Beat Time” and to test the market they made around 2800 games with art work featuring likenesses of the Beatles and a band name called “The Bootles”. This was done while Williams was in the process
games.name: Beat Time

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2023. 

This table is inspired by one of the dumbest duos of all time, Beavis and Butthead!
games.name: Beavis And Butthead Pinball Stupidity

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2023.

This is a Reskin of JPSalas's table Iron Maiden
games.name: Beetlejuice

games.description:
This table is a copy of Gottlieb's 1970 'Baseball'.

Maximum displayed point score is 9,999 points, maximum displayed Runs score is 99 runs.
games.name: Beisbol

games.description: Bell Ringer (1990, Gottlieb/Premier) is a quirky, circus-themed pinball redemption game. It's flipperless and plays a single ball per turn, with players aiming to shoot into bell and ticket holes—earning up to 25 tickets per hit. With its alphanumeric display, upbeat carnival sounds (including spoken attract-mode cues like "Hey kids, step right up"), and no ramps or bumpers, it delivers nostalgic, ticket-driven fun in a compact, no-frills machine
games.name: Bell Ringer

games.description: Original table, designed by lodger in 2016, based on Arcade Classic Berzerk by Stern.
games.name: Berzerk

games.description:
Hey, pal, there's a cover charge here!

Welcome to the Big Bang Bar, the bangin'est place in the galaxy. We wondered, what table would be a good showpiece for some of the new lighting techniques that have been developed lately and BBB was a clear choice with amazing light shows. Plus, it's just really fun. Have a drink, hit the mosh pit, and try not to get bounced!
games.name: Big Bang Bar

games.description: This game is very similar to Bally's Eight Ball, a classic. Big Ben is a shooter's game. You have to concentrate on three things: getting the B-I-G rollovers, knocking down the B-E-N drop targets for bonus points and extra balls, and getting the ball into the saucer for 5,000 points.
games.name: Big Ben

games.description: Big Brave is western themed the 2 player version of Gottlieb's "Big Indian"
games.name: Big Brave

games.description: Big Buck Hunter® PRO Pinball by Stern Pinball, Inc. is a hunting game that delivers a hot new quarry of no-limit fun to players everywhere. Big Buck Hunter® PRO Pinball is based on the hugely successful Big Buck Hunter® arcade video game series by Raw Thrills and Play Mechanix. And like the video games, Big Buck Hunter® PRO Pinball is sure to challenge new hunters, as well as seasoned marksmen.nnnnBig Buck Hunter® PRO Pinball takes you on a hunting adventure. Players are in pursuit of wild game, such as elk, moose and rams, while a motorized big buck moves swiftly across the forest-like playing field. Strike the buck with the pinball and start multiple ball action.
games.name: Big Buck Hunter Pro

games.description:
Build your profits with the magic appeal of a card game !

Try to reach the maximum score of 1,999 points by completing the following missions:
- Making A-K-Q-J-10 rollovers light corresponding cards in light box
- Lighting all cards scores special and advances carry-over arrow sequence under name BIG CASINO to score specials
- Hitting any lighted card rollover scores special
- Making 1-2-3 rollover scores 200 points and lights double number match feature
games.name: Big Casino

games.description: With the Big Chief Flipper from 1965, the pinball machine manufacturer Williams achieved a breakthrough on the German pinball market. Even then, pinball machines that could be played with up to four people were very popular in Germany. The Big Chief Flipper has a classic and timeless playing field with three pop bumpers, two slingshots, four standup targets, a middle right ball return gate and a right outlane ball return gate.nnnnThe special thing about the Big Chief pinball machine is that it was one of the first pinball machines to have an illuminated coin slot. Also special is the headboard of the pinball machine. Here the whole front frame can be unfolded.
games.name: Big Chief

games.description: Big Deal is a pinball machine produced by Williams. It is not to be confused with the 1977 Williams machine of the same name.nnnnNotable Features of this table : Large non-kicking rebound rubber between and below flippers. Backglass has a feature awarding a Special that carries over from game to game. Backglass light animation (playing cards light up). Reverse wedge head.nnnnMaximum displayed point score is 1,999 points.
games.name: Big Deal

games.description: This is a re-themed game. It used to be Williams's 1963 'Big Deal'. The playfield art was not changed except for custom plastics. The cabinet was changed with a custom theme. A tape sound system was installed inside. The flyer indicates brass trim was used. Re-themed by Fabulous Fantasies.
games.name: Big Dick

games.description: Dive into the wild world of high-stakes poker in Big Flush! This vintage Brazilian pinball machine combines casino flair with fast-paced gameplay, featuring card-themed targets, flush bonuses, and skill shots that raise the stakes. Notably, Big Flush is an unlicensed copy of Gottlieb's 1976 classic Royal Flush, replicating its layout and design with a Brazilian twist. Light up the table and go all-in to trigger the ultimate jackpot!
games.name: Big Flush

games.description:
﻿So big, it's making pinball history :
- It's the first pinball game ever to let the score roll into the millions.
- It's the first wide- body game with the feel and comfort of standard-sized games.
- It's the first wide- body game (dimen- sions: 23%"x45") to ever fit through a doorway.
- It's the first pinball game with animal magnetism.
games.name: Big Game

games.description: Big Guns is a 1987 pinball game designed by Mark Ritchie and Python Anghelo and released by Williams Electronics. Taking place in a medieval future, the King Tyrant is holding the Queen hostage. It's up to the Queen's military forces to storm the King Tyrant's castle and rescue the Queen. But to successfully storm the castle, they would have to be granted invincibility powers. Big Guns's notable features include two catapults (the cannons) that shoot the ball into the air and into the habitrail, and a taller-than-normal backbox, which houses a bagatelle mini-game (the King's Chamber).
games.name: Big Guns

games.description: Gottlieb's Big House was manufactured in 1989 with a prison escape theme. nnnnThe Big House is packed with interesting features. LOCK up one ball to go for the release or two balls to “Blow up the bridge” and make an “ESCAPE”. nnnnOnce you lock into the multi-ball, escape up the corkscrew FREEDOM RAMP to release the jailbirds from their CAPTIVE HOLES. Searchlights move across the playfield during the escape mode so don't get caught.
games.name: Big House

games.description: Frank Thomas' Big Hurt is a pinball machine released by Gottlieb in 1995. The game features a baseball theme and is named after Frank Thomas. The playfield of the game is laid out like a stadium with roaring crowds, a play-by-play announcer and features a moving baseball glove.nnnnThe game has three flippers, two pop bumpers, two slingshots, drop targets, a captive ball, and a four-ball multi-ball.
games.name: Big Hurt

games.description:
Prior to production, this game was named 'Chief' and then renamed to 'Big Injun'. Sample games were produced as 'Big Injun' and, according to the Encyclopedia of Pinball Vol 1, the Native American employees in Gottlieb's wiring and assembly plant in South Dakota complained about this. So, the name was changed again, to 'Big Indian', stalling production for three months. The 2-player version of this game is Gottlieb's 1974 'Big Brave'.
Spell B-I-G with the rollovers to light pop bumpers and other features for super high scores. 5 Drop Targets score 500 points, add bonus and 5000 points when all are lit.
Hitting last Drop Target when BIG has been made scores a special. The Vari-Target scores up to 5000 points and 5 bonus advances.
games.name: Big Indian

games.description: An original pinball table inspired by The Big Lebowski (1998), directed by the Coen Brothers. Featuring movie scenes, character modes (The Dude, Walter, Donny), White Russian multiballs, and a mini bowling alley with real pins, the gameplay blends humor, chaos, and cinematic flair—just like the film.
games.name: Big Lebowski

games.description:
The goal of the game is to light all 15 billiard ball lights. The player must hit the ball drop targets on either side of a central bumper to light its corresponding ball light, except the 8 ball. The 8 ball is lit by either going through the middle gate or by stopping in the center pit. When stopped in the center pit, a diverter (also called a gate) will change position, allowing a ball drained in the right outlane to return to the plunger lane.

Once all the ball lights are lit, the special can be achieved by hitting the target on the special lit side. The light switches sides when the slingshots are hit. Replays can be achieved by hitting the special lit side and by earning 50,000 points, 64,000 points, and 72,000 points.
games.name: Big Shot

games.description: Big Show is an Electromechanical pinball machine by Bally from 1974. The theme of the table is a circus and there is a clown on the playfield which is always cute to see. The playfield is bright and blue and really pops out at you.nnnnThe 4-player version of this game is Bally's 1973 'Circus'.
games.name: Big Show

games.description: Original table, designed in 2022. Inspired by the american fantasy action-comedy film co-scored and directed by John Carpenter, released in 1986.nnnnIt is based on the Wrath of Olympus table by jpsalas
games.name: Big Trouble in Little China

games.description: The manufacturer Bally produced the backglasses in both crystal glass and Plexiglas.nnnnThis game is the only Bally electromechanical pinball machine that has multi-ball and 3-inch flippers.
games.name: Big Valley

games.description: Game play consists of collecting belts (yellow, green, blue and black) in order to achieve higher playfield bonus from 2x up to 5x. This multiplier carries over from ball to ball and the game's infectious music gets faster and faster as you progress to higher belt levels.
games.name: Black Belt

games.description: Black Fever is a solid-state pinball machine released by Playmatic in 1980. It features a mysterious and moody theme, with gameplay elements like drop targets, bumpers, and spinners. Black Fever shares an identical playfield layout with Playmatic's 1985 release, Rock 2500, though each game showcases distinct artwork and thematic presentation.
games.name: Black Fever

games.description: Black Gold is a single player table with an oil theme, exploit your oil well to reach the maximum score of 199,990 points
games.name: Black Gold

games.description:
Black Hole is a widebody pinball machine by Gottlieb released in October 1981. It had a number of features going for it, the most striking of which were the dual playfields: a normal playfield, and the "Black Hole", a reversed playfield embedded underneath, visible through a transparent hole in the table.

It also featured speech, something of a novelty at the time, with the game memorably taunting prospective players by saying "Do you dare to enter the Black Hole?" during Attract Mode. Finally, it featured an eye-catching mirrored backglass with a rotating black hole. Both features were taken out of the export version. The game cost 50 cents to play, which was fairly extravagant at the time, but played up in marketing to promote the game's earning potential.
games.name: Black Hole

games.description:
Black Jack is a Solid State Electronic (SS) pinball machine manufactured by Bally Manufacturing Co in June 1978, whose original project date began May 6th, 1976.

It was also produced as an EM 2-Player the year before.
games.name: Black Jack

games.description: The Black Knight is a milestone in the evolution of pinball. It introduced many of new designs to pinball. It was the first game with the patented "Magna-Save" feature. It was the first with a two-level playing field, and faceted inserts in the playfield.
games.name: Black Knight

games.description: The first sequel to 1980's original table, with software by Ed Boon and artwork by Doug Watson. The Black Knight returns, this time in a techno-feudal landscape (eschewing the more traditional, ornate look of the original game). The player must storm the Knight's castle and battle him, while a Choir of Angels provide moral support for the player. It was the first pinball game to offer a Wizard Mode, and featured a truly memorable soundtrack with Chicago singers Stephanie Rogers and Glo Van Vlack.
games.name: Black Knight 2000

games.description: Black Magic is a 1980 pinball machine by Recel S.A. with an occult theme. It comes in two versions: Black Magic for 1 player and Black Magic 4 for up to 4 players. The gameplay features two flippers, pop bumpers, drop targets, a spinning target, and a unique open-elbow left inlane that adds strategic ball control and challenge.
games.name: Black Magic

games.description:
﻿﻿EMBARK ON A MYSTICAL PINBALL EXPEDITION DISCOVER THE TREASURES OF BLACK PYRAMID

Legend of BLACK PYRAMID It all began thousands of miles beyond the mouth of the Nile River in a fertile region known today as Bally Midway. It was here that an expedition of the world's most prominent pinballologists wandered west and made a startling discovery while excavating for new plateaus in arcade adventures. Through remarkable feats of engineering, they soon uncovered a mysterious artifact said to have once amused Pharaohs, priestesses, and mummies in their final resting place. Preserved in all its monolithic glory lied the treasures of BLACK PYRAMID. Never before had modern civilization had the chance to marvel at the rich ornamental sculpting of its cabinetry ...the majesty of its flashing lights...the gleaming opulence of its regal flippers. Now from the far corners of Bally Midway, the legend known as BLACK PYRAMID lives again.
games.name: Black Pyramid

games.description:
The game focuses on the title character, a female pirate captain who commands her crew of grizzled sea dogs. Your goal is to sink as many ships as you can by lighting S-I-N-K-S-H-I-P through various means, then fire a cannonball through the broadside at the far end of the table. Along the way, you'll find the Pirate's Cove, get a random award from Polly, and play no less than three Video Modes.
Possibly the most interesting feature of the game is its cannon, which sits below the playfield just above the flippers. At certain points, the cannon will become loaded and start pivoting back and forth. The player must then press the "Fire" button on the lockbar, causing the cannon to pop up and launch the pinball at various playfield targets for different bonuses. Accurate cannon-firing is needed to hit the broadside of opposing ships and establish your reign as Queen of the seas.
games.name: Black Rose

games.description: Black Sheep Squadron is a pinball machine from 1979, manufactured by Astro Games.nnnnNotable features of this table: nn- Lightning action bonus multiplier alleynn- Double, triple, quintuple bonusnn- Exithing scuadron scoring featurenn- Multiple feature kickout holenn- Ever popular extra ballnn
games.name: Black Sheep Squadron

games.description: Blackout was the first Williams machine to have a computer controlled general illumination effect. This is seen during the "BLACKOUT" sequence. The backbox mounted GI relay would interrupt power to the playfield GI lamps. Stern's Galaxy was the first pinball title to introduce a computer controlled GI relay. It also uses the same lane change concept first introduced by Williams "Firepower." The sounds are pure 80s and the voice sounds like a computer. All in all, this is a solid state classic that will keep you coming back for more! Orbit Completed!
games.name: Blackout

games.description: Original table, designed in 2021.nnnnThis is a re-theme of jpsalas's "Pokemon Pinball" table.
games.name: Blade Runner 2049

games.description: Hit the standup targets to lite everything as soon as possible. Nail the spinners for lots of points, and for the ball bouncing around in the upper playfield, which will usually pick up the 1, 2, and 3 targets, and maybe a saucer or two. Be careful with the 4, 5, and 6 targets, since they are right above the drain. The 7 and 8 targets are almost impossible to shoot directly, and are drain targets for the outlanes; let random bouncing take care of these two. The Right Eject Hole is almost impossible to hit directly, since neither flipper has a clear shot at it.
games.name: Blue Chip

games.description:
Gottlieb's Blue Note, with its sparking topical disco theme! Single player, electro-mechanical, convertible to add-a-ball. 5 pop bumpers create dynamic, fast, play-action.

- Skill shot from plunger to lighted top rollover scores 10,000 points.
- Complete A-B-C to light kickout hole for extra ball.
- Complete 8 blue note targets to light moving “note” for specials.
games.name: Blue Note

games.description: The 1983 Bally BMX pinball is a rather rare model, with only 400 units made, this isn't a game you'll see very often. It's a really neat game, with a lot of features not seen on other games of this era. For example, there are two playfields (upper and lower). And on the upper playfield, there's a magnet which is pulsed. This drags the ball away from the ramp (going to the lower playfield.) Also there is an additional set of flipper buttons which control right and left outlane 'save' guides. And there's also a bunch of drop targets. What's not to like? Note it is alledged that this game was meant to be an "ET" themed game, but Bally could not get the license. So the theme was changed to "BMX" bicycle racing.
games.name: Bmx

games.description: BMX (Radical Rick) is a fan-made digital recreation of the original BMX pinball machine by Bally (1983). The name "Radical Rick" refers to a comic strip character from BMX Plus! magazine in the 80's/90's. It features vibrant 1980s-inspired artwork, a magnet in the upper playfield, flexible outlanes, and enhanced gameplay dynamics for an immersive experience.
games.name: BMX Radical Rick

games.description: Flip into the world of the Belcher family with this fan-made Visual Pinball table! Designed in 2024, this playful re-theme of Gottlieb's Volley (1976) is inspired by the hit animated series Bob's Burgers. It blends classic pinball action with the humor and charm of the show, offering a perfect mix of vintage gameplay and burger-fueled chaos!
games.name: Bob's Burgers

games.description: Bon voyage features a messenger ball to win the special, kickout saucer, a spinner, two pop bumpers, an always open return to shooter lane, spell BONVOYAGE to light the special and can be set to add free balls for extra long play in your home. Popular 100,000 scoring for over the top pinball fun,nnnnBon Voyage has super art work on the backglass with Boeing 747's and great looking girls and guys getting ready to travel the world.
games.name: Bon Voyage

games.description: Original table, designed in 2022. It is based on Genie from Gottlieb in 1979.nnnnThis table is inspired by Bonanza, an American Western television series that ran on NBC from September 12, 1959, to January 16, 1973. Lasting 14 seasons and 431 episodes
games.name: Bonanza Edition

games.description: Original table, designed in 2022.nnnnthis table is inspired by James Bond first movie: Dr. No (1962)
games.name: Bond 60th

games.description: Original table, designed in 2022.nnnnthis table is inspired by James Bond first movie: Dr. No (1962)
games.name: Bond 60th

games.description: Original table, designed in 2023.nnnnThis table pays tribute to all the actors who played the role of James BOND
games.name: Bond 60th - Limited Edition

games.description: Original table, designed in 2023.nnnnThis table pays tribute to all the actors who played the role of James BOND
games.name: Bond 60th - Limited Edition

games.description: Operate whimsical lab equipment to open gateways to parallel dimensions. Explore the multiverse and bring back relics from unknown realms. Six quest modes, six mini game modes, two multiball modes, a wizard mode, and 8 unlockable gadgets. The spiritual sequel to the table "Experiments of Alchemical Chaos", Vortex Plunder expands the objective of “studying an alternate universe” to be “explore as many parallel dimensions as possible.”
games.name: Vortex Plunder

games.description: Operate whimsical lab equipment to open gateways to parallel dimensions. Explore the multiverse and bring back relics from unknown realms. Six quest modes, six mini game modes, two multiball modes, a wizard mode, and 8 unlockable gadgets. The spiritual sequel to the table "Experiments of Alchemical Chaos", Vortex Plunder expands the objective of “studying an alternate universe” to be “explore as many parallel dimensions as possible.”
games.name: Vortex Plunder

games.description:
Bally's 1974 "Boomerang" Australian Themed, Four player pinball
Boomerang features:
- Spinner spins up the bonus value
- Captive balls rollover stars to increase bonus value
- 1 Out hole scores 3000 points
- Thrilling countdown bonus up to 30,000 when doubled
- Double bonus lights for making A,B,C and D
- Win extra balls and Specials

The 2-player version of this game is Bally's 1975 'Flicker' but with different artwork.
games.name: Boomerang

games.description: Step into the covert world of Jason Bourne with this fan-made Visual Pinball table released in 2024, it's a fully original creation with custom artwork, soundtrack, code, 3D models, VR modes, and immersive DOF/LED lighting. Play through mission-based modes, mood-changing lighting effects, and dynamic gameplay that captures the thrilling spy‑action vibe of the Bourne movies.
games.name: Bourne Identity - Treadstone Edition, The

games.description:
Here is a Bow and Arrow pinball Machine. This was made by Bally in 1975. It features 2 spinners, ABCD targets that you hit for double bonus, and a bonus feature you can collect on the playfield that does not reset when you collect it, so once you build it up, you can keep collecting it. When you get the bonus up to 10,000, extra ball and special light up.
A great playing Electro Mechanical pinball game.
games.name: Bow And Arrow

games.description: Bram Stoker's Dracula is a popular pinball machine that is mostly known for its well-integrated theme, callouts, and unique mist multiball feature where the player has to hit a floating captive ball. The flippers have a lightning bolt pattern molded into them and reportedly are 1/8 inch shorter than the standard Williams flippers. A magnet moving under the playfield slowly transports a captured ball in a straight line across the mid-playfield from one side to another. Dislodging this ball from its path by hitting it with the ball in play starts Mist Multiball. A player can get two or three multiball modes going at the same time for a total of a 4-ball multiball.
games.name: Bram Stoker's Dracula

games.description: The table's theme is BMX.
games.name: Brave Team

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2022.

This is a RE-SKIN of the jpsalas Table Friday the 13th.
games.name: Breaking Bad

games.description: Breakshot is a physical pinball table released by Capcom Coin-Op in 1996. The playfield deliberately hearkens back to the design philosophies of the electro-mechanical pinball machines of the '70s, with a single-level playfield and total ball visibility at all times. The object of the game is to complete 3 games of pool - Eight Ball, Nine Ball and Rotation - in order to start Cutthroat Countdown, a high-stakes pool game where each ball is called out in order; each ball you sink is worth 1M points times one plus the number of times Cutthroat Countdown has been successfully completed (maximum 3M) and the mode ends with a shot at a Super Jackpot worth twice the value of the balls you sank before either running out of time or sinking all the balls.Balls can be sunk in several ways; you can hit their affiliated target on the playfield, shoot an orbit with a lit Super Cue, shoot the center pockets or make the undocumented skill shot (soft plunge the ball to the upper flipper, then shoot the Bank Shot lane to score 100K and sink a ball).
games.name: Breakshot

games.description:
This is a Novelty Play version of Gottlieb's 1970 'Snow Derby' made especially for Bilotta Distributing in Newark, New York (not New Jersey). Bristol Hills was the name of a resort in the region and John Bilotta had Gottlieb make this machine.

This adaptation used an extra ball feature when winning scores were achieved. A "Same Player Shoots Again" allowed one extra ball to be awarded per ball in play, up to a maximum of four for each player in a game. No replays were permitted under New York State rules.
games.name: Bristol Hills!

games.description:
There's nothing quite like the thrill of playing an original electro-mechanical pinball machine. With playfield Bonus Counter and Extra-Ball feature, Bronco delivers the classic experience with a modern edge. Four player scoring tracks the competition for family and friends.

The 2-player version of this game is Gottlieb's 1977 'Mustang'.
games.name: Bronco

games.description:
1976 Gottlieb's "Buccaneer" Pirate themed pinball machine.

Captivating features on Buccaneer:
- Spinner (Brand New) spins the ships wheel to spot numbers Complete Wheel lights Specials
- 3 Rebuilt fast acting pop bumpers
- Lots of rollover lanes to award numbers 100,000 scoring for over the top fun
- Replays for high scores and end of game match
games.name: Buccaneer

games.description: Buccanner is a vintage-style 4-player pinball machine designed by J. Esteban, featuring a classic pirate/adventure theme. The playfield layout is based on Gottlieb's 1977 Jungle Queen, while the artwork on the backglass and playfield replicates Gottlieb's 1976 Buccaneer. With dual flippers, pop bumpers, a spinner, and rollover lanes, Buccanner offers engaging gameplay reminiscent of the golden era of electromechanical pinball.
games.name: Buccanner

games.description: Buck Rogers is a challenging and fun game from from Gottlieb. Based of the hit late 70's TV Show. Buck Rogers has pop bumpers, several drop targets and a captive ball target along with it's classic 70's tone sound effects. It's a great pinball from the era!
games.name: Buck Rogers

games.description: This classic 'wedge head' is the epitome of collectible. Superb playfield action employs a spinning target wheel - Backbox animation sends the Wrangler spinning with a kick from his not-so trusty stead. Complete your pinball line-up today, Buckaroo!
games.name: Buckaroo

games.description: Original table, designed in 2022. This is a RE-SKIN of the jpsalas Table Serious Sam 2.
games.name: Buffy The Vampire Slayer

games.description:
A version of Gottlieb's 1969 'Mini Pool' made for export to Italy.

The words "Punteggio Massimo Raggiunto" under the backglass score reels mean "Maximum High Score".
games.name: Bumper Pool

games.description:
Pure Mechanical table (PM)
7 balls for 5 cents. Stained cherrywood cabinet with carved designs.
games.name: Bunnyboard

games.description:
Bushido table Has voice and multiball. Starting the game will announce "Welcome to Bushido". Hitting targets and rollover switches is accompanied by Japanese kiai vocalizations. A carousel of three kick-out holes rotates when activated by a ball going up the left ramp and arriving at the elevated right-side cannon. Pressing flipper buttons fires the cannon ball to the rotating carousel. If the timing is right, the ball will lock in one of the three kick-out holes. Locking three balls in the carousel starts multiball. A cannon ball missing an empty carousel hole will be diverted back into play. The carousel kicks out all locked balls at end of a player's turn; locked balls do not carry-over.

Although 'Bushido' is the last machine commercially produced by Inder, they had designed a game called 'Mach 2' that was later produced by Spinball in 1
games.name: Bushido
Caballeros del Zodiaco - Saint Seiya Pinball

games.description:
Williams CABARET was presented in November of 1968, the Test-Samples had no Ball-Saver-Post and the Artwork in that area was slightly different. Some press-photos and flyers show those early production-machines.

The Post seems to be added in a hurry because there are no hints on the Playfield how it can be moved up or down.
games.name: Cabaret

games.description:
With less than 1,000 machines produced, the original game is notorious for being released with incomplete code. It's sort of the ultimate "rare game with promise". An expensive collector's item and pinball conversation piece until Chicago Gaming Company was able to complete the project and re-release the game in 2022.
Cactus Canyon is meant to be in the same vein as other Bally/Williams games of the era, like Attack from Mars and Medieval Madness. Fan layout, mode-based rules, mostly linear gameplay.
games.name: Cactus Canyon

games.description:
Cactus Jack's is a pinball machine released by Premier Technology under the Gottlieb label in April 1991.

Cactus Jack's is a nice but intense table.  Missed shots on the ramps, the slingshots, the awesome randomness of the Thorn Surprise and the deadly outlanes gets you in trouble quickly.  Multiballs are also quite frenetic affairs with not too many safe shots... it is often over before it even started.  In this game you manage to keep a few multiballs going which help you to advance the fruits to orange by taking down the drop-targets and also scored a nice Thorn Surprise random award jackpot.
games.name: Cactus Jack's

games.description:
This game was produced for a contest in France to promote the Canada Dry soda brand.

Playfield was produced by Gottlieb as a 1 player replay version called 'El Dorado', an Add-A-Ball version called 'Gold Strike', an Add-A-Ball version for Italy called 'Lucky Strike', a 4 player replay called 'Target Alpha', a 4 player replay game made only for France called 'Canada Dry', and a 2 player replay called 'Solar City'.

Also later produced as Premier's 1984 4 player 'El Dorado City of Gold'.
games.name: Canada Dry

games.description: Canasta 86 is a solid-state pinball machine with a basketball theme, the game features classic gameplay elements like drop targets, bumpers, and a unique backglass animation that simulates scoring hoops. It stands out as one of the few Spanish pinball machines with a strong sports theme and distinctive '80s design flair.
games.name: Canasta 86

games.description:
Original table, designed by ivantba in 2018

The board costumization was inspired by Cannon Fodder, one of the hit shooters of the nineties, Amiga. Later on, the game also appeared on the popular consoles of the era. The intriguing intro music is still heartening to this day. The theme is music phenomenal.

Table inspired from "Papa Smurf" of JPSalas.
games.name: Cannon Fodder

games.description:
Capersville features 3-ball multiball play, used earlier on Bally's 1963 'Star-Jet'. A special version was produced for Germany with the same project number and project release date.

Inspired from 'Capersville' that was the 1965 French detective movie 'Alphaville' starring American actor-singer Eddie Constantine.
games.name: Capersville

games.description: This is a target shooters paradise! Four banks of four targets each representing Jack-Ace of the four suits. Rollovers on each upper side, a bumper in the center, and a wide open playfield. Despite the fact that there isn't much more to the game, except an eject hole in the middle of the board (which scores bonus for dropped targets, and the 'WOW' when the sequence is complete), it is surprisingly fun, and a great table to practice shot accuracy on.
games.name: Capt. Card

games.description: Capt. Fantastic was inspired by the movie 'Tommy' and includes a representation of Elton John, as his character from the movie, playing pinball on the backglass. The game name, however, is the title of Elton John's 1975 autobiographical song and album where "Captain Fantastic" was Elton and "The Brown Dirt Cowboy" was his then-lyricist Bernie Taupin. Included in the song lyrics are the words "From the end of the world to your town" which appear at the very top center of the backglass.
games.name: Captain Fantastic
Captain NEMO Dives Again

games.description:
Car Hop is an automobile themed solid state pinball machine released by Premier Technology in 1991.

At start of game, player can choose between 'modern' or 'nostalgia' modes. Nostalgia mode imitates electromechanical games by awarding lower levels of points and using synthesized chime sounds.
games.name: Car Hop

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2021. It is based on Firepower from Williams in 1980.

If you like "Technic Heavy Melodic Death Metal", If you like throaty voices, guitars Vs bass tapping battles, and if you like quick doublebass drumming, this Table is for you !!
games.name: Carcariass Pinball Chaos

games.description:
The objective of this table is to score a 'WOW' special which is either an add-a-ball or 50,000 points (depending on your set-up). To lit 'WOW' you have to complete a bank of drop targets or cards. There are 3 banks in total, and they only reset after you complete them once and drain the ball. This game is simple to play but hard to master! You also will notice the short, stubbed flippers which was more prominent in earlier Gottlieb tables, kind of an unusual sight for a table from the early 1970's. 

This is a version of Gottlieb's 1972 'Pop-A-Card' made for export to Italy.
games.name: Card King

games.description:
The replay version of this game is Gottlieb's 1970 'Flip a Card'.

The backglass shows a college dorm room with pennants on the wall and a study desk.

Theme:	College Life - Happiness - Music - Playing Cards
games.name: Card Trix

games.description:
Fantastic game play make the 3 jokers to light the specials, make poker hands by dropping the targets. Neat scan feature awards bonus score for pairs, two pair, three of a kind, full house and royal flush. The World Series of Pokers "Main Event" winner in 1976 was the legendary Doyle Brunson hard to believe but back then it was winner take all 2nd place won zero

The 4-player version of this game is Gottlieb's 1976 'Royal Flush'.
games.name: Card Whiz

games.description: Step into the rhythm of Brazil's iconic celebration with this lively Visual Pinball table! Faithfully recreating the 1977 LTD do Brasil original (re-released in 1981), it bursts with vibrant carnival-themed art, upbeat samba-inspired ambiance, and fast-paced gameplay featuring colorful bumpers, spinners, and festive targets. A joyful homage to Rio's carnival energy in digital pinball form!
games.name: Carnaval No Rio

games.description: Step into the rhythm of Brazil's iconic celebration with this lively Visual Pinball table! Faithfully recreating the 1977 LTD do Brasil original (re-released in 1981), it bursts with vibrant carnival-themed art, upbeat samba-inspired ambiance, and fast-paced gameplay featuring colorful bumpers, spinners, and festive targets. A joyful homage to Rio's carnival energy in digital pinball form!
games.name: Carnaval No Rio

games.description: This original, fan-designed pinball table brings the iconic world of Castlevania: Symphony of the Night to life. Players take on the role of Alucard, battling monsters, unlocking castle rooms, and collecting relics across a gothic, multi-level playfield. With dynamic modes, combo shots, and a haunting soundtrack, this custom table captures the spirit of the classic game in fast, immersive pinball form.
games.name: Castlevania : Symphony of the Night

games.description:
Everyone goes to his final reward eventually. And few ever escape. Either way. their money ALWAYS remains behind in Catacomb, the thrilling new pin game from Stern.

Having a PLAYER CONTROLLED, ACTION PACKED BACKGLASS, combined with a superfast playfield, Catacomb demands the ultimate in refined skills and cunning strategy.

What numbers should be picked ? What colors must be chosen ? Only seconds to decide as a simulated voice alerts the player to his options.
games.name: Catacomb

games.description:
Player tries to line up as many balls as possible at the Post... he then tries for Starter... upon making Starter, all the balls at the Post alternately shoot out from both sides of the Post flashing a green light on one side and a red light on the other side. If the player is lucky several of the balls may go into the Home Stretch.

The first three balls that reach Home Stretch will lodge in the one, two, and three thousand pockets. The other balls that roll into Home Stretch, are automatically sent into the 5,000 pocket by a rapid fire mechanism that flashes a light and rings a bell.
games.name: Cavalcade

games.description:
This system has a peculiarity that the sound changes when you beat the record, the left led of the scoreboard indicates that you passed the scoreboard, the upper left led the active player and the lower one turns on when scoring.

Recel is the name used for export games. The same company made a domestic version as Petaco's 'Cavalier'.
games.name: Cavalier

games.description: Caveman Pinball is the first "pinball with a video game" design ever tried by the big 5 manufacturers. Its wide body cabinet and 3/4 size playfield also contained a video game monitor and a joystick. Its 13-inch RGB video game monitor was built into the center-rear portion of the playfield and the joystick was positioned in the top-center of the larger than normal lockdown bar. Caveman Pinball was released soon after the very popular Haunted House pinball and captured some of the deep, resonant sounds that the early '80's Gottlieb pinballs created.
games.name: Caveman

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2023. This is a Re-theme of the jpsalas Table DeadPool.

The Cenobites are extradimensional beings who exist in an extra-dimensional realm and are present in Clive Barker's writings The Hellbound Heart, The Scarlet Gospels and eleven Hellraiser films. They are also mentioned in passing in the novel Weaveworld by the character Immacolata, who calls them "The Surgeons."
games.name: Cenobite

games.description: Centaur is a popular, highly rated pinball machine. It has a striking black and white design, with red, orange, and green accents. This makes it stand out. The playfield is also designed well, and the sounds and music are impressive. Plus, there's an extremely satisfying bonus countdown sound. This machine is fair because it offers a lot of shot variation, which helps keep players interested. Some people love it while others hate it - but that's what makes pinball interesting!
games.name: Centaur

games.description: Battle through the mythic underworld in this Spanish pinball from Playmatic. Inspired by Greek legends, Cerberus features bold artwork, multi-flipper action, and classic early-'80s gameplay with a dark fantasy twist.
games.name: Cerberus

games.description: Try to become a pinball champion (the theme of the table) by achieving the maximum score of 199,990 points.
games.name: Champ

games.description:
It's centered around the concept of boxing matches held in bars - the player, as a newcomer named "The Kid", must work his way up through the circuit, training to get his health up, before eventually beating the final man, getting the Pub Champion belt, and fending off five more foes in "Ultimate Challenge".

The game's design departs from the norm - there are health meters for the player and his opponent, and there are a number of toys in the machine, the most prominent of which is a large, revolving target that can present either a heavy bag or a boxer figurine. Two others are a small speed bag with a pair of fists and a rotating metal bar styled as a jump rope; each of these is a separate Mini-Game that the player must complete in order to train for the fights, using the flipper buttons to knock the ball against the bag or make it hop over the turning rope.
games.name: Champion Pub

games.description:
Notable Features :
- High score to date adjustable to 1 or 3 replays.
- Special targets score a replay or shoot again according to adjustment..
- Shoot again, when lit, can be adjusted to collect the score or not when ball leaves playfield.
- Central bumper can be adjusted to score 10.000 or 1.000 points.
- Double Bonus dropping one bank of targets.
- Triple Bonus dropping the two banks of targets.
- Kickout Hole combined with spinning lights can multiply bonus score by 10, lit extra ball, activate up post, etc.
- Dropping targets the score on the cristal ball advances.

there is another pinball table but with the same name but completely different released in 1974 by Playmatic.
games.name: Chance

games.description:
Notable Features :
- High score to date adjustable to 1 or 3 replays.
- Special targets score a replay or shoot again according to adjustment..
- Shoot again, when lit, can be adjusted to collect the score or not when ball leaves playfield.
- Central bumper can be adjusted to score 10.000 or 1.000 points.
- Double Bonus dropping one bank of targets.
- Triple Bonus dropping the two banks of targets.
- Kickout Hole combined with spinning lights can multiply bonus score by 10, lit extra ball, activate up post, etc.
- Dropping targets the score on the cristal ball advances.

there is another pinball table but with the same name but completely different released in 1974 by Playmatic.
games.name: Chance

games.description:
Charlie's Angels was the sixth solid state game released by Gottlieb and based upon the television crime drama of the same name, which appeared on the ABC network between 1976 to 1981.
The game features the likenesses of Cheryl Ladd, Kate Jackson and Jaclyn Smith, the 1977 cast of the ever-changing Angels team. The iconic Angels “silhouette” is used throughout the backglass, playfield and cabinet art. Two sets of drop targets and a stand up target work to increase bonus and advance the bonus multiplier.

There is indication that this Allen Edwall design was originally used to test the limits of Gottlieb's solid state hardware upon its implementation at Gottlieb, some years before the design was assigned to carry the Charlie's Angels theme. An electromechanical version of this game was also made by Gottlieb in fewer numbers. The SS Model was manufactured in late 1978, the EM Model in early 1979.
games.name: Charlie's Angels

games.description: Discover Check, a 2-player electromechanical pinball by Spanish maker Petaco. Featuring card-themed targets and classic bumpers, it offers both replay and extra ball options. It's part of a trio of similar tables made in 1974–75: Jake Mate (1 player, replay only), Check (2 players), and Check Mate (4 players), each with slight variations in gameplay.
games.name: Check

games.description: Recel of Spain previously made this game as an EM under the names of Jake Mate (1974), Check (1975), and Check Mate (1975). Taito of Brazil made it in 1977. The playfield layout is the same through all versions, but it is unknown if the scoring is the same.
games.name: Check Mate

games.description: Recel of Spain previously made this game as an EM under the names of Jake Mate (1974), Check (1975), and Check Mate (1975). Taito of Brazil made it in 1977. The playfield layout is the same through all versions, but it is unknown if the scoring is the same.
games.name: Check Mate

games.name: Check Mate

games.name: Check Mate

games.name: Check Mate

games.description:
Checkpoint it the first pinball machine to let players choose their own music, Checkpoint is most famous as the first game to feature a Dot Matrix Display (DMD), allowing for attention-grabbing animations, status indicators, and storytelling capabilities.

The goal of the game is to drive your Porsche Carrera to victory in eight rally races around the world. Build up those RPMs for multiball, hit the Spin-N-Win, then start Fast Mode for a ten-second scoring frenzy.

Punch the Hot Nitro to get the Blue Light Special and Redline your way to the Checkered Flag. For extra glory, race through the Lasermatic Speed Gun and set a new speed record, then hit the Checkpoint for Double Bonuses.
games.name: Checkpoint

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2021. It is based on Cactus Canyon from Bally in 1998.

That's right, Cheech & Chong are here! It's been a long time coming, but this insanely funny duo have now made their nostalgic venture in to Visual Pinball !
Kick back and enjoy the ride as you take a road-trip with these two famous stoners, doing what they do best, and explore their world from those crazy 70's and 80's. You'll encounter characters, music and sounds based from their iconic comedy albums, as well as their hilarious cult classic movies. Traveling from "Pedro's House" to the "Battle of the Bands", and back, Cheech & Chong: Road-Trip'pin, will provide you with a "high" amount of fun and laughs that only these two can deliver.
games.name: Cheech & Chong - Road-Trip'pin

games.description: Original table designed in 2023. The theme is inspired by slot machine called Big money cheese caper.
games.name: Cheese Squad

games.description:
The flyer states that this is "the first pinball game ever to have the innovative "Add-a-Balls" feature giving player up to 5 extra balls on a single play." According to the manual, extra balls will stack like this only if the Special feature and the Score Thresholds are set to award an Extra Ball.

- Theme of the table : Jungle, Fantasy
- Maximum displayed point score is 9,999,990 points per player.
games.name: Cheetah

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2022. This is a RE-SKIN of the jpsalas Table Pokemon with some small additions. Inspired by one of the greatest RPGs of all time, Chrono Trigger on the SNES!

Defeat Lavos and save the world! Gather all your party members, acquire all 7 ultimate weapons, and take on all 3 forms of Lavos in some fast and furious pinball battle action!

Table Features:
- Nfozzy physics, Fleep sounds, LUT selector, DOF implementation
- Over 170 random enemies to battle! Fight and defeat regular enemies, bosses, and ultra bosses all from the SNES game!
- Jam out to the amazing nostalgic Chrono Trigger soundtrack together with its sound effects!
- 3 different multi-ball modes that can stack on top of each other!
- A secret certain boss battle against a certain... game character...!
- Play slots with different party members for special modes and bonuses!
games.name: Chrono Trigger

games.description: Step right up and enjoy Circus, a colorful electro-mechanical pinball classic from Bally launched in November 1973. This 4-player table features bright carnival-style art, three bumpers, mechanical reel scoring, and dynamic out-hole bonus mechanics including double-bonus and extra-ball options for up to 27 ways to score. A vintage slice of mid-70s amusement with lively gameplay and nostalgic charm!
games.name: Circus (Bally)

games.description: Circus pinball features a wide body design, alphanumeric displays, and can accommodate up to 4 players. It is known for its unique gameplay mechanics, including five flippers but no ramps or multiball options.
games.name: Circus (Gottlieb)

games.description: Circus pinball features a wide body design, alphanumeric displays, and can accommodate up to 4 players. It is known for its unique gameplay mechanics, including five flippers but no ramps or multiball options.
games.name: Circus (Gottlieb)

games.description: Circus pinball features a wide body design, alphanumeric displays, and can accommodate up to 4 players. It is known for its unique gameplay mechanics, including five flippers but no ramps or multiball options.
games.name: Circus (Gottlieb)

games.description: The theme involves the player performing many different marvels in order to join the circus. Some of the features include a neon light running along the right-hand ramp, a pop bumper that rises up from the middle of the playfield at certain times, and a mini-playfield at the top of the center ramp with a magnet to catch the ball for locking. The most notable feature is the Ringmaster, a head that rises from the playfield at certain times and makes jokes against the player.
games.name: Cirqus Voltaire

games.description: A rebranded copy of Gottlieb's 1977 Super Spin, City Ship reimagines the fast-paced gameplay in a futuristic setting. Players guide a massive airborne metropolis through storm-ravaged skies, evading danger and seeking a safe haven for the last remnants of humanity. With dynamic lanes, timed objectives, and thrilling multi-ball sequences, this bootleg table delivers a unique twist on a classic layout.
games.name: City Ship

games.description:
Original table, designed by Onevox in 2018.

This is a re-theme of "Rock Encore" by JPSalas.

Contributors :
- Onevox : Author
- jpsalas : Author 
- Inkochnito : scripting additions
- Xenonph : audio scripting
games.name: Clash, The

games.description:
This table features a supernatural monster theme and was advertised with the slogan "Frightful fun for all ages!". It has a dark theme featuring the reunion of a long dead class. The back glass is a vacuum formed 3D image. During Multiball Madness, a large mechanical beating heart and chattering teeth are synchronized along to chickens clucking the Tchaikovsky's 1812 Overture.
The top of the playfield contains upper rollovers that advance bonus multiplier. The white target sequence advances the BAT-O-METER. Completing the left drop-targets lights the ball lock, then it is possible to lock the ball with the right ramp. Completing the C-O-F-F-I-N letters collects a 2 MILLION point jackpot. The playfield contains elements such as for example pop-bumpers, stationary targets, drop-targets, rollovers, ramps, saucer holes and spinners.
games.name: Class Of 1812

games.description:
The Egyptian theme surrounding the Pharaoh, Cleopatra may be Gottlieb's first EM game to supply DC power to the playfield coils but an SS version was also produced.
Shots through the upper channels usually trip the star rollovers just below the one-way gates; these rollovers are worth 5000 per hit, the best value on the game. You also will get points when the ball then drops through a top lane, including a chance to get another color towards your end of ball bonus. The ball will then often also land in one of the saucers as it drops down the playfield, scoring more points and further helping your bonus cause. Also observe that shots to the top that miss may rattle around in the bumpers and or drop into a side saucer. Bonus is two step: you only score bonus when you've collected both a top lane and a drop target of matching color. It's possible to double your bonus by collecting both side saucers. The 2-player EM version is Gottlieb's 1978 'Pyramid' with different backglass art.
games.name: Cleopatra

games.description: You've claimed the ancient Clock of Eternal Fog an eldritch artifact that distorts reality. As a devoted occult acolyte, your mission is to illuminate Nine Sigils of Infinite Terror across Faith, Flesh, and Fear to summon cosmic horrors. Complete each sigil-quest, unlock multiball mayhem, and unleash an apocalypse of eternal darkness across space and time.
games.name: Clock Of Eternal Fog

games.id: Close Encounters of the Third Kind (Gottlieb 1978)(4.0)
games.description:
Gottlieb's Close Encounters of the Third Kind was based on the 1977 science-fiction film of the same name. Gottlieb had recently been purchased by Columbia Pictures, and Close Encounters represents one of the first attempts at synergy between a Columbia property and their newly acquired pinball division.

An electromechanical version of this game was also made by Gottlieb in fewer numbers. The game features a spinner, a set of drop targets and Gottlieb's trademark roto-target in the top right corner of the playfield.
games.name: Close Encounters of the Third Kind

games.description:
Best features:
- Bumpers increase bonus value
- Completing 5 of 6 numbers lights an outlane for extra ball
- Completing all 6 numbers lights both outlanes as wel as ramp for extra ball
- Hitting the ramp lights the saucer for extra ball
- Shots to the ramp should accelerate fast enough to make extra ball/bonus collect saucer - however balls must be slowed down to hit the extra ball rollover at end of ramp - so decided that was more important

Hitting the horseshoe when not lit increases collect bonus saucer value to 3x - twice raises to 5x
games.name: Clown (Inder)

games.description: Clown features a pair of flippers, multiple bumpers (pop and mushroom), slingshots, and a kick-out hole—classic electromechanical mechanics. A rotating playfield arrow changes scoring values dynamically, while a ball‑saver post prevents immediate drain. The goal is to hit bumpers, targets, and the hole to build points, all under the watchful, smiling clown backglass. With bell sounds and a knocker for added flair, it delivers a nostalgic, funfair-style experience.
games.name: Clown (Playmatic)

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2022. It is based on Blackout from Williams in 1980.

This table is inspired by Cobra - The Space Pirate, a japanese manga series.
games.name: Cobra

games.description:
This is a 4-player version of Gottlieb's 1969 'Airport' with different artwork.

Pinball's theme: Happiness, School

Maximum displayed point score is 9,999 points per player.
games.name: College Queens

games.description:
Brazilian machine from 1981 based on Stern's FLIGHT 2000.

This table has the theme the space shuttle Columbia.
games.name: Columbia

games.description: Original Electro-mechanical table, designed in 2021. It is based on "Abra Ca Dabra" from Gottlieb in 1975 and inspired by Jeff Albertson, commonly known as the Comic Book Guy (CBG), a recurring fictional character in the animated television series The Simpsons.
games.name: Comic Book Guy

games.description: This table is inspired by Conan the Barbarian, a 1982 American epic sword and sorcery film directed by John Milius and written by Milius and Oliver Stone. Based on Robert E. Howard's Conan, the film stars Arnold Schwarzenegger and James Earl Jones
games.name: Conan

games.description:
The supersonic airliner depicted on the backglass is not a Concorde but is a Soviet Tupolev TU-144.

The first Concorde, the 001, flew its maiden flight on March 2, 1969 over France. The first commercial passenger flights took place on January 21, 1976 when a British Airways flight traveled from Heathrow to Bahrain at the same time that an Air France jet flew from Paris to Rio de Janeiro. The last supersonic flight occurred October 24, 2003 when British Airways flew from New York to Heathrow. Air France had already grounded its supersonic fleet the previous May.
games.name: Concorde

games.description: Congo is part of a grand tradition of terrible movies that turned out to be great pinball machines, and is just a fun game to shoot. The 3 flippers and varied shot layout make this game more interesting to play than many others of its era. Playing it feels like you're on a jungle adventure, which makes the game more fun.
games.name: Congo

games.description: The 4-player version is Playmatic's 1976 'New World'.
games.name: Conquest 200

games.description:
This game had playfield inserts near the flippers that lit for high Roto-target values so players who were looking at the flippers would be made aware when those high Roto-target values came around. Each player score matching at end of game awards 1 replay, or 10 replays awarded for both 1st and 2nd players matching or both 3rd and 4th players matching (operator adjustable).

Maximum displayed point score is 1,999 points per player.

Tilt penalty: game over.
games.name: Contest

games.description: Step into the parlour charm of a bygone era with Corinthian Master, Abbey's distinguished 1951 bagatelle. With gleaming brass pins and a finely lacquered playfield, this elegant tabletop pastime rewards steady hands and gentlemanly luck. A true post-war classic, where chance meets refinement.
games.name: Corinthian Master

games.description: The table represents the pirate ship that you are.
games.name: Corsario

games.description:
The pinball was released to commemorate the 40th anniversary of the Chevrolet Corvette. The player's objective is to collect nine classic Corvettes, from the 1953 Blue Flame Six and 1963 Grand Sport to the 1982 Collector Edition L-83 and the 1993 ZR-1 40th Anniversary LT-5.

Cars are collected by driving down Route 66, winning Drag Races, and defeating six sexy models on thirteen international tracks in the Challenges.

Along the way, fire up the Turbo Boost for extra racing speed, collect the Spark Plug rewards, make a Pit In before your tire blows, then shake the table by revving up the LT-5 engine for a Super Jackpot before locking balls for multiball. Collect all nine cars, then assemble the jigsaw puzzle to get the 1997 Corvette Test Car prototype.
games.name: Corvette

games.description:
Table based on Stern's 1980 'Galaxy' , One of the best-selling Taito pinball machines in Brazil.

Table's theme : Outer Space, Fantasy
games.name: Cosmic

games.description: Cosmic Gunfight is a Williams system 7 fantasy pinball machine that allows up to four players to play. Its features include electronic solid state design, 2 ball multiball, lane change, drop targets and an asymmetrical playfield. The model number is 502 and 1,008 confirmed machines were built.
