Its desiger was Barry Oursler and the artwork was done by Doug Watson and Larry Day.
games.name: Cosmic Gunfight

games.description: Original table, designed in 2018.
games.name: Cosmic Lady

games.description: This game was manufactured in Australia by Leisure & Allied Industries (LAI) under license from Stern Electronics. Of the several pinball machines that Stern licensed to LAI, it was the only one that Stern did not also make themselves. It used the same game ROMs as Stern's 1979 'Magic'.
games.name: Cosmic Princess

games.description: This was a custom-made game for the Hollywood movie "Tilt". The backglass and playfield are original creations while the cabinet was reused from Williams' 1975 'Triple Strike'.
games.name: Cosmic Venus

games.description: Gottlieb's space themed Count-Down Pinball Machine was released in 1979. The playfield on this machine is unique in that there are no areas of unpainted wood. For instance, the shooter lane is fully painted, as are the oval areas around each rollover, the flipper area, and under the light shields.
games.name: Count-Down

games.description:
Counterforce, the pinball that fights back.

For the first time it really is man vs machine with Gottlieb's accelerated attack!

Alien attack rockets descend at increasing speed, their mission, to knock out the players multiplier gun's.

Your mission… arm the multiplier gun and destroy the attack guns.

Destroy all the rockets and score even more, but any rocket reaching a multiplier gun will cancel the score and reset the back of targets. it then starts all over again but this time at an accelerated attack rate!
games.name: Counterforce

games.description: Cow Poke is the add-a-ball version of Buckaroo. One difference in the gameplay is the WOW on the roto-target which gives an added ball. There is no such target on Buckaroo. Cow Poke is similar to the older Flipper Cowboy.
games.name: Cow Poke

games.description:
A copy of Bally's 1981 'Eight Ball Deluxe'. All parts were made by LTD in Campinas, São Paulo, Brazil.

The 4-player version of this game is LTD's 'Cowboy Eight Ball 2'.

Pinball's themse: Billiards, Cowboy.
games.name: Cowboy Eight Ball

games.description:
This version these Electronic melodies :
- Theme from 'The Good, the Bad, and the Ugly'
- The song 'Oh! Susanna' from Stephen Foster
- Theme from the TV show 'Bonanza'

The 3-player version of this game is LTD's 1981 'Cowboy Eight Ball'. Both versions are a copy of Bally's 1981 'Eight Ball Deluxe'.
games.name: Cowboy Eight Ball 2

games.description:
Creature from the Black Lagoon is based on the 1954 movie of the same name. However, it is more about the experience of going to see The Creature from the Black Lagoon at a 1950s drive-in theater.
The game-play is just okay. There is not a lot of flow, and some really dangerous shots. It also relies a little too heavily on a few other key shots to be able to progress in the game.
But man, the theme is great - from the art package to the callouts and the mode design, it's got it all.
games.name: Creature From The Black Lagoon

games.description:
Crescendo was the first Gottlieb game to have drop targets of the modern style where the entire surface that the ball hits is what drops down. An earlier, different version was used on Gottlieb's 1951 'Minstrel Man'. and Gottlieb's 1951 'Wild West'.

The 4-player version of this game is Gottlieb's 1970 'Groovy'. Also produced as a single player Italian version Gottlieb's 1970 'Psychedelic'.

Maximum displayed point score is 9,999 points per player.
games.name: Crescendo

games.description:
This is an EM table with digital displays. It was made during the transition period between EM and SS tables.
 
This table was a copy of Recel's Criterium 75, but its rules are different.
They are also different than the rules in the other Recel tables Criterium 80 and Criterium 2000.
games.name: Criterium 77

games.description:
This table has the Specialty of a Mechanical Backbox Animation

Cross Town and its add-a-ball version, Gottlieb's 1966 'Subway', were the last Gottlieb games to have the manual ball-lift.

Maximum displayed point score is 1,999 points.
games.name: Cross Town

games.description:
Crystal Ball was produced by Talleres del Llobregat S.A. (Automaticos) in 1970. The Backglass has replay window.

Theme of the table: Fortune Telling
games.name: Crystal-Ball

games.description: CSI: Crime Scence Investigation is a pinball machine based around the popular television franchise. The pinball is licensed from CBS Consumer Products; and features original speech from characters from the franchise and music from the television show. Pinball Hall of Fame artists John Youssi and Margaret Hudson created the artwork, and CSI series creator Anthony E. Zuiker also assisted in the design of the machine. Features of the pinball include a mechanical skull that loads pinballs into its eyes for release before rising above the play-field to start the Skull Multi-ball. In keeping with the forensic theme, the Microscope Multi-Ball features a microscope mechanism which captures the pinball on a magnet. Other main features include a bullet scoop shot that catches the pinball and propels it back into gameplay, and a centrifuge spinning disc that captures the ball and thrusts it into play.
games.name: CSI

games.description: A single digital score display serves all four players. A large magnet under the center playfield is always energized unless the ball rolls over its surface switch, momentarily disabling the magnet, causing the ball to fly off in an unpredictable direction. Only one outlane, and it is protected by the lone pop bumper at bottom of playfield. Reversed flippers catch the ball if it goes out a side lane. The ball will sit at the end of the flipper until the flipper button is pressed. The left flipper returns the ball to the very top of playfield. The right flipper sends the ball through the spinning target to the upper playfield area.
games.name: Cue

games.description:
Cue Ball Wizard is a 1992 Pinball Table by Gottlieb (under the Premiere label). Unsurprisingly, a game called Cue Ball Wizard has a cue ball prominently featured on the table, along with an eight-ball in an oscillating kicker on an upper playfield. If the player shoots the cue ball correctly, it hits a target on the kicker, which knocks the eight-ball into an upper set of targets.

This is used during 8-Ball Multiball; hit one set of targets (solids or stripes), sink the eight-ball, then use the kicker during multiball to hit the upper targets for a Super Jackpot. Alternately, complete the six game modes on the Wagon Wheel for Pool Ball Mania, then finish it with a quick round of 9-Ball for a 500 million bonus.
games.name: Cue Ball Wizard

games.description:
This is a tribute to the game and its creators, StudioMDHR.

The table has a bunch of boss videos running on the backglass for boss fights and a really cool numerical display for scoring.
games.name: Cuphead Pro

games.description:
The sequel to the Comet pinball game, paying homage to the Riverview Amusement park that was in Chicago. The best feature of this was the Skill Shot where your goal is to get the ball into the 100K on launch.

The game has no multiball which is not typical for its era. The next sequel was Hurricane in 1991. A revolving mystery wheel is placed in the backbox ranging from Zilch to 200k, Extra Ball, and Special. A Ferris wheel one on the playfield carries the ball for a portion of its rotation.

The playfield features boomerang, comet, spookhouse, and cyclone shots. Images on the moving ferris wheel depict a young couple kiss as it turns. The art on the side of the backbox features an asian type dragon and on the side of cabinet a carnival type design.
games.name: Cyclone

games.description:
The sequel to the Comet pinball game, paying homage to the Riverview Amusement park that was in Chicago. The best feature of this was the Skill Shot where your goal is to get the ball into the 100K on launch.

The game has no multiball which is not typical for its era. The next sequel was Hurricane in 1991. A revolving mystery wheel is placed in the backbox ranging from Zilch to 200k, Extra Ball, and Special. A Ferris wheel one on the playfield carries the ball for a portion of its rotation.

The playfield features boomerang, comet, spookhouse, and cyclone shots. Images on the moving ferris wheel depict a young couple kiss as it turns. The art on the side of the backbox features an asian type dragon and on the side of cabinet a carnival type design.
games.name: Cyclone

games.description:
The sequel to the Comet pinball game, paying homage to the Riverview Amusement park that was in Chicago. The best feature of this was the Skill Shot where your goal is to get the ball into the 100K on launch.

The game has no multiball which is not typical for its era. The next sequel was Hurricane in 1991. A revolving mystery wheel is placed in the backbox ranging from Zilch to 200k, Extra Ball, and Special. A Ferris wheel one on the playfield carries the ball for a portion of its rotation.

The playfield features boomerang, comet, spookhouse, and cyclone shots. Images on the moving ferris wheel depict a young couple kiss as it turns. The art on the side of the backbox features an asian type dragon and on the side of cabinet a carnival type design.
games.name: Cyclone

games.description: “Around the World, Around the World”, Join The Crescendolls on their galaxy tour in DAFT PUNK's Interstella 5555! You will help them put on the best shows by learning Melodies and releasing hit Records. Upgrade your ball from “Homework” to “Human After All”, and rock out to your favorite DAFT PUNK samples, loops, and songs throughout the game.
games.name: Daft Punk Interstella 5555

games.description: “Around the World, Around the World”, Join The Crescendolls on their galaxy tour in DAFT PUNK's Interstella 5555! You will help them put on the best shows by learning Melodies and releasing hit Records. Upgrade your ball from “Homework” to “Human After All”, and rock out to your favorite DAFT PUNK samples, loops, and songs throughout the game.
games.name: Daft Punk Interstella 5555

games.description:
This table is a Limited Edition run of Stern's 2005 'NASCAR®'.

The rules are the same
games.name: Dale Jr.

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2022. It is based on Nemesis from Peyper in 1986.

Here is Dante's Inferno, if you have not been there yet, you have the opportunity to get to know the real hell.
games.name: Dante's Inferno

games.id: Daredevil and The Defenders - Multiverse Mayhem (Original 2024)(2.0.2)
games.description:
Kingpin and Mysterio have teamed up with the Hand to use a Machine that opens a Portal to the Multiverse. Daredevil and the Defenders have to catch all the villains Kingpin has brought to Hell's Kitchen, using the Portal Machine. Villains are scattered all over and have set up bases in various locations in Hell's Kitchen and the surrounding area.

This is not based on any specific story, but a mix of Comics, Tv Show, games and more.
games.name: Daredevil And The Defenders - Multiverse Mayhem

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2020. This is a Re-theme of the jpsalas Table Serious Sam Pinball.

All base gameplay elements remain the same as Serious Sam with name changes to fit the theme.
games.name: Dark Crystal Pinball, The

games.description:
This table is a conversion kit for Bally's 1979 'Star Trek'.

The backglass artwork is a mirror image copy of a 1973 painting called "The Death Dealer" by the fantasy artist Frank Frazetta
games.name: Dark Rider

games.description:
Dark Shadows is a classic style pinball from from the Italian company Nuova Bell. This is a Vampire themed pinball featuring two pop bumpers, four drop targets, a rollunder spinner, and a swinging target.

This machine was originally used in commercial environments such as arcades, public houses, and amusements.
games.name: Dark Shadow

games.description:
Darling pinball includes the unique Acclaimed Looping Captured Ball Feature for an advanced bonus and an extra ball. Slingshot shooters capture the ball then catapult it into the center Looping Captive Ball to get all the balls (5) to one side then to the other side. Pop bumpers are DC powered from the factory, which makes them play faster and stronger (unlike most games of this era). Additional features include: 2 flippers, 2 pop bumpers, 2 ball kickers, and the Acclaimed Looping Captured Ball Feature!

The 4-player version of this game is William's Jubilee Pinball.
games.name: Darling

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2023. This is a Re-theme of the jpsalas Table Wrath of Olympus.

Welcome to the Everquest two pinball tribute. prepare to face the greatest gods of Norrath !

This is a tribute to the MMORPG game Everquest II on PC released in 2004.
games.name: Dava's Everquest II - Pinball Tribute

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2022. It is based on Dale Jr. from Stern in 2007.

Days of Thunder is a 1990 American sports action drama film directed by Tony Scott. The film stars Tom Cruise, Nicole Kidman, Robert Duvall, Randy Quaid, Cary Elwes, Caroline Williams, and Michael Rooker.
games.name: Days of Thunder

games.description: A "Street level" game, which were an experiment by Gottlieb towards designing a simplier, single level (no ramps), slightly smaller and cheaper game. They did not sell very well, and only six models (Premier's 1990 'Silver Slugger', Premier's 1990 'Vegas', Premier's 1990 'Deadly Weapon', Premier's 1990 'Title Fight', Premier's 1991 'Car Hop' and Premier's 1991 'Hoops') were made.
games.name: Deadly Weapon

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2021. This table is a tribute to the Stern table from 2018. It will be soon 3 years since Stern released Deadpool. This is not a 100% replica of Stern's table or a ripoff of it, there are layout differences, graphic & sound differences, and most of all rules differences.

This table has 7 battles, a lot of multiballs, combos, things to collect (Ninja Stars, Chimichangas and weapons) that will boost your bonus and when you have enough of them will give you extra goodies. The table includes about 130 voices from the game, 22 songs and 42 quotes from the first Deadpool movie. During battles you may stack multiballs to help you finish them, and even start other modes and keep collecting goodies.
games.name: JP's Deadpool

games.description:
Dealers Choice was one of the most popular pinball machines of the 70s. To hit the targets, which are located on the left side of the playing surface, the Dealers Choice has an additional pinball finger on the playing surface. In total, the pinball machine is equipped with four pinball fingers.

This detail was a real highlight in the 70s. The pinball machine is also equipped with three pop bumpers, two slingshots and ten rollover buttons. Thematically the pinball machine is designed to the theme card game. The player can play the Dealers Choice alone or with up to three other people in a duel. With this pinball machine nothing stands in the way of an exciting game of cards.

The 1-player version is Williams' 1974 'Lucky Ace'. Has the same playfield as Williams' 1973 'High Ace'.
games.name: Dealer's Choice

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2022. It is based on NASCAR from Stern in 2005 and inspired by the movie with the same name.

Death Race 2000 is a 1975 American science fiction action film directed by Paul Bartel and starring David Carradine.
games.name: Death Race 2000

games.description:
Defender was released in 1982 by Williams Electronics as a Pinball Spinoff of their popular Defender arcade game. While other Licensed Pinball Tables of the time simply themed a generic table with the licensee's images and ideas, Defender attempted to replicate the video game's rules and structures into a pinball paradigm. In each wave, the player must protect ten Humanoids from being abducted by Landers and turned into Mutants; take too long to destroy the Landers, and Baiters will pop up from the playfield to thwart your shots.

Hit the Pods to access the Warp target, then shoot down the Swarmers to open the Stargate. Skillful players will judiciously use Smart Bombs to destroy all enemies, while a well-timed press of the Reverse button will save wayward balls from draining down the left outlane.
games.name: Defender

games.description: Gameplay is centered around 4 multiballs, named Fortress Multiball, Museum Multiball, Wasteland Multiball, and Cryoprison Multiball. Completing all multiballs lights the Demolition Jackpot (the total of all jackpots scored in all mutiballs). The main playfield toy is the Cryo Claw, a mechanical device that captures the ball from a right ramp shot (via a magnet) and is then user-controlled to drop the ball onto one of 5 possible awards: Start AcMag, Lock Freeze, Prison Break, Super Jets and Capture Simon. Completing the 5 awards lights "Demolition Time" a wizard mode starting at 3 balls and with a maximum of 5 balls multiball.
games.name: Demolition Man

games.description: Desert City is a Western-themed pinball machine set in a dusty frontier town plagued by outlaws and chaos. Players take on the role of a lone sheriff restoring order, hitting key targets to capture bandits, protect saloons, and light up the town's iconic clock tower. Fast-paced gameplay and vintage artwork capture the gritty charm of 1970s pinball.
games.name: Desert City

games.description:
Devil Riders is a pinball machine manufactured by Zaccaria in April, 1984. This game features a daredevil/Stunt motorcycle theme.

Ramps leading to the upper playfield are elevated above ball level by drop targets underneath. When the drop targets are knocked down, the ramps fall to playfield level allowing the ball to enter.
games.name: Devil Riders

games.description: Devil's Dare is a widebody pinball machine released by Gottlieb in 1982. As pinball games go, Devil's Dare is a straightforward design of the era — hit the drop target banks to enable the Capture Cave and the Capture Pit, then lock two balls for three-ball multiball play. If you score well during multiball, you'll be rewarded with "Multi-mode", an extra multiball round after multiball ends.
games.name: Devil's Dare

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2022. It is based on Devil's Dare from Gottlieb in 1982 and inspired by the series with the same name.

Dexter is an American crime drama television series that aired on Showtime from October 1, 2006, to September 22, 2013
games.name: Dexter

games.description:
Original table, designed by jpsalas in 2017. Based on the characters of the computer game Diablo III by Blizzard Entertainment.

Your world, Sanctuary, has been invaded by 5 Lords from Hell: Butcher, Belial, Azmodan, Diablo and the once archangel, Malthael. You are the last nephalem, born of a demon and an angel, and you are the only one capable of defeating the 5 Lords and send them back to Hell. Each one of the 5 Lords has its own horde of monsters, demons and skeletons which you must fight in order to engage the Lord itself.

This table is a cooperative table. The different players do not play against each other but they unite against the Lords of Hell. Still each player will have each own score, bonus, experience level, etc.

Contributors :
- jpsalas : Author, VPX table (layout, script)
- scottywic: graphics & sounds (including DMD)
- STAT: b2s
- arngrim: DOF script commands
- thalamus: dragons 3d mesh
games.name: Diablo Pinball

games.description: Diamond Jack is a classic Gottlieb pinball and it is one of the best of the wedge head era. It is a rare game with only 650 units ever produced. The theme is poker and the play is pure classic pinball. This electro-mechanical pin features 2 flippers, 3 pop bumpers,and 5 roto-targets … all of the things vintage pinballs are known for. Also, it has terrific backbox animation where playing card are revealed during play. This is the Add-A-Ball version to its replay counter part King of Diamonds. Law enforcement at the time believed that pinball machines could be viewed as a gambling device by awarding replays (free games). Thus pinball manufactures came out with Add-A-Ball versions of pinballs such as Diamond Jack, to where the player is awarded additional balls to play…as opposed to free games.
games.name: Diamond Jack

games.description:
Diamond Lady introduced a new backbox design with extended side panels, and with score display and speakers relocated to the top of the backbox.

The woman who modeled for the manufacturer's flyer and backglass for this game also appeared on the flyer for International Concepts' 1989 'Night Moves'.
games.name: Diamond Lady

games.description:
Dimension its export version 'Galaxie', and the replay version '2001', all made by Gottlieb in 1971, are the first pinball machines to feature multiple banks of drop targets.

Maximum displayed point score is 99,990 points.
games.name: Dimension

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2019. It is based on Firepower from Williams in 1980.

DIMMU BORGIR is a Norwegian metal band that exists for more than 25 years, and their style is often described as Symphonic Black Metal, because they use a lot of choirs, keyboards, and symphonic or philharmonic orchestras.

The name of the band comes from a volcanic region of Iceland, Dimmuborgir (in one word), which means "dark castles", because of the ghostly forms of volcanic formations that evoke ruins.
games.name: Dimmu Borgir

games.description:
Taking place in a 1950s-style train car diner, the player takes the role of a waitress who has to serve five hungry customers Haji, Babs, Boris, Pépé, and Buck. As each person calls out an order, hit the drop targets for their dish and their sides, then collect the Grill bonus before it gets cold.

Serve all five customers and you can collect the Dine-Time Jackpot, an award based on the game's backbox clock. For more tips, make successive shots to the cash register, Beat the Rush, then spell D-I-N-E-R for a chance to Stir the Cup for a pipin' hot couple'a millions.
games.name: Diner

games.description:
The Dipsy Doodle's simple yet enjoyable playfield represents something of a return to basics, allowing players to enjoy the stylish and retro aesthetic of a truly classic pinball machine. Dipsy Doodle features, 2 Flippers, 5 Pop bumpers, 2 Slingshots, 5 Standup targets, 1 Kick-out hole, A Right outlane free ball gate, Up-post between flippers. Doodle Bug animation unit below the playfield uses an electromagnet to move a captive ball repeatedly across a point-scoring rollover button. 3 or 5 ball play. With cartoonish young characters adorning the machine leaping and dancing in charmingly wacky poses. With its cheerful design and sunny theme, this classic pinball machine is fun for the whole family!

Table also released in single player version as Williams' 1971 'Doodle Bug'.
games.name: Dipsy Doodle

games.description:
Dirty Harry is based on the fictional character of the same name. It is a multiplayer game that allows up to four players.

This pinball game falls under the themes of celebrities, fictional and licensed theme. The playfield of Dirty Harry includes shooting pinballs at targets, sinkholes, ramps and magnets in through loops.
games.name: Dirty Harry

games.description: Disco delivers fast-paced, classic '70s pinball action with a rhythmic twist. Players rack up points by hitting spinning targets, drop targets, and bonus lanes synced to the pulse of the disco beat. Strategic shot placement and quick reflexes are key to activating multipliers and keeping the ball dancing across the playfield. A true test of timing and skill, set to a retro groove.
games.name: Disco

games.description: Playfield layout is the same as Williams' 1973 'Triple Action' except upper and lower targets are different.
games.name: Disco Dancing

games.description:
Original table, designed by RTKIII in 2016

This is a MOD of Borgdog's "Golden Birds" Table set to the theme of the Disney Princesses.

There are Two versions of this table:
- Normal : Normal layout for adults and more skilled younger players
- Kid : Bumpers are closer and center kick is high enough that the ball should not go through the middle. Giving new younger players a long time to play.
games.name: Disney Princesses Kid

games.description:
Original table, designed by RTKIII in 2016

This is a MOD of Borgdog's "Golden Birds" Table set to the theme of the Disney Princesses.

There are Two versions of this table:
- Normal : Normal layout for adults and more skilled younger players
- Kid : Bumpers are closer and center kick is high enough that the ball should not go through the middle. Giving new younger players a long time to play.
games.name: Disney Princesses Kid

games.description: The follow-on game to Nashville, Dixieland adds an 11th coin double-double. When the 11th coin is inserted, one or two of the cards would have the double-double light illuminated. Any win subject to Magic Number Doubling on a card with double-double lit would score 4x the base in-line value. Like most of the six-card games, the scores got higher on cards 2-6, with card #6 having the highest scores. The maximum win is obtained from a 5-in-line win on card #6 (300), doubled by Magic number doubling, doubled again by 11th coin double-double, and doubled again by winning a double-or-nothing gamble. The roll-over buttons turned on the corners scoring or the super line on all cards, if they weren't already enabled.
games.name: Dixieland

games.description: Original table, designed in 2023. It is based on Doctor Who from Bally-Midway (1992) with the same rules, but reimagined with the universe of Marvel's Doctor Strange (2016). This virtual pinball table blends the classic mechanics of the original with the mystical visuals and themes of the Sorcerer Supreme.
games.name: Doctor Strange Pinball

games.description: Doctor Who is a pinball machine released by Midway (under the Bally brand name) in September 1992. It is based on the television series Doctor Who. As stated in the Gameplay section, the rulesheet is rather different from other pinball machines released at the time, which didn't help popularity (and even now it is still seen as an exotic machine amongst collectors) as casual players did not understand the complex rule changes that occur during the game.
games.name: Doctor Who

games.description: The Dogies Canyon in upper left playfield has three normally-closed gates that, when all are closed, route the ball across three rollover buttons to exit the Canyon near the bottom pop bumper which also lights the top two pop bumpers. Only one of these three normally-closed gates can be open at a time, as controlled by their corresponding mushroom bumpers located in mid-playfield. When open, these gates will detour the ball to remain inside the Canyon. When this happens, a long and inconspicuous fourth detour gate quickly and temporarily opens to block the entrance and route the ball to an otherwise inaccessible left drop lane (the Devil's Canyon).
games.name: Dogies

games.description:
In 1977, Neiman, now a Bally Vice-President, decided to pursue a pinball machine based on the rising country music star Dolly Parton. He believed this would be a good fit for rural and country bars, arcades, and convenience stores.

As the pinball design progressed, Parton's career was developing and taking a new direction. In late 1978, Bally asked for approval of the pinball machine artwork, but Parton's publicists rejected it.

Bally Having already invested a lot in the design, they proposed a compromise, keep the playfield the same but redesign the backglass. They argued it would show “both sides” of Parton. Parton's people reluctantly agreed.
games.name: Dolly Parton

games.description:
﻿NEW! From the originators of the Flipper! Scientifically engineered flipper provides thrilling ball action : 
- 8 ROLLOVERS, 6 BULLS-EYE TARGETS, 2 KICK-OUT HOLES and roto-targets advance Domino lights.
- Lighting last Domino in pattern lights holes and bottom rollovers for specials.
- ﻿ROTO-TARGETS score 500 points when matching Domino is lit.

Maximum displayed point score is 9,999 points.
games.name: Domino

games.description:
The add-a-ball version of this game is Williams' 1971 'Love Bug'. Also released in a 4-player version as Williams' 1970 'Dipsy Doodle'.

An earlier game having a captive ball scoring feature similar to the Doodle Bug is Bally's 1938 'Paramount'. A solid-state game having this feature is Williams' 1981 'Solar Fire'.

The common "Over The Top" backbox version has four actual score reels plus one dummy reel. The 100,000 digit is a silkscreened "1" that is lit from behind when earned. The playfield has a light red background with a dark red circle at each outlane and under the pop bumpers.
games.name: Doodle Bug

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2019. It is based on Mad Race from Playmatic in 1985.

When it was released in 1993, Doom revolutionized the concept of action games and laid the foundations for the FPS genre. In fact, its popularity has not diminished slightly over the years. It still has one of the largest fan bases. At that time, there was hardly any platform on which it wouldn't appear
games.name: Doom Classic Edition

games.description: Original table designed in 2022. Inspired by Stern's 2018 The Beatles (layout/rules) and 2019 Black Knight: Sword of Rage (sound/callouts). A fast-paced tribute to Doom Eternal (2020), released on PS4, Xbox One, PC, and Stadia (Mar 20, 2020), with later ports for Switch, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S.
games.name: Doom Eternal

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2020. This is a 5 ball game with on 1,3 and 5 million an extra ball. This table has no ball savers!

This table is based on Doraemon the animated series, which is very popular in Asia. 
 
Features of this table :
- Ramp bonus and sounds when shooting the ramps
- Target bonus
- Target bank that has to be down before you can enter the slot machine.
- Bonus from the slot machine
games.name: Doraemon

games.description:
Double Barrel delivers fast-paced, high-reward action. Two lower launchers blast balls toward a Moving Target, boosting side pocket values. Rollovers increase Jet Bumper scores, all on a slick, Plasticote-finished playfield.

Smooth, explosive, and built for big earnings — operate Double Barrel and cash in!
games.name: Double Barrel

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2020. This is a Re-theme of Doraemon's table.

Double Dragon has been one of the best arcade game in "beat em up" style. The series exploded into a giant in the mid-80s that survived several episodes. There is almost no machine, computer, game console that would never have appeared in some version. Its popularity peaked in the 8 and 16 bit eras, in the early 1990s. Moreover, in 1994 e.g. it was even made into a movie.

The Neon version is a kind of tribute, remake version of the series that came out in 2012 and tried to get new fans for the genre. The adventures of the two main characters Billy and Jimmy continue in a pinball version this time.
games.name: Double Dragon Neon

games.description:
This table has a motorcycle theme, unfortunately only 55 units were sold by Bally.

Maximum displayed point score is 99,990 points.
games.name: Double-Up

games.id: Dr. Dude And His Excellent Ray (Bally 1990)(2.2)
games.description: Dr. Dude and His Excellent Ray is a Pinball Table released by Williams Electronics under the Bally Midway label in 1990. Festooned with Comic Book pop-art, Speech Bubbles, and more surfer slang and puns than you can shake a thermometer at, this game challenges players to prove their cool by raising the Dude-O-Meter. The hotter you get, the cooler you'll be; if you can raise yourself up to a Super Dude, you'll get a chance to collect pinball's first-ever Gazillion Jackpot.
games.name: Dr. Dude And His Excellent Ray

games.description:
Startling Beauty And The Beast Graphics Plus:
- First Appearance Of Exclusive Vari-targets In A Solid State Game.
- "Advancing Multiple" 5x Bonus Scores Up To 95,000 Points.
- Player Can Score Bonus From Vari-target.
- A-b-c-d Star Rollover Buttons Increase Bonus Multiplier.
- Unique Gottlieb Electronic Sounds Enhance Play Appeal.
- Time Proven Gottlieb/ Rockwell Solid State Controller System-the Ultimate In Reliability.
games.name: Dragon

games.description:
Startling Beauty And The Beast Graphics Plus:
- First Appearance Of Exclusive Vari-targets In A Solid State Game.
- "Advancing Multiple" 5x Bonus Scores Up To 95,000 Points.
- Player Can Score Bonus From Vari-target.
- A-b-c-d Star Rollover Buttons Increase Bonus Multiplier.
- Unique Gottlieb Electronic Sounds Enhance Play Appeal.
- Time Proven Gottlieb/ Rockwell Solid State Controller System-the Ultimate In Reliability.
games.name: Dragon

games.description: This is an original digital pinball table features 120 voice clips from the Dragon Ball series and 24 event-triggered songs. The game includes four playfield transformations tied to multiballs and six additional ones triggered by special events. Designed for desktop, full-screen, and VR setups, it also offers customizable elements like alternate ball styles, attract-mode music, six selectable backgrounds, and a Kamehameha blast effect.
games.name: Dragon Ball - Super Saiyan Edition

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2023. This is a RE-SKIN of the jpsalas Table Horrorburg.

You're about to fight a real Super Saiyan!
Rules:
- Shoot the villains in order to defeat them. 3 Hits should defeat each villain.
- Shoot the dragon to collect 7 Dragonballs and start a multiball.
- Hit the targets and ramps to collect all 10 Z fighters.
- Budokai: After collecting all 10 Z fighters there will be a wizard mode that is a multiball.
- Cell Games: After defeating all 5 villains there will be a two minute scoring frenzy.
- Time Chamber Multiball:  4 ball multiball. Collect 5 jackpots and hit the super jackpot at the Time Chamber, and repeat. The number of jackpot shots available will be according to the number of power obtained.
- Spell GOHAN or hit the spinners enough times to upgrade your power level. The power level will increase the number of simultaneous jackpots during Time Chamber multiball and Cell Games multiball.
games.name: Dragon Ball Z Budokai

games.description: Recreativos Franco is the name used for domestic games. The same company made a 4-player export version as Interflip's 1977 'Dragon'.
games.name: Dragoon

games.description: Original table, designed Full from scratch in 2015. This table has an Electro-Mechanical style
games.name: Drink Absolut

games.description:
1971 Gottlieb's "Drop a Card" Card Themed pinball machine was the only drop target game in Gottliebs A Card series. It was the end of a long series of fantastic pinball machines from Gottlieb. Starting with 1941 Spot a Card, 1950 Select a Card, 1960 Lite a Card, remake in 1960 Spot a Card, 1969 Spin a Card, 1970 Flip a Card and in 1971 and 1972 Drop a Card and Pop a Card. It was the last small flipper game with drop targets and one of the very last small flipper games ever made.

It has 13 drop targets to light the 4 specials to win free games.
games.name: Drop A Card

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2020.

He drinks, burbs and he farts it's drunken Santa. Santa crashed with his sleigh when he wanted to deliver a package and now he is stuck in the chimney. Can you help drunken Santa and his elfs to lift the sleigh and get the package delivered?
- Collect the 100 toys in Santa's workshop for an extra bonus.
- Don't forget the beer and toy bonus.
- Hit the beers out of the ice for extra bonus points
- Can you get al 10 reindeers from the parking?
- Hit three times the Christmas for an extra ball
- Complete the chimney for multiball
- Complete the sleigh for multiball
games.name: Drunken Santa

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2020.
Do you still remember: Ducktales "the quest for gold" from 1990 and DOS ? Go on a adventure to the Amazon, Egypt, Africa and the Himalayas with all there own 8bit music. You will be send of by Launchpad McQuack but it can be in 4 directions to start the adventure.

Aim on the piggy bank to get money and after 5 times scrooge golden money bin will appear for extra points. Knock the doors 2 times to get the "monsters" out and hit the "monsters" 3 times to have a change to get the treasure!

Launchpad McQuack will fly you in the dmd to the nearest airport where a multiball bonus is waiting for you. Do you have them al and win the jackpot ? Don't forget the beagle boys and magica! on 1,3 and 5 million you will get an extra ball to play more!
games.name: DuckTales

games.description: This original pinball table is a tribute to Dune: Part One, following Paul Atreides on the desert planet Arrakis as factions vie for control of the Spice. Inspired by the film, it blends sci-fi action with immersive, destiny-driven gameplay.
games.name: Dune

games.description:
1974 Gottlieb's futuristic "Duotron" Robot themed pinball. Sister to the 2 player "Magnotron".

Featuring a captive ball, ball return gate, countdown bonus, three pop bumpers and two kick up lanes for top to bottom pinball fun from 1974. Duotron would make a great first pinball machine or a wonderful complement to later robot pinball machines like Pinbot and Bride of Pinbot or Gottlieb's own Centigrade 37 which has similar artwork.

Notable features: Captive ball that boosts the bonus Center "Cup" opens gate and scores up to 5,000 points Return to Shooter Gate for longer games at home Side Kickers shoot the ball across the top of the playfield
games.name: Duotron

games.description:
Fun Features on Eager Beaver:
- 3 drop targets
- 2 kick outs that shoot out at the drop targets
- 4 pop bumpers
- 4 rollover buttons
- 2 stationary targets
- Extra balls
- Double match awards 5 replays
Just a feature packed game from William's plays fast and strong for a 1965 machine
games.name: Eager Beaver

games.description:
Earth Wind & Fire is a beautifully Italian crafted pinball from Zaccaria and is extremely rare in the UK. 

The main goals is to get the highest score as possible. The layout consist of 4 bumpers, 1 kickhole, 3 rollover targets, 4 droptargets, a normal static bonus target, and 10 static targets which will activate a bonus score for the kickhole.

It's stunning fantasy artwork and simple gameplay make this pinball a fun and stylish game for any pinball enthusiast.
games.name: Earth Wind Fire

games.description: Earthshaker! is a 1989 pinball machine released by Williams Electronics. The game casts the player as a researcher at the Earthquake Institute, and his task is to visit various Zones along the California-Nevada border where upcoming earthquakes are predicted to occur. After a while, tremors occur; take the Fault Trip, which will cause California to split from Nevada, allowing the pinball to get locked. Use another ball to keep visiting more Zones, and soon a full-blown Earthshaker occurs, starting three-ball multiball. Fittingly, Earthshaker! is the first pinball game to include a shaker motor that caused the table to vibrate during gameplay.
games.name: Earthshaker

games.description:
A Single-Level Version of Black Hole. With a playfield very similar to Black Hole (Gottlieb 1981), this version had one bank each of 4 drop targets and 4 spot targets, in place of the window that BH had in the center of the game. The "black hole" tunnels run to a upkicker / capture hole, and kicker target exists where the re-entry gate was located on BH.

Eclipse was an extremely low production game, due to the fact that it was usually kitted to an existing game; generally Time Line (Gottlieb 1980), or James Bond 007 (Gottlieb 1980).
games.name: Eclipse

games.description: The scientist is an “egghead”, a derogatory name for a smart person, which later became “nerd”. Egghead is full of references to science and human behavior. The scientist appears to be having an anxiety attack (sweating) while controlling the robot who is playing tic-tac-toe with the women who are having a good time. The robot is named Oxie Robut; a machine whose purpose is to play a game with women while the egghead works in the background.
games.name: Egg Head

games.description:
Eight Ball set a new record for the industry with 20,230 tables sold, a threshold that was only surpassed by The Addams Family nearly fifteen years later. As one of Bally's early solid-state pinballs, Eight Ball was groundbreaking for being able to track the progress of each player via software. Targets would reset for each player based on their earlier state, preventing players from "stealing" the work of others.

Eight Ball followed the rules of pool in the pinball game, requiring players to sink the seven balls of their type (solids or stripes) before shooting the eight ball for the jackpot.
games.name: Eight Ball

games.description: This game is very straight forward with the rules. Object is to complete racks of balls and the final shot is the eight ball. So after you knock down 7 different balls (5 shots with 2 shots repeated) you send the ball up the left orbit and it wraps into the upper right kickout hole. This is also a multiplier shot. Another multiplier shot is spelling C-H-A-M-P with the 3 lanes up top H-A-M along with the C and P in the right and left inlanes. Lots of end of ball bonus on this game and you don't get a tilt warning so be careful!
games.name: Eight Ball Champ

games.description:
The game features a cue sports theme and was so popular that it was produced again in 1984. The game is the successor of the popular Eight Ball pinball machine from 1977.

In Eight Ball Deluxe, Bally added more rules, complicated shot combinations, and speech synthesis. The pinball machine is still very popular today and was followed by the pinball machine Eight Ball Champ in 1985.

Eight Ball Deluxe has two sets of drop targets, one set for the billiard balls 1-7 and 9-15, and four in line drop targets for bonus multiplier. Behind the 1-7 drop targets are stand up targets that spells out 'Deluxe'. Completing these will light one letter in a different 'Deluxe' spelled out on the backglass. If the player spells the last letter of 'Deluxe' on the backglass, the game gives three free games. This feature stays in memory even when the machine is turned off
games.name: Eight Ball Deluxe

games.id: El Bueno el Feo y el Malo (Original 2015)(jpsalas 5.5.0)
games.description: Original table, designed in 2015. This fan-made pinball table blends elements from classic Gottlieb designs and serves as a tribute to The Good, the Bad and the Ugly, the iconic 1966 Italian Spaghetti Western directed by Sergio Leone. Starring Clint Eastwood, Lee Van Cleef, and Eli Wallach, the film's legendary style and soundtrack are echoed in the table's theme and atmosphere.
games.name: Bueno El Feo Y El Malo, El

games.description: Includes a lower bank of 5 targets, and an Upper bank of 10 targets which is the main goal here, with the help of 2 flippers at the top knock them all down to light extra ball. Simple rules, 4 flipper game. Constant jungle noises, plenty of bird sounds.
games.name: Dorado City Of Gold, El

games.description: Includes a lower bank of 5 targets, and an Upper bank of 10 targets which is the main goal here, with the help of 2 flippers at the top knock them all down to light extra ball. Simple rules, 4 flipper game. Constant jungle noises, plenty of bird sounds.
games.name: Dorado City Of Gold, El

games.description:
Billiard table in backglass shows all balls lit up and all mechanical balls above it are reset out of view. Hitting lit numbered target on playfield turns off corresponding lit ball in backglass and mechanically drops that ball into view.

This game is the Italian version of Gottlieb's 1965 Flipper Pool.
games.name: Electra-Pool

games.description:
Original table, designed by Lodger in 2016

This is a Recoding/retheme of "Magic" table by Stern.
games.name: Electric Mayhem

games.description: Elektra has three levels of playfields. Each of the playfields has two flippers. The top or upper playfield (1) is accessed by the ball shooter and four metal ramps from the main level. The main or second level playfield (2) is completely covered with a thick piece of plexiglass which forms the window to view the lower playfield. The lower or mini playfield (3) can be accessed after a ball drain if enough Elektra units have been collected. Elektra contains four balls. Two are used on the main and upper playfields. They alternate during normal play, both are activated during multiball. A third ball is kept captive at the top of the upper playfield to knock down in-line bonus multiplier targets. The fourth ball is dedicated to the lower playfield. There are two main objectives when playing Elektra (besides racking up bonus points and multipliers). One, achieve multiball and two, gain Elektra Units for time in the lower playfield. Mulitball is challenging and usually does not last long. The lower playfield becomes active after the ball(s) drain and there is enough Elektra Units earned. Elektra Units earned are shown in a separate 2-digit display in the bottom center of the backglass.
games.name: Elektra

games.description:
A version of `Palace Guard' made for export to Italy.

It was not uncommon for local operators to modify games for 5-digit scoring. Most often, the new digit was a fake "0" but in some cases they added a real counter.
games.name: Elite Guard

games.description: Original table, designed in 2021. This is a mash-up of the table "Elvira and the Party Monsters" from Bally-Midway in 1989 and the table "Elvira's House of Horrors" from Stern in 2019
games.name: Elvira's Party House of Horror

games.description: At last… The King of Rock n' Roll meets The King of Pinball! ELVIS, the new pinball machine from STERN Pinball, Inc., is the first pinball ever to brandish the Elvis name and was designed by pinball's leading designer, Steve Ritchie. Celebrating the King of Rock and Roll's greatest hits in its playfield packed with references to his songs and singing career, the Elvis Pinball features an animated Elvis Figurine shuffling forward and back, kicking his legs left and right to show his dance moves off, and the famous Heartbreak Hotel as a Mini-Playfield; shooting the ball in through the doors triggers Multiball. Smash into the Hound Dog target to send the hound hopping into the air. Jive along to some of Elvis' most iconic tunes, including Heartbreak Hotel, Hound Dog, Blue Suede Shoes, All Shook Up and Jailhouse Rock. Spell out E-N-C-O-R-E to light a special post-game multiball mode.
games.name: Elvis

games.description:
Embryon is a widebody arcade pinball machine released in 1981 by Bally. The game has the player in charge of some unspecified futuristic eugenics program, responsible for growing and birthing various multicolored humanoids in organic pods.

Aside from being the last widebody pinball from Bally, Embryon is remembered for its vaguely unsettling yet alluring theme, which raises more questions than it answers. It has a small but vocal following of fans who enjoy its unorthodox layout and diverse targets; it's a rather fast game for a widebody pin, one that rewards patient players with good aim. The Machine Monotone voice, simplistic digital sound effects, and clinically alien artwork come together into a memorable Science Fiction package.
games.name: Embryon

games.description:
Embryon is a widebody arcade pinball machine released in 1981 by Bally. The game has the player in charge of some unspecified futuristic eugenics program, responsible for growing and birthing various multicolored humanoids in organic pods.

Aside from being the last widebody pinball from Bally, Embryon is remembered for its vaguely unsettling yet alluring theme, which raises more questions than it answers. It has a small but vocal following of fans who enjoy its unorthodox layout and diverse targets; it's a rather fast game for a widebody pin, one that rewards patient players with good aim. The Machine Monotone voice, simplistic digital sound effects, and clinically alien artwork come together into a memorable Science Fiction package.
games.name: Embryon

games.description:
This game is a two ball multi-ball with an upper and lower playing field with four flippers, up to four players can play the game.

Knock down three specific targets will open escape gate. When you launch ball up the ramp to upper play field to cross bridge of gold and with right flipper shoot into gate to collect treasure; or with right upper flipper shoot through cave to activate a volcano which lights extra ball as ball follows path to lower play field activates extra ball.

There is a cave shot on lower play field which collects bonuses second cave shot holds bonus. Numerous idles hits on the bottom builds the treasure. Your ultimate goal is to build as much treasure as possible before you enter the escape gate to collect it. Game has great sound effects, dinosaurs growling, a lot of jungle and bird noises, drums in the background, also a volcano exploding, mans voice saying "Can You Escape", etc.
games.name: Escape From The Lost World

games.description:
Evel Knievel is a 1977 Bally pinball machine based on the famous American motorcycle daredevil of The '70s. It was released when the pinball industry was transitioning from electro-mechanical games to solid state designs, and embodies aspects of both types.

Most versions of this game were solid-state tables, though several hundred electro-mechanical versions were also made. Pinball enthusiasts consider Evel Knievel a hallmark game of The '70s, a table that perfectly captures both the cultural and gaming atmosphere of the era. The game itself doesn't present any innovative new ideas, but simply offers enough shots and challenges to keep things interesting for all players.

Gaming historians will note that Evel Knievel was the hottest Arcade Game of 1978, only to be knocked off its perch by a strange new thing called Space Invaders. Bally released a home version of this pinball with a different layout, different artwork, and shorter legs to better accommodate children.
games.name: Evel Knievel

games.description: Evil Fight is a solid-state, four-player game featuring a fantasy theme. The playfield is equipped with three flippers, one pop bumper, one mushroom bumper, five star rollovers, four drop targets, four standup targets, and two kick-out holes.
games.name: Evil Fight

games.description:
Excalibur: The Sword of Honor; The Game of Fury!
﻿
Charge onto the Battlefield of Excalibur as you choose your strategy with the Plunger Shot, try to earn up to 250,000 points and select your "SHIELD TARGETS" for LOCK UP. Battle your way through the "SHIELD TARGETS" to Storm the Castle and Save the Princess from the Evil Knight. Complete any 4-BANK SHIELD or make your way across the CENTER DRAWBRIDGE when lit to Advance MULTIPLIER. Gain the MULTIBALL weapon by first Completing the FLASH SHIELD BANKS to light LOCK. ﻿Then pull back the PLUNGER and enter the fury of MULTIBALL.

Achieve X-TRA BALL/ SPECIAL by completing ALL FLASHING SHIELD TARGETS to collect Lit Award during MULTIBALL BATTLE. When you lose the MULTIBALL weapon you'll immediately enter the JACKPOT BO- NUS ROUND. Hit the ROTATING LIT TAR- GET to collect JACKPOT BONUS during the pinball industry's first BONUS
ROUND. Complete the YELLOW SHIELD TARGETS when flashing BOTH to fight SPECIALS.
games.name: Excalibur

games.description: Dive into a vibrant, psychedelic universe where the laws of physics break down. As a lab technician, explore bizarre anomalies, cultivate alien flora, and harness unpredictable magical forces. This original pinball table offers a whimsical and challenging experience with hand-painted art, custom music, and surreal animations immersing you in colorful chaos.
games.name: Experiments Of Alchemical Chaos

games.description: This table was one of Gottlieb's early solid-state machines. The game features four flippers, two pop bumpers, and ten drop targets across three banks. The 4-player EM version of this game is Gottlieb's 1978 'Sinbad'. The 4-player SS version is Gottlieb's 1978 'Sinbad'.
games.name: Eye Of The Tiger

games.description: F-14 Tomcat is a 1987 pinball game released by Williams Electronics. As a pilot of the Navy's F-14 Tomcat, nicknamed "Hitman", your goal is to engage and destroy the evil Russian General Yagov and his fleet. Shoot down all seven of his planes, then defeat the maniacal Yagov himself. But stay on your guard — you'll need your best reflexes to fight off the Yagov Kicker, which suddenly launches pinballs straight down your flippers. Lock three balls to start a four-ball multiball blitz, then make three safe landings on the Launch Ramp to collect the jackpot. For even higher scores, get a Hot Streak going to build the bonus multiplier, then spell TOMCAT to collect the Hot Streak Bonus. F-14 Tomcat is noted for being the first pinball game to include a ball save feature, referred to in this game as "Flight Insurance".
games.name: F-14 Tomcat

games.description:
Faces is the first pinball released by SONIC brand and they exported a lot. It is one of the most beautiful electromechanical pinballs ever made by sonic. A color and a light that makes it highly appreciated especially among American fans where it sold very well. The playfield design would have been signed by Picasso himself.

The playfield design of this game was influenced by Williams' 1976 'Grand Prix'.
games.name: Faces

games.description:
Playfield has a layout almost identical to Recel's 1979 'D. Quijote'. Table thamed Outer Space - Science Fiction - Space Fantasy

Right outlane has a mini-post to try to nudge the ball to a free ball return lane.
games.name: Faeton

games.description: Recel is the name used for export games. The same company made a domestic version as Petaco's 'Fair Fight'.
games.name: Fair Fight

games.description: Embark on a whimsical adventure in the Fairy Kingdom! As a trainee fairy, you'll master pixie dust, learn magic, and battle dark forces to join the Seelie Court. This original pinball table features painted art, custom music, and immersive gameplay, offering a magical experience filled with enchantment and challenge.
games.name: Fairy Favors

games.description:
Family Guy is released by Stern Pinball in 2007. Based on the popular animated show by Seth MacFarlane, the Family Guy pinball game takes players through the memorable misadventures of the dysfunctional Griffin family.

Fight the crazy monkey in Chris' closet, help Stewie start a Sexy Party, hit Brian's beer can to bring about Happy Hour, and get Peter into a Chicken Fight over a coupon. As you progress, Stewie will get to play his own mini-pinball machine, all part of his plan to take over the world starting with your table.

The gameplay is accompanied by numerous voice clips from the show, supplemented with additional dialog by Seth MacFarlane.
games.name: Family Guy

games.description: Fan-Tas-Tic is themed around dancing, happiness, and music. The machine features two flippers, four pop bumpers, six rollover buttons, five standup targets, and three kick-out holes, but notably lacks slingshots. One of its unique elements is a captive ball spinner under the playfield and a kickback lane in the left outlane, adding complexity and strategy to the gameplay.
games.name: Fan-Tas-Tic

games.description:
Designed by Ed Krynski with art by Gordon Morison, Gottlieb's Far Out has a psychedelic theme with an Andy Warhol vibe, especially on the colorful backglass.
It has a fast and snappy game play 10 drop targets for your skill shot pleasure and three rebuilt pop bumpers for fast upper playfield action. Dropping all targets doubles the bonus value, two rollovers score special when all targets are down and bonus is at 10000 points or 15000 points. Return to shooter gate and a left drain kickback gate makes for long playing games and a popular end of ball countdown bonus awards up to 30,000 points. Left side rollover opens the lower left ball return kicker gate and the right side rollover opens the lower right ball return gate. Pop bumpers light to score 10, 100, or 1000 points. 10 checkered Drop Targets score 50, 500 or 5000 points. The 2-player version is Gottlieb's 1974 'Out of Sight'.
games.name: Far Out

games.description: Farfalla is a Pinball Table released in 1983 by Italian pinball maker Zaccaria. In this game, players are challenged to find love (and a high score) in a colorful flower garden filled with butterflies. Knock down the orange, blue, and red butterfly drop targets to collect the corresponding colored flower specials, then lower the Ramp and shoot for the upper playfield for a chance at the yellow butterflies there. Find love to increase the bonus multiplier, test your reflexes with the React Feature to prevent draining the ball, then advance the colored flower specials to unleash the Multi Special — all while the butterfly nymph on the backbox smiles and watches...
games.name: Farfalla

games.description:
1962 Gottlieb's 2 player "Fashion Show" rare trendy pinball machine with a glamorous fashion show. Five ways to win the bonus and mystery score three brand new pop bumpers.

Fast pinball play from 1962 the same year first Lady Jacqueline Kennedy takes television viewers on a tour of the White House.
games.name: Fashion Show

games.description:
Pinball themed American West - Western with ten drop targets. The 2-player version of this game is Gottlieb's 1975 'Quick Draw'.

Fast Draw has drop targets that reset for a single horseshoe target worth 5,000 points, two kick out holes for specials, three fast pop bumpers, thrilling fast countdown bonus up to 45,000 points on last ball.
games.name: Fast Draw

games.description: Somewhere off the coast of Bermuda, three vacationers are enjoying a day scuba diving and exploring the undersea wonders of a tropical beach. After one of the divers stays submerged longer than expected, his friend goes underwater to check up on him only to quickly fall into trouble from a school of deadly mermaids! While their female companion watches helplessly from above, the player must enter the murky depths and release the captive balls from the Cave Trap and the Lagoon. Spear the drop targets to advance the Blue and Green Bonuses, then keep your cool and knock down the 1-2-3 targets in order to collect the 5x Multiplier before your oxygen runs out...
games.name: Fathom

games.description: Somewhere off the coast of Bermuda, three vacationers are enjoying a day scuba diving and exploring the undersea wonders of a tropical beach. After one of the divers stays submerged longer than expected, his friend goes underwater to check up on him only to quickly fall into trouble from a school of deadly mermaids! While their female companion watches helplessly from above, the player must enter the murky depths and release the captive balls from the Cave Trap and the Lagoon. Spear the drop targets to advance the Blue and Green Bonuses, then keep your cool and knock down the 1-2-3 targets in order to collect the 5x Multiplier before your oxygen runs out...
games.name: Fathom

games.description: Somewhere off the coast of Bermuda, three vacationers are enjoying a day scuba diving and exploring the undersea wonders of a tropical beach. After one of the divers stays submerged longer than expected, his friend goes underwater to check up on him only to quickly fall into trouble from a school of deadly mermaids! While their female companion watches helplessly from above, the player must enter the murky depths and release the captive balls from the Cave Trap and the Lagoon. Spear the drop targets to advance the Blue and Green Bonuses, then keep your cool and knock down the 1-2-3 targets in order to collect the 5x Multiplier before your oxygen runs out...
games.name: Fathom

games.description:
Train your boxer and fight your way through ten opponents to become the Champ!

The objective is to win boxing matches. Before you may enter a boxing match, you must have a Promoter, a Trainer, an Opponent, and sufficient Training.

Hit the drop target between the ramp and the left loop to collect the Trainer and the kicker below the left loop to collect the Promoter. Once the promoter is collected spell F-I-G-H-T via the drop targets to collect an Opponent.
games.name: Fight Night

games.description:
The 4-player version of this game, Gottlieb's 1977 'Vulcan', has the Roman god of fire on the backglass instead of the Fire Queen.

Fire Queen has the desirable 100.000 scoring for over the top fun. If you never played a Vulcan the 4 player version or a Fire Queen rest assured it is one of the better Drop Target games that Gottlieb ever made.
games.name: Fire Queen

games.description: The player must quickly "put out fires" when they appear in various places on the playfield, by either completing a bank of targets or making a lit shot. These objectives award points increased by the "Fire Multiplier" as displayed in the upper playfield inserts indicating 10x-7x-5x-3x-2x. Each ball in play starts with this multiplier at its highest value of 10x and counts downward each time a fire is not put out within a timed interval. Each end of a large horseshoe lane is protected by ramps that raise and lower. When lowered, they deliver the ball to ball locks. Upper playfield has a ramp that raises and lowers during play, allowing a ball to enter an elevated opening for multiball. A small horseshoe lane above this ramp advances bonus multipliers 2x-3x-4x-5x-10x which display in the storefront windows in the lower playfield. Top of backbox has a ringing bell. The first and second player score displays are alphanumeric and the third and fourth player displays are numeric-only.
games.name: Fire!

games.description: In this game, the player is out to challenge the Fire Gods in his quest for a high score. Master the Skill Shot incline, activate the kickback, then hit the center target to close the Zipper Flippers. Lock a ball in the Odin and Wotan saucers, then hit the captive ball to Release The Fire Gods for triple-scoring multiball action. But there's no time to rest, because the spinning playfield disc will catapult your balls in unexpected directions.
games.name: Fireball

games.description: A rubbered post between the flippers kicks ball upward, activated by an extra button below the right flipper button. Fireball Bonus scoring animation below playfield moves a captive ball repeatedly across a point-scoring rollover button.
games.name: Fireball 2

games.description: Some notable features about this table including the spinning-score mechanic along with the kick-back and ballgate. This table also has a center-post to keep the ball from draining down the middle. If you hit the kick-out hole up top, you will hear firecracker sounds!
games.name: Firecracker

games.description:
Firepower is the second pinball to feature speech (the first being "Gorgar"). The eleven word ability was beyond Gorgar's seven word memory. Firepower has three notable "firsts". 

1) the first pinball with the "lane change" feature in which the right flipper button controlled the lit/unlit status of rollover lanes. 
2) the first SS pinball to have a multiball feature. Attaining three balls in play at the same time was an uniquely attractive reward. 
3) the first playfield animation. This "countdown to multiball" animation was innovative and amazing in 1980. It was also near the limit of the electronic and computational capacity of the hardware.

 It ranks at #5 in the list of the most successful Flippergames of all time
games.name: Firepower

games.description: Lock a ball, then hit the center target to start multiball. In multiball, UTAD via the right side; the left side orbits back to the bottom. Repeat until bonus multiplier at 5X, then resume UTAD via the left spinner, if now lit, and right side. Shoot lit orbit quickly to hold bonus.
games.name: Firepower 2

games.description:
A first of it's kind pinball game that you can actually play and challenge a fully capable A.I. computer. This release is both graphically and physically identical to the original Firepower but can also still be played in a vanilla state like the original.

By default the computer's level of skill is set to "Legendary" . Player 2, 3 and 4 are the computer. There are four levels of difficulty to choose from. Easy, Normal, Hard, Expert and Legendary. You can pick and choose which player is human or computer and even have all four players computer if you wish (lots of fun to watch and even bet on games).
games.name: Firepower vs. A.I.

games.description:
It's a fishing themed game! What more do you need to know?!! We kid, Fish Tales has flowing, satisfying gameplay with a bit of risk/reward involved. Theme integration is well done as evidenced by the fishing pole themed multiball lock. Memorable, if maybe slightly annoying, sound design.
The general goal of Fish Tales is to catch as many fish and tell the most outlandish stories about their size possible. The machine's backglass is topped with a plastic fish that thrashes its tail when the player achieves certain goals, and the players launches balls with an autoplunger shaped like a fishing rod. Fish Tales introduced flippers with lightning bolts on them that were believed to be 3.2 mm shorter than other Williams flippers of the time. While seemingly minor, a 6.4 mm gap creates a far greater ball control challenge for the player. As such, this enhancement was only added to a few pinball titles before being abandoned.
games.name: Fish Tales

games.description:
It's a fishing themed game! What more do you need to know?!! We kid, Fish Tales has flowing, satisfying gameplay with a bit of risk/reward involved. Theme integration is well done as evidenced by the fishing pole themed multiball lock. Memorable, if maybe slightly annoying, sound design.
The general goal of Fish Tales is to catch as many fish and tell the most outlandish stories about their size possible. The machine's backglass is topped with a plastic fish that thrashes its tail when the player achieves certain goals, and the players launches balls with an autoplunger shaped like a fishing rod. Fish Tales introduced flippers with lightning bolts on them that were believed to be 3.2 mm shorter than other Williams flippers of the time. While seemingly minor, a 6.4 mm gap creates a far greater ball control challenge for the player. As such, this enhancement was only added to a few pinball titles before being abandoned.
games.name: Fish Tales

games.description: "FJ" refers to the Australian automobile model FJ, made in the 50's by Holden. Reportedly, these were an iconic "youth" car in the 60's and 70's, much like the '57 Chevy or the '32 Ford "Deuce" Coupe were in the United States. Holden is now a division of General Motors.
games.name: Fj

games.description: Not everyone is aware that FLASH is an absolute milestone. 1st machine featuring a dynamic Background-sound, increasing in pitch and indicating the player's skill to anyone. 1st machine using FLASH-Lights, which got their name therefore. 1st machine with newly designed, smooth and much faster Flipper-Lanes. 1st machine with new-style translucent lane-guide-plastics. Nowadays many people consider FLASH as dull or even primitive, but you had to be there in 1979 when it literally appeared like a FLASH out of the blue. It was an awesome experience, and people lined up just to hear that stunning thunder. Many guys, including me, took tape-recorders with them so they could hear the wonderful new sound at home. The dominating Bally-machines with their crude sound and lame flipper-lanes became obsolete over night. WILLIAMS was back again and heading for #1.
games.name: Flash

games.description: Flash Dragon features two flippers, three pop bumpers, nine standup targets, a three-in-line drop target bank, a single drop target, a spinning target, and a messenger ball. Player beating high score receives Polaroid photo of that moment from camera in backbox.
games.name: Flash Dragon

games.description: Flash Gordon is the first split-level pinball machine from Bally, as well as the first game to use the "Squawk and Talk" sound board. It was also the second production Bally game with speech (Bally's 1980 Xenon was the first, utilizing a crude 'vocalizer' board set.) The game is based on the perennially popular "Flash Gordon" character and stories of comics, film and television. The pinball machine was specifically produced to coincide and promote the 1980 film Flash Gordon and features all the main characters as objectives; Aura for entering the saucer and the upper level, Vultan and Baron for dropping the drop targets in the palace, Ming for dropping the palace guard drop target and of course Flash himself for getting the multiplier at the palace.
games.name: Flash Gordon

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2018. It is based on Flash from Williams in 1979.

2 versions of this table are available:
- Original : white flippers and pop bumper caps
- LE : red/yellow flippers and pop bumper caps and new audio
games.name: Flash, The

games.description: Compare the playfield layout to Bally's 1978 'Playboy'.
games.name: Flashman

games.description: A 4-player version of this game is Bally's 1974 'Boomerang' but with different artwork. Also it was converted to a solid state prototype by Dave Nutting Associates for Bally's 1974 'Flicker'.
games.name: Flicker

games.description: The game has 3-ball multiball where each ball is launched through three separate 'Lift-Off' stages. This is placed at the upper left of the playfield inside a maze-like ball lock mechanism. The playfield contains a ball capture feature in the upper left and a spinner and drop targets in the middle. Space ships heading to the stars are depicted on the backbox. Flight 2000's has a robotic synthesised speech sound that fits well to its space travel theme. Pinball machines with speech were still seldom in 1980. Bally, released Xenon not until a couple of months later. The pinball machine is well received for its combination of attractive art and Harry Williams' innovative design therefore Flight 2000 sold well and is still widely recognized as one of Stern's most finest and memorable games
games.name: Flight 2000

games.description:
The Add-a-ball version of this game is Gottlieb's 1970 'Card Trix'.

The backglass shows a college dorm room with pennants on the wall and a study desk. It also shows the name of this game as 'Flip a Card' (no hyphens) but the game is always spelled 'Flip-A-Card' in the manufacturer literature.
games.name: Flip A Card

games.description:
1976 Bally's "Flip Flop" 4 player western themed pinball machine. It is super fun with four flippers and the unique flip flag feature. Flip Flags first appeared on Flip Flop and were also installed on 1975 "Wizard".
Other great features:
- Four powerful rebuilt Flippers
- Four Flip Flags that raise the bonus
- Two powerful rebuilt Pop Bumpers
- Two kick-out holes for extra balls
- Two rollovers for Specials
- Double bonus on third and last ball
- Bonus scores of up to 38,000 when doubled
- Ball Rescue rebound chance of saving the ball on either side drain
- 100,000 scoring for over the top fun
- Replays for Specials, High Scores and end of game Match
games.name: Flip Flop

games.description:
The goal is to advance two parallel sets of inserts, green and amber, so that the lit inserts are next to each other. For instance the second green and the second amber are both lit. On comes a red light and the center standup target awards another ball. Not as easy as it looks. You advance them via the green and yellow pops. Some games are a real beating. Some games, the flow is just there and you hit three add a balls in quick succession.

You also get extra balls for scores and for making the top rollovers. It's all about the extra balls.
games.name: Flipper Fair

games.description:
This is the first pinball machine with its dot matrix display (DMD) located under the playfield glass. The 256x64 High Resolution DMD used in this game is larger than on other games. Balls shot under the DMD hit rapidly reset drop targets that are used to animate a virtual ball that continues into the DMD display animations.

Speech includes an "adult" mode containing profanity and bodily noises.

This game is timed, with each player getting the same amount of time, no matter how many drains. 6 players can play as two teams.
games.name: Flipper Football

games.description:
Two backbox animations: at start of game, billiard table in backglass shows all balls lit up and all mechanical balls above it are reset out of view. Hitting lit numbered target on playfield turns off corresponding lit ball in backglass and mechanically drops that ball into view. Maximum displayed score is 9,999 points.

The replay version of this game is Gottlieb's 1965 'Bank-A-Ball'. The Italian model is Gottlieb's 1965 'Electra-Pool'.
games.name: Flipper Pool

games.description: Excellent game play Spell FLYING CARPET to light the 4 Specials to win tons of free game. Playfield design appears later on Mirco Games, Inc.'s 1975 'Spirit of 76'.
games.name: Flying Carpet

games.description:
"Flying Chariots" old school 56 year old vintage pinball for two players.

Fine features on Flying Chariots:
- 4 rebuilt pop bumpers with nice original art deco caps
- 2 rebuilt retro flippers very snappy
- 2 players "it's more fun to compete!
- Target Alley for high scoring
- Mystery Target awards 50 to 300 points
- Pops games for scores of 1,000 1,100 1,200 and 1,900 points
- End of game match
games.name: Flying Chariots

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2020. It is based on BorgDog's Space Walk from Gottlieb in 1979.

The Fog is a 1980 American supernatural horror film directed by John Carpenter, who also co-wrote the screenplay and created the music for the film. It stars Adrienne Barbeau, Jamie Lee Curtis, Tom Atkins, Janet Leigh and Hal Holbrook.
games.name: Fog, The

games.description: Table Similar to Williams' 1978 'World Cup'.
games.name: Football

games.description:
The backglass artwork depicts elements from the Star Wars movies: a Jedi riding a Tauntaun, surrounded by R2-D2, C-3PO, Chewbacca, Yoda, X-wing fighters, and AT-AT Walkers, while the mask of Darth Vader is superimposed over the darkness of outer space behind them.

The playfield layout is nearly identical to that of Gottlieb's 1978 'Close Encounters of the Third Kind'.
games.name: Force

games.description: Get at least one top colored lane, then hit the matching stand-up target to light the locks and play multiball. Shoot targets and the upper left lanes all day in multiball.
games.name: Force 2

games.description: Fortnite is an original digital pinball table released in 2024. A full reskin of Atari's 1979 Superman, it brings Fortnite's iconic visuals and lobby music into the pinball world. The package includes desktop and VR modes, complete with backglass graphics, attract-mode animations, and custom media packs for an immersive experience.
games.name: Fortnite

games.description: Zip the flippers closed, shoot the volcano and tar pit to lock balls, advance the tar pit via the center bumper until achieving multiball. Repeat. Lock balls for more Skill Shots whenever possible.
games.name: Four Million B.C.

games.description: An original table designed in 2022, based on SEGA's 1995 Mary Shelley's Frankenstein pinball machine. This creation is a tribute to the classic 1931 film Frankenstein, capturing its iconic horror atmosphere through immersive gameplay, gothic visuals, and chilling sound design. The table is available in two editions: a black & white version for a vintage cinematic feel, and a color version for a more modern experience.
games.name: Frankenstein

games.id: Freddy A Nightmare On Elm Street (Gottlieb 1994)(Bigus 1.0)
games.description:
Launched in 1995 on the back of the hugely successful horror movie, Freddy: A Nightmare On Elm Street follows the adventures of the nocturnal monster Freddy Krueger. Intense multiball action. With plenty of multiball rounds to keep you sharp, the playfield features lots of interactive elements. Halfway up the table on the left is a third flipper in the shape of Freddy's claw.

Use this carefully to keep the ball up in the top of the playfield. If you're lucky you'll hit Freddy's head, which moves and spits out multiballs, or the furnace, which activates special game modes. Between the flippers there's a ball save feature, but you'll have to remember to hit the third button when you need it! Creepy, horror movie theme. With an immersive, creepy theme involving deep red backlighting, spooky voiceovers and music, and plenty of nasty shocks, Freddy: A Nightmare On Elm Street is one of the best horror-themed pinball machines ever made. Just remember to keep the lights on...
games.name: Freddy A Nightmare On Elm Street

games.description: Free Fall is electro-mechanical game features a vibrant skydiving theme, highlighted by its distinctive backglass depicting parachutists. The replay version of this game is Gottlieb's 1974 'Sky Jump'. The Add-a-ball version for export to Italy is Gottlieb's 1974 'Sky Dive'.
games.name: Free Fall

games.description:
Freedom was produced in both EM and SS versions as Bally's 1976 'Freedom'.

Do you feel lucky? Freedom is all about getting the ball in the top saucer when “lite spinner” is lit, then shooting the spinners all day. Since you can't control which center feature is lit, it's a matter of luck to get the spinner item to fall your way on a shot when the ball settles into the top saucer. Fewer than half of the shots to the top do this due to the wide gaps next to the saucer. If the center wheel is currently on “lite spinners,” you can try to shoot the right side saucer for it, but that's about the only time I'd ever deviate from UTAD.
games.name: Freedom

games.description:
Freefall incorporates "state of the art" pinball technology with some spectacular innovations. And, when you combine all this with a smashing playfield and an alluring backglass, you've got a game that keeps all those quarters dropping.
- Features multiple-ball play.
- 20 word vocabulary signals beginning of game, identifies each player at his turn, and alerts player upon completion of sequenced scoring features.
- Ball accumulator launches up to 3 balls simultaneously onto playfield for explosive pinball action.
- Game includes an innovative Lighted Line Selector Changer: by depressing both flippers, player has option of changing Lighted Line Selector on bonus multiplier scoring feature.
- Bonus multiplier increases point value up to 14x.
- Numerical drop target scores 10,000 pts., or 50,000 pts., if made in sequence.
games.name: Freefall

games.description: The story so far: you are Jason Voorhees and you return to Crystal Lake together with your friends Freddy and Michael, and you find a new teenager camp with teenagers all around the lake and your cabin occupied by the camp counselors. Inside your head you hear your mother's voice, urging you to kill them all. And as a good son, you listen to your mother.
games.name: Friday The 13th
