games.description: Frontier is based on the mountain man and hunting theme. The basic game play is to collect two separate bonuses. The Den of Predators are 5 rows of 3 animals, rolling over lanes A, B and C or hitting the left, center, or right stationary targets lights one animal in the left, center, or right columns respectively. Lighting a complete row of animals advances the "Frontier Bonus". Lighting all the animals advances the "Frontier Bonus" to 60,000 and the "Predator Bonus" to 45,000 and lights "Special".
games.name: Frontier

games.description:
Another game having "pin targets" is Interflip's 1977 'Dragon'. Recreativos Franco is the name used for domestic games. The same company made an export version as Interflip's 'Full'.

Open-elbow inlanes allow ball to pass from inlane to outlane and vice-versa. The ten "bowling pin" knock-down targets, five green and five red, are in the shape of a standard rack of bowling pins. When hit, they fall flat to form part of the playfield surface. They score nothing, but dropping all pins of a color lights the correspondingly colored kick-out hole for Special. These "pin targets" reset for each ball.
games.name: Full

games.description: Williams' Full House and Top Hand are electro-mechanical pinball machines released in 1966 with a poker theme. Full House is the replay version, while Top Hand is the add-a-ball variant
games.name: Full House

games.description: Original table, designed in 2023. This is a Re-theme of the jpsalas Table Inder 250.
games.name: Full Throttle

games.description: A version of Gottlieb's 1968 'Fun Park' made for Italy. Soon followed by Gottlieb's 1968 'Tivoli' which differed only in the backglass and playfield artwork.
games.name: Fun Fair

games.description:
A classic Gottlieb 1960s Wedgehead, Fun Land is a brightly colored game with an amusement park boardwalk theme and a playfield that's equally interesting and challenging. The backglass depicts a pretty girl shooting at targets at the boardwalk arcade, and the cabinet includes brightly colored flags reminiscent of those used at carnivals.

The open playfield includes spinning targets and a rotating arrow that offers a total of 20 positions in which you can score the Special. The challenge is that as you play, the lighted arrow moves based on the ball striking the three well-placed pop-bumpers or the two duck spinners, which means you're chasing the Special often! The game also has 10 "shooting gallery" rollovers / targets. Hitting all 10 targets re-lights one of 10 numbers for the Special score.
games.name: Fun Land

games.description: The replay version of this game is Gottlieb's 1968 'Fun Land'.
games.name: Fun Park

games.description: FunHouse is a unique table thanks to being one of two pinball machines with animatronic talking puppet heads in the playfield. Callouts by said talking head, otherwise known as Rudy, are dripping with humor. Theme is done well, almost to the point of being vaguely annoying with a lot of repeat play. Definitely a memorable machine, and probably gets a boost in the ratings from its nostalgia factor.
games.name: Funhouse

games.description:
Future Spa was the first game from this manufacturer to use continuous background sound. The first pinball machine from any manufacturer to do this was Williams' 1978 'Flash'.

Shoot the mid-left inline drop targets in the channel to get your bonus to 6X, plus EB if it's either on or set to award points.
games.name: Future Spa

games.description: 'Galaxie', its domestic version of 'Dimension' that is made for export to Brazil then Italy, and the replay version '2001', all made by Gottlieb in 1971, are the first pinball machines to feature multiple banks of drop targets.
games.name: Galaxie

games.description: Galaxy is an electro-mechanical pinball machine featuring a classic space theme, the table includes two flippers, pop bumpers, rollovers, and a vibrant backglass illustrating interstellar travel and cosmic action. It's a vintage tribute to early sci-fi imagination in pinball form.
games.name: Galaxy (Sega)

games.description: The 'Galaxy Play' backglass shows a spaceship above a city skyline as viewed from the ground, with a man and woman in the foreground. In contrast, the backglass for CIC Play, S.A.'s 1987 'Galaxy Play 2' depicts several spaceships high above a cloudy planet surface with no people visible.
games.name: Galaxy Play

games.description: Galaxia is a solid-state pinball machine released by LTD do Brasil in 1975. It features a vibrant space exploration theme, with two flippers, pop bumpers, and a set of standup targets. Known for its colorful backglass and classic design, Galaxia delivers fast-paced gameplay typical of the early solid-state era.
games.name: Galaxia

games.description: Gamatron was a conversion kit produced by Pinstar, a company started and owned by Gary Stern between the collapse of the 'original' Stern and the formation of Data East Pinball. The playfield is a version of Stern's 1980 'Flight 2000' and features a device similar to that game's ball-walker at the upper left, completing G-A-M-A-T-R-O-N letters to enable locks, etc
games.name: Gamatron (Pinstar)

games.description: Gamatron was a conversion kit produced by Pinstar, a company started and owned by Gary Stern between the collapse of the 'original' Stern and the formation of Data East Pinball. The playfield is a version of Stern's 1980 'Flight 2000' and features a device similar to that game's ball-walker at the upper left, completing G-A-M-A-T-R-O-N letters to enable locks, etc
games.name: Gamatron (Pinstar)

games.description: This is the last pinball machine produced by Mylstar before they were purchased by Premier Technology.
games.name: Games, The

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2016. The goal of the game is to become a master of the 6 main rides/attractions. You'll find skillshots, ball savers, extra balls, mystery awards, highscores and much more. When you are a master of an attraction the each time you complete the attraction you get a jackpot. This jackpot increases each time you get a jackpot.
The Attractions:
- The Mirror Maze: a maze where you may end on the Azrael Shooting gallery, the bumper cars or simply back to the entrance.
- The Azrael Shooting gallery: just drop all the targets, don't forget to nudge!
- The Haunted House: hit all the targets and be careful of the ghosts.
- Bumper Cars: hit those 100 times to advance your status.
- Freefall: help your smurf friends to ride the freefall. Shoot the spinners.
- Ferry's Wheel: Papa smurf will help you to get you to the top playfield. Here you may ride the Main Center Ride or the Insane Ride.
- Insane Ride: hit the targets to increase the value of the ride, and get your three smurf friends and get your ride!
games.name: Jp's Gargamel Park

games.description: Gaucho is basically about getting bumper action up top, somewhat challenging given the narrow gaps on either side of the central roto target assembly and the fact that the large gap between the 2” flippers makes balls drain easily. When the ball is up top, you must nudge a lot and hope you eventually get enough “advance yellow” or “advance purple” lanes to make the roto target worth 100 times the value shown on the dial in either window. Once the roto target is at 100X value, it becomes the most valuable in the game. Depending on how drainy the roto target shot is, you can then choose to shoot for it or just continue UTAD. Note that once you shoot the roto target, the multiplier resets. One of the roto target values is a star; that gives and extra ball rather than points. It should be left active; you'll need it! The best time to hit it is when you have no multiplier progress, that way, the progress reset won't hurt you later.
games.name: Gaucho

games.description: Drop the ball between the top bumpers, ideally so it rolls over the little white knob that “scores lit value” [rotating awards are hole advance, open right gate, open left gate]. A full plunge is often the right strength for this.
games.name: Gay 90's

games.description:
Base bonus is advanced by all top lanes, return lanes, outlanes and stand-up targets and goes up to 19K. Drop targets are worth 1000 plus 1000 for each of the four colors you've collected; it's similar to Jacks to Open in that regard. Completing the red or yellow lanes gives you both colors. There are two places to collect each color: one top lane for each; the upper left side lanes for red and white; the upper right stand-up target for green; and the center right side lane is your second yellow.

To double your bonus, complete all 8 drop targets. Complete them a second time to raise your multiplier to 3X. On ball 3, you start at 2X. Strategy is simple - - get the lanes first to maximize target value, then smack the targets all day to double and triple your bonus. Once at 3X and 19K, just keep smacking the drop targets. If extra balls are on, completing all four colors lights the left outlane to score the extra ball.
games.name: Gemini

games.description: An animation feature is under a dark tinted window in the middle of the playfield. It is called the "Regenerator" and it holds the "Lifeforce". When "Lifeforce" is lit, a full-stroke shot on the vari-target launches the unveiling of the Lifeforce robot. This sequence uses an onslaught of flashers around the robot and behind the translite, to the music of Bach's Toccatta & Fugue
games.name: Genesis

games.description: Genie is a widebody pinball machine designed by Ed Krynski and released in 1979 by Gottlieb. It features a jinn theme and was advertised with the slogans "Gottlieb's WIDE and Beautiful BODY" and "A Wide-Body Pinball absolutely bulging with player appeal and proven massive profit earning capacity!"
games.name: Genie

games.description:
The sequel to Steve Ritchie's game from 1986, The Getaway: High Speed II, is similar to the original game. In both games, you drive your car as fast as you can and avoid the cops.
But the execution on this one is just amazing. Right off the bat you'll notice the supercharger feature at the center of the playfield, which when activated, triggers a magnetic ball accelerator which whips your ball around the metal track quickly for a large point payout.
This game is fast-paced, like most Ritchie games. It also has a lot of flow and is easy to learn and play multiple times. If you're a fan of High Speed, you'll love this game too.
games.name: Getaway High Speed 2, The

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2016. The layout is based on the Ghostbusters table by Stern, but there are some differences in the layout, like 2 captive balls, gates at the top lanes, holographic Slimer, wire ramps, etc. The rules are based on Stern's table, but with many differences.

You can go for catching ghosts, you can go for completing modes & ladders, you can go for collecting gear, or all them at the same time. There are plenty of extra modes and multiballs, with a lot of jackpots and superjackpots.
games.name: Jp's Ghostbusters Slimer

games.description:
There are two chevrons of numbered bumpers, one red and one yellow. The bumpers light when hit. Lighting all of the bumpers of either color lights the "Speshul" for replays. However, lighting a bumper in one color will turn off the like-numbered bumper of the other color, making it harder to achieve this objective. Lighting a complete chevron of either color resets the bumpers and scores an Advance on lower playfield.

Outhole award: points and possible replays awarded at end of game based on earned playfield Advances (operator adjustable).

Maximum displayed point score is 1,999 points.
games.name: Gigi

games.description:
First pinball game with a Dot Matrix Display (DMD) released by Williams/Bally, although Williams' 1991 'Terminator 2: Judgment Day' was the first Williams/Bally standard pinball game *designed* with a DMD.

Based on the popular television sitcom, the game begins with the Castaways' tranquil island home disrupted by the impending eruption of Kona, the local volcano god. To avoid the calamity, Gilligan (and the player) must scour the island for seven ingredients to make the Professor's Secret Formula Lava Seltzer and relieve Kona's pressure. After gathering up the ingredients, Gilligan must then traverse the Jungle Run and deliver the Seltzer before it evaporates but will the rotating jungle turntable send Gilligan in circles and sink the Castaways instead.
games.name: Gilligan's Island

games.description: Godfather (2024) is an original pinball table inspired by the 1972 film. Packed with missions, multiballs, and iconic music, it immerses players in the world of the Corleone family for a cinematic gangster pinball experience.
games.name: Godfather, The

games.description: Godzilla is a pinball machine which was released into arcades in 1998 in correlation with the release of the 1998 film. About only 516 Godzilla pinball machines were made and a maximum number of six players can play the game. Every time Godzilla takes a step and a "boom" is heard the shaker unit in the machine vibrates, and the roars of the new and old Godzilla can frequently be heard throughout the game while Godzilla also appears on the dot matrix where you can see him walking, crushing cars and sometimes breathing fire.
games.name: Godzilla

games.description: Godzilla is a pinball machine which was released into arcades in 1998 in correlation with the release of the 1998 film. About only 516 Godzilla pinball machines were made and a maximum number of six players can play the game. Every time Godzilla takes a step and a "boom" is heard the shaker unit in the machine vibrates, and the roars of the new and old Godzilla can frequently be heard throughout the game while Godzilla also appears on the dot matrix where you can see him walking, crushing cars and sometimes breathing fire.
games.name: Godzilla

games.description: Original table, designed in 2021. it's a remix of sega's godzilla table and stern's godzilla playfied. the rules of the game are modified a bit with targets add triggers and spinners the ramps and 3D objects.
games.name: Godzilla - Limited Edition

games.description: Original table, designed in 2023. It's a mod version of godzilla from SEGA in 1998.
games.name: Godzilla vs Kong

games.description: Goin' Nuts is a pinball machine that only 10 prototypes were made and never placed into productions. The game is unique in that it has no outlanes. Also, the game starts as 3-ball multiball with auto-plunger instead of a plunger; once the player started the game all three balls are released and objective is to knock down the set of drop targets in order to score points and build up time. Rather than counting balls, a player's score is determined based on the amount of time left on the timer which counts down when there's only 1 ball left.
games.name: Goin' Nuts

games.description: Gold Ball has two balls, one silver and one gold, but no multiball feature. The gold ball feature as issued from the factory uses an operator-adjustable percentage (1-15%) for the random release of the gold-colored ball into the shooter lane, awarded as an extra ball. When the gold ball is in play, all playfield scores are tripled. The field service upgrade kit converts the gold ball release rules to a skill feature instead of a percentage. The player must light G-O-L-D-B-A-L-L using the center standup target, the star rollovers, or the left return lane. The gold ball will be issued once the current ball has been lost and is considered an extra ball.
games.name: Gold Ball

games.description: Williams 1988 Goldmine shuffle bowler. Right Magna Save key is for selecting the game mode. After feeding a coin and starting the game, you can then select the game mode. Up to six players.
games.name: Gold Mine

games.description: The 1-player version of this game is Williams' 1971 'Klondike'. Also produced as a 4-player Williams' 1971 'Jackpot' made for export.
games.name: Gold Rush

games.description: Gold Strike is the 1-player Add-A-Ball version of El Dorado; both games have 15 drop targets and 4 flippers, with conventional inlane/outlane/slingshot configuration and two small flippers on the upper part of the playfield.
games.name: Gold Strike

games.description: Prenez de la vitesse pour réaliser un looping, rivez votre viseur sur l'une des nombreuses cibles ou déclenchez le mode multibilles ! Les joueurs les plus habiles pourront tenter de faire sonner la sirène aérienne s'ils parviennent à remplir l'une des conditions nécessaires, comme atteindre un score de 500 000 points en un seul tir.
games.name: Gold Wings

games.description: 1977 Gottlieb's “Golden Arrow” The last western themed single player electromechanical pinball machine from Gottlieb, the end of an era. Low production of just over 1500 machine made in 1977 Great fun features: Two spinners moves the “spot” Star rollover moves the “spot” “Spotted” numbers score 10,000 points Three rebuilt Pop bumpers Six bulls eye targets Twelve rollover lanes (with all new plastic lane guides) Three chime box and six inch bell for 10,000 points Over the top 100,000 scoring Ten ways to win a Special End of game match
games.name: Golden Arrow

games.description: Original table, designed in 2015. This is an Angry Birds themed table based on Gottliebs 1977 Golden Arrow table.
games.name: Golden Birds

games.description: Player must complete a task checklist and then the games ends. The faster the player completes the checklist, the more timer points they score. Various shots may pause the timer (depending on configuration and tournament rules). Once the checklist is complete, the game is done.nnnnMaximum of five balls per play. Draining ball five ends the game, although completing the checklist on an earlier ball also ends the game as noted above.nnnnAlso described as having "Minimum Assured Scoring": If a player completes a specific set of objectives, they are guaranteed a specific score. This can be used to make the players score appear to be much greater than it really is, giving the player the illusion that a mediocre final score is close to an excellent final score.
games.name: Golden Cue

games.description: As the title indicates, this game is based on the 1995 James Bond movie starring Pierce Brosnan. As Bond, the player must stop the international terrorist Janus from using the old Soviet GoldenEye satellite to destroy London's financial markets. Opposing him are the sexy but deadly Xenia Onatopp, the Soviet Colonel General Arkady Ourumov, and Janus himself. Infiltrate a Soviet nerve gas plant, engage in shootouts with guards, hack Janus' computers, detonate Q's exploding pen, then pop up the jump ramp to capture a pinball in the satellite dish. Complete all five 007 Encounters, and you might be able to activate GoldenEye itself for a five-ball scoring frenzy.
games.name: Goldeneye

games.description: Original table, designed in 2027. This is a port from Future Pinball.
games.name: Goldorak

games.description: Prenez de la vitesse pour réaliser un looping, rivez votre viseur sur l'une des nombreuses cibles ou déclenchez le mode multibilles ! Les joueurs les plus habiles pourront tenter de faire sonner la sirène aérienne s'ils parviennent à remplir l'une des conditions nécessaires, comme atteindre un score de 500 000 points en un seul tir.
games.name: Gold Wings

games.description: Gorgar was the first talking pinball machine commercially released and had a vocabulary of seven words (Gorgar, Speaks, Beat, You, Me, Hurt, Got). This may sound rather ridiculous 40 years later but was absolutely leading edge in 1979, not only for the pinball-industry but for technology in general, and nobody should forget that. Gorgar also had a heart beat sound that would speed up during longer game play. According to an article in Amusement Review (Jan/Feb 1980, page 6), the talking feature was optional at an additional cost of $70 to the operator and was ordered on the great majority of the machines. Paul Dussault did the Speech Processing for this game. After the sensational success of FLASH, it was the second SS-milestone for Williams and did a further important step to beat Bally and becoming #1 in the industry.
games.name: Gorgar

games.description: GORILLAZ is an original pinball table that drops you into the heart of a high-energy Gorillaz concert. Featuring custom modes inspired by the band's music, you'll trigger tracks, hit combo shots, and unlock unique challenges—all set in a fully animated, immersive stage. With dynamic lighting, DOF support, VR compatibility, and a full media pack, this table offers a fresh, fan-made pinball experience like no other. Perfect for Gorillaz fans and pinball lovers alike!
games.name: Gorillaz

games.description: Original table, designed in 2027. Table based on the 1985 space shooter Gradius. This is intended to be a table styled on the late-80s alphanumeric display era of pinball, with short ball times, nudging required, and lasers that go "pew!"
games.name: Gradius

games.description: Grand Prix (1977) by LTD do Brasil is a fast-paced racing-themed pinball table featuring looping shots, drop targets, and vibrant Formula 1 visuals. It captures the energy of 70s motorsport with smooth gameplay and classic solid-state charm.
games.name: Grand Prix (LTD do Brasil)

games.description: This is a version of Stern's 2005 'NASCAR®' was made available outside of North America only. A subsequent production run of this game is Stern's 2007 'Dale Jr.'.
games.name: Grand Prix (Stern)

games.description: Grand Prix by Williams is a 1976 racing-themed pinball machine, featuring Monaco's iconic cityscape on the backglass in tribute to the legendary Monaco Grand Prix. Its playfield layout closely resembles that of Williams' Liberty Bell (1976), but with faster gameplay and a more dynamic flow that fits its motorsport theme.
games.name: Grand Prix (Williams)

games.description: Grand Slam and World Series are baseball-themed electro-mechanical pinball machines. Both games share similar features, including two flippers, two pop bumpers, three kick-out holes, three roto-targets, and two slingshots, simulating the experience of a baseball game. Grand Slam is the replay version, rewarding players with replays for achieving certain scores, and had a production run of 3,600 units​. World Series is the "add-a-ball" version, designed for locations where replay games were restricted, and instead allows players to earn extra balls for extended play.
games.name: Grand Slam (Gottlieb)

games.description:
3 ways to get Extra Balls : COLORFUL CARRY-OVER FEATURE
Kick-Back Gate is always open, permits player to flipper-kick balls back to area above Top Rollovers, collecting 50 points on the way. Free-Ball Gate turns out-hole balls into extra balls. Tour Gate delivers free ball, scores 100, lights next City in 1-to-10 carry-over feature. Plenty of extra balls and 25 ways to score points insure strong play-appeal, top earning-power. Get GRAND TOUR going for you now.

The Add-A-Ball version of this game is Bally's 1964 'Happy Tour'.
games.name: Grand Tour

games.description: Grande Domino was made exclusively for the Italian market. The USA replay version is Gottlieb's 1968 'Domino'.
games.name: Grande Domino

games.description: Original table, designed in 2020. It is based on Elvis from Stern in 2004. This table is inspired by Grease, a 1978 American musical romantic comedy film directed by Randal Kleiser. The film depicts the lives of greaser Danny Zuko (John Travolta) and Australian transfer student Sandy Olsson (Olivia Newton-John), who develop an attraction for each other during a summer romance.
games.name: Grease

games.description: Original table, designed in 2022. It is based on the script of bond, Mission impossible and friday 13 of jpsalas.
games.name: Great Houdini

games.description: It is a football themed game with a unique dual scoring system. It keeps standard pinball scores as well as football scores from various targets on the playfield.
games.name: Gridiron

games.description: Groovy is a 4 player version of Crescendo. Also produced as a single player Italian version named Psychedelic.
games.name: Groovy

games.description:
The game will immerse players in a dynamic, challenging, and galactic pinball environment where Star-Lord, Rocket, Gamora, Drax the Destroyer, and Groot battle Ronan to stop him from using the Infinity Stone to destroy the galaxy.
It features a sculpted and interactive ball-eating Groot. Color-changing inserts highlight the mysterious and interactive Orb, which opens to reveal the powerful Infinity Stone. The Limited Edition and Premium models also feature extra magnets, custom artwork, RGB lighting, and sculpted Groot arms that sprawl across the playfield.
games.name: Guardians of the Galaxy

games.description: Original table, designed in 2023, inspired from the pinball Fx version. Game rules you have to reform the guardians of the galaxy over the three films on 12 missions and 3 more missions for the superheroes.
games.name: Guardians of the Galaxy Trilogy

games.description:
Gulfstream was convertible to Replay or Add-A-Ball.

This 1-player game used a "split bank" of relays to track two separate playfield objectives: the 1-9 numbers and the S-P-E-C-I-A-L rollovers. The "split bank" was also used in 2-player games such as Williams' 1971 'Solids N Stripes' to track a single playfield objective separately for each player.

This game and its add-a-ball version Williams' 1973 'Tropic Fun' were the first Williams games to use their "gear" style of pop bumper cap.
games.name: Gulfstream

games.description: Original table, designed in 2022. This is a RE-SKIN of the jpsalas Table "Serious Sam 2". This table is inspired by "Gundam Wing", a 1995 Japanese mecha anime series directed by Masashi Ikeda and written by Katsuyuki Sumizawa. It is the sixth installment in the Gundam franchise, taking place in the "After Colony" timeline.
games.name: Gundam Wing

games.description: Guns N' Roses is a pinball machine based on the rock group Guns N' Roses. This game is a widebody pinball game with several unique twists. Among them, is an old fashioned revolver, which players use to start the game as opposed to the typical plunger. When a quarter is inserted, the band's famous "Welcome to the Jungle" song (recorded from a concert) plays. Also included on the soundtrack is the Use Your Illusion outtake "Ain't Going Down," which is the only official release of the song. The backdrop is illuminated with lights in the shape of the famous Guns N' Roses seal, and Axl Rose's tattoos, featured in the Appetite for Destruction album artwork. The multi-ball can be activated when the yellow light is lit on the G ramp, this will open a trap door and send the ball into the snake pit (if the ball is shot up the ramp which is a hard shot), pulling the rose plunger will then activate the multi-ball. An "R" ramp is also featured completing the "GN'R" logo.
games.name: Guns N' Roses

games.description: Guns N' Roses is a pinball machine based on the rock group Guns N' Roses. This game is a widebody pinball game with several unique twists. Among them, is an old fashioned revolver, which players use to start the game as opposed to the typical plunger. When a quarter is inserted, the band's famous "Welcome to the Jungle" song (recorded from a concert) plays. Also included on the soundtrack is the Use Your Illusion outtake "Ain't Going Down," which is the only official release of the song. The backdrop is illuminated with lights in the shape of the famous Guns N' Roses seal, and Axl Rose's tattoos, featured in the Appetite for Destruction album artwork. The multi-ball can be activated when the yellow light is lit on the G ramp, this will open a trap door and send the ball into the snake pit (if the ball is shot up the ramp which is a hard shot), pulling the rose plunger will then activate the multi-ball. An "R" ramp is also featured completing the "GN'R" logo.
games.name: Guns N' Roses

games.description: This is a fan-made remix of the classic Data East Guns N' Roses table, reimagined using the Jersey Jack Pinball style (an American pinball machine manufacturing company that was established in 2011). The mod brings a fresh playfield with new ramps, a striking guitar‑lock ramp feature, redesigned inserts, vibrant mood lighting, and fully updated backglass and ball‑color options.
games.name: Guns N' Roses - Limited Edition

games.description: Halley Comet features an outer space theme, inspired by the appearance of Halley's Comet during that period. The playfield is equipped with three flippers, two pop bumpers, two slingshots, three solitary drop targets, a two-bank drop target, a spinning target, a standup target, a kicker lane, and a messenger ball, offering players a diverse and engaging gameplay experience.
games.name: Halley Comet

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2023. This is a RE-SKIN of Spooky pinball haloween.

The rules are simple and indicated on the table DMD.
- There are 15 missions to do, activated via the kickers on top of the mini playfield 2
- Collect objects with blue targets to activate bonus points, extra ball, multiplier, two ball, complete mission and mystery.
- Activate multiplier bonuses via knives and blood drop with X
- Multiball up to 4 balls activated with the 2 green targets on mini playfield 1 and validated with the top kicker on mini playfield 2.
games.name: Halloween Michael Myers Edition

games.description: An original table, designed in 2022, based by Jacks Open pinball machine from Gottlieb (1977). This modern reinterpretation blends classic gameplay mechanics with fresh artistic influences from Hanafuda Garden, the traditional Chinese card game known for its floral themes and strategic depth. The result is a unique fusion of East and West—vintage pinball action meets the calm elegance of garden symbolism.
games.name: Hanafuda Garden

games.description: This is a near-twin of Hi-Deal with slightly different rules. This is a bonus plus spinner game. Bonus is advanced by the ten white mini-rollover buttons at the top when lit, by the two return lanes, by the five standup targets [three lower left, two upper right] when lit, and from the center saucer, which gives one advance and 1000 points for each drop target that you've hit so far on that ball. Bonus maxes out at 15000. If extra balls are enabled, you score it in the saucer in the center once the five targets on the right are completed.
games.name: Hang Glider

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2022. This is a RE-SKIN of the jpsalas Table Serious Sam 2.

ALL the tracks are fully made by the ahthors, unless the "drain" and "plunger-lane" track which are the original of the Film, and the base to make the original tracks for each ball. The "missions-battle" tracks are from "White Bat Audio", all them create a very intense atmosphere, and more pinball-related sound.
games.name: Hannibal Lecter

games.description: Harlem Globe Trotters on Tour is a classic pinball machine. A really cool and entertaining pinball, Harlem Globe Trotters shows you some serious challenge. Gameplay is not fast, but still intense and with variety to the playfield. The fact that you can rip three different spinners and shoot at a tempting setup of 4 in-line-drops makes this a winner.
games.name: Harlem Globetrotters On Tour

games.description: The table went through three different production runs. The first made by Sega and continued by Stern Pinball in 1999 after they bought Sega's pinball division in the same year. The second produced by Stern Pinball in 2002, and the third with an artwork change also by Stern was released in 2004. The machine features a Harley-Davidson motorcycle theme including authentic engine sound. The game enables players to lock the ball in wheelies on the playfield. The game has an up post between the flippers that is controlled by the player by an extra flipper button on the right side of the cabinet.
games.name: Harley Davidson

games.description: The table went through three different production runs. The first made by Sega and continued by Stern Pinball in 1999 after they bought Sega's pinball division in the same year. The second produced by Stern Pinball in 2002, and the third with an artwork change also by Stern was released in 2004. The machine features a Harley-Davidson motorcycle theme including authentic engine sound. The game enables players to lock the ball in wheelies on the playfield. The game has an up post between the flippers that is controlled by the player by an extra flipper button on the right side of the cabinet.
games.name: Harley Davidson

games.description: Original table, designed in 2027. This is a RE-SKIN of the jpsalas Table Diamond Lady.
games.name: Harley Quinn

games.description:
'Harmony' and Gottlieb's 1967 'Troubadour' are versions of Gottlieb's 1967 'Melody' made for export to Italy.

Unique cardholders were used only for the Gottlieb add-a-ball games made for Italy that had an outhole kick-up feature for extra balls. This feature was a small kicker lane under the cardholder and next to the outhole. When a drained ball was diverted away from the outhole and into this lane, it would be counted as an extra ball and kicked back into play upwards and through the flipper gap.
games.name: Harmony

games.description: It was also the first game with three playfields that the ball can move between, including one below the main playing surface.
games.name: Haunted House

games.description: Playfield layout same as Bally's 1981 'Fathom'.
games.name: Hawkman

games.description: This is the add-a-ball version of Spin-A-Card with different scoring and a slightly different strategy. Hearts and Spades is a great EM if you're playing to win extra balls. If you're playing for points, it loses a whole lot in translation. Hearts and Spades has a different point value ratio mix than its free-game sibling, Spin-A-Card. On Spin-A-Card, the points ratios, using lit bumpers as the base, are: bumpers 1; targets 10; saucers 20; and top center lane 50. On Hearts and Spades, the ratios are: bumpers 1; targets 5; fan target, saucers and top lane 10 each. As a result, the relative value of the bumpers makes lighting them more useful than trying for the center lane on the skill shot. As on Spin-A-Card, the two “spin” saucers are too small to make shooting at them practical since the ball must usually be moving slowly to fall into them. Your best chance of having the ball go in a saucer is via nudging as the ball is coming down from the top near one of them.
games.name: Hearts And Spades

games.description: Spanish table by Inder from 1971, themed American History
games.name: Hearts Gain

games.description: There are only two sources of good points on this machine: the top bumper, worth 100 when lit, and the center drop target. The value of the drop target starts at 100 and is raised up to 500 in 100-point increments via nine items: the five rollover buttons at the top, when lit; the two rollover buttons just above the flippers, when lit; and the two swinging targets, labelled A and B, with rebound rubber behind them. Everything else is worth just 1 unlit or 10 lit. If you advance the target value all the way to the top, it changes the value to Special. You don't want to do that if you're not awarded points for a special, since otherwise, you get zero for the target from then on, making the otherwise most valuable shot in the game now worthless.
games.name: Heat Wave

games.description: Hellboy is a fully original 2024 pinball table that plunges players into the B.P.R.D. universe. You'll face legendary foes like Baba Yaga, Rasputin, and the Ogdru Jahad across interconnected modes, alongside allies Abe Sapien and Liz Sherman. With hybrid physics, custom DOF effects, animated VR room, adjustable difficulty, and immersive styling—including voice lines, rich artwork, and cinematic audio—every shot and bumper feels as powerful as Hellboy's Right Hand of Doom.
games.name: Hellboy

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2016. Hextech is sort of inspired from the PC game League of Legends. This a 70s-style EM steampunk theme with a dual bonus-count system (hitting certain targets controls which bonus is active), two multiball modes (2-ball and 3-ball), a gold ball that scores double on targets it directly hits, a captive-ball target. Trying to get a multiball is probably where the points are on this table. Get a multiball with a gold ball in play and the table can go ham with all the bells going off and the scoring with the gold ball being 4x during multiball.

The tournament mode prevents the gold ball from coming onto the playfield and any extra balls or specials that would be earned instead scores 100,000 points.
games.name: Hextech

games.description: This is a bonus plus spinner game. Bonus is advanced by the ten white mini-rollover buttons at the top when lit, by the two return lanes, by the five red standup targets [three lower left, two upper right] when lit, and from the center saucer, which gives one advance and 1000 points for each of A-K-Q-J-10 that you've hit so far on that ball. Bonus maxes out at 15000. If extra balls are enabled, you score it in a lit return lane [which one alternates on switch hits] once the five cards are completed. One of the outer EB lanes will be on once your bonus is maxed, again if enabled. The right side double bonus lane lights randomly based on score digit
games.name: Hi-Deal

games.description:
Hi-Lo is the Italian version of Gottlieb's 1969 'Spin-A-Card' and Gottlieb's 1969 'Hearts and Spades'. It is the first Italian version featuring a dummy zero in the score.

Machines have backboxes with beaded side panels, used on only a few different models produced in 1969.
games.name: Hi-Lo

games.description: It's hard to believe this machine made it out of the factory. It has to be one of the worst games ever made. There's very little to shoot for and no way to get the ball back to the top of the playfield, so your shots from the plunger must be deadly accurate to complete all of the cards to light the specials. The only cool feature of the game is the double special feature where spotting either the high or low cards light the "high" or "low" special lanes. That's pretty neat, but does little to redeem the crappiness of this game.
games.name: Hi-Lo Ace

games.description:
Hi-Score was Gottlieb's response to the very successful and popular 66' Williams A-Go-Go. Very similar design and features with four pinball fingers, four pop bumpers, two kick-out holes and a captive ball spinner.

The 2-player version of this game is Gottlieb's 1967 'Super Score'.
games.name: Hi-Score

games.description: The lower right corner of the inside of the backbox shows the holes in the insert for the add-a-ball lamps have no sockets or wiring. Above these holes is where the add-a-ball stepper unit is missing and would have been mounted. The jumper plugs for this option are not present in the upper right area.
games.name: Hi-score Pool

games.description: Complete suits to advance bonus value; bonus is 100 for one card in a suit, 200 for two cards, 300 for three cards, then leaps to 4000 for a complete suit. Strategy – try to finish suits rather than get some of each: 12 cards total with 3 in each suit is worth 1,200 in bonus; 12 cards total in three [complete] suits is worth 12,000 in bonus. But don't finish all 16 targets if add-a-balls cannot be played! When you get all 16, the saucer changes from scoring 12,300 for 15 targets (3 times 4,000 plus 3 times 100) to adding a ball for having all 16. If add-a-balls are turned off or must be plunged, you just lost your biggest scoring opportunity. If you do happen to finish them just go for the bumper and lanes until the ball drains.
games.name: High Hand

games.description: The object of the game is to win six casino games: 21 (Blackjack), Craps, Hi-Lo, Poker, Roulette and Slots. The last of these will be the most frequently played of the six games, as playing the slots lights the lock for Slot Machine Multiball, while the bumpers can be reached by shooting an unlit orbit, catching the ball in a magnet at the top of the orbits, which releases the ball on top of the bumpers. The games also award you chips if you win, which increase your bonus and also factor into one of the game's Wizard Modes. If this all seems a bit overwhelming, bear in mind that repeated ramp shots will grant you a Cheat Game, turning your next loss into a big win.
games.name: High Roller Casino

games.description: Get all the numbers, then for the center bumper and top center lane if you can manage it. This is the add-a-ball version of Buccaneer. Ship Ahoy is a poor tournament game but is sometimes seen in league play. Part of the problem with it is its narrow scoring range. Each of the 11 numbers is worth 5k when first scored, then just 500. Once the numbers are done, the only ways to score more meaningful points are to hit the top bumper for 1K or go through the top center lane for 5k. It all comes down to how long your balls last rather than skillful shooting, assuming you manage to get all the top lanes via your plunges. Note you can shoot the ball through the center spinner via a bank shot off the opposite slingshot.
games.name: High Seas

games.description:
Get a card you need; try for the 10 on ball 1. If you already have all the red cards, get the center saucer if it's lit to award a black card. If you have all the red cards and the saucer is lit on red, go for the 10 at the middle left to try to get the ball to bounce into the top left kicker.

The Add-a-ball version of this game is Gottlieb's 1978 'Neptune' which was exported to Italy as Gottlieb's 1978 'Poseidon'.
games.name: Hit The Deck

games.description: Advertised as first game to use 8-digit scoring, Hollywood Heat is said to be an unlicensed tribute to Miami Vice.
games.name: Hollywood Heat

games.description:
Ball enters playfield from between the flippers when right flipper button is pressed. Player must accumulate 1,000 points per ball before the flippers will work for that ball. (This guarantees the player will receive at least 5,000 points per 5 ball game.)

Game was produced in a replay version named 'Playball".
games.name: Home Run

games.description: Honey is a lot like Star Action: central pocket, rollover buttons, center post and right gate. Instead of a diamond-shaped foursome of bumpers, it has a 5-cluster like Swinger. The central hole value starts at 1000 and is raised by either shooting it or scoring the top center lane to 3K, 5K and 10K. You need to knock down the drop target in front of it for access to the hole. Since that 10K value is easily the biggest points on the game, the best strategy is to get the value up to that and keep shooting it. If you get the center post up and the ball resting between it and a flipper, try to microflip until the ball rolls up enough to shoot the central pocket. When you can't get the center, go for the rollovers and A-B. Hitting both the A and B standup targets near the top opens the ball save gate at the bottom right. If you get a ball out the gate, try to get a different top lane than the one you first plunged
games.name: Honey

games.description: Hong Kong Phooey is an original 2025 pinball table, a playful re-skin of Stern's Wild Fyre (1978). Inspired by the classic 1974 Hanna-Barbera cartoon, it features vibrant graphics, thematic soundtrack, and tailored playfield elements. With cartoon-inspired animations, custom wheels, topper videos, and optional PuP-pack support, it delivers a nostalgic, fun-filled pinball romp into the beloved canine hero's world.
games.name: Hong Kong Phooey

games.description:
Hook was designed by Data East in 1992 to tie in with the movie blockbuster from 1991 based on the legendary tale of Peter Pan! The table features skill shots, multi-ball action, double jackpots and adventures in a fantastic pirate themed game.

Features:
- Skill Shot Plunger lets you skill shoot for millions of points, extra balls and multi-ball action
- Double Jackpot Treasures available on the Wind Coaster and Crock Clock ramps
- Pirate Town adventures for 10 million points, extra ball and special rewards
- 360 degree Wind Coaster Ramp will net you 3 million points!
- Digitised character speech
- Large, lighted start button and solid state flippers
games.name: Hook

games.description: Original table, designed in 2023. The table was inspired by the Stern machine "Jurassic Park The Pin Home edition". It use the layout of the table with some changes, and also the rules were inspired by Stern's table.
games.name: Horrorburg

games.description: Based on the Bally's 1977 'Eight Ball'
games.name: Hot Ball

games.description: Make the center “K” lane to light the up kicker and collect bonus lane. Very important! Even if you already have the K and need the S or I letters, still choose the K on the plunge for the kicker, then get the S and I later with shots to the top from the left flipper.
games.name: Hot Doggin'

games.description:
Notable Feature of this table, A large flipper at top of playfield slowly rotates throughout game play. A ball resting in any of the ten "rollover pockets" nearby will score points continuously until dislodged by the rotating flipper.

This game was also manufactured in Australia under license as LAI's 1979 'Hot Hand'.
games.name: Hot Hand

games.description: Center playfield buttons spell out H-O-T-L-I-N-E to lite Special. The add-a-ball version of this game is Williams' 1966 'Big Strike'.
games.name: Hot Line

games.description:
Completing sequence 1 through 8 or 8 through 15 lights special targets alternately. End-of-ball bonus scores 1000 points for each ball lit in center playfield rack, or double or triple this award on last two balls in play.

The 2-player version of this game is Gottlieb's 1974 'Big Shot'. The 1-player Add-a-ball version is Gottlieb's 1973 'Pro Pool' which was made for Italy as Gottlieb's 1972 'Play Pool'.
games.name: Hot Shot

games.description: A motor-powered accelerator in upper right playfield consists of two spinning wheels that send the ball up the ramp to the left flipper. Hitting all four blue drop targets and all four red drop targets without having hit any yellow or green one, or hitting all four yellow drop targets and all four green drop targets without having hit any blue or red one, scores 10 specials. Photographic translite.
games.name: Hot Shots

games.description: Hot Tip was manufactured in 1977 and was the first Williams “Solid State” game to go into full production. It is the definition of a classic pinball, featuring 2 flippers, a pop bumper 2 slingshots, 3-bank drop targets, 2 stand-up targets, a spinning target, a captive ball, and 2 kick-out holes. The upper left lane also features a unique tilt rollover.
games.name: Hot Tip

games.description: This widebody Holden machine was themed after Hall of Fame Australian cricketer Dennis Lillee. The subtitle, "Howzat" is a slang term commonly used on the cricket pitch.
games.name: Howzat

games.description: Hurricane is a pinball machine released by Williams Electronics in August 1991. It was designed by Barry Oursler as the third game in Oursler's amusement park themed pinball trilogy. The first being Comet, released in 1985, and the second being Cyclone, released in 1988.
games.name: Hurricane

games.description: Hurricane is a pinball machine released by Williams Electronics in August 1991. It was designed by Barry Oursler as the third game in Oursler's amusement park themed pinball trilogy. The first being Comet, released in 1985, and the second being Cyclone, released in 1988.
games.name: Hurricane

games.description: Get a free game by completing all the banks of drop targets and then hitting the 8-ball spot target last, lighting the free game in the outlanes.
games.name: Hustler

games.description: Get a free game by completing all the banks of drop targets and then hitting the 8-ball spot target last, lighting the free game in the outlanes.
games.name: Hustler

games.description: Hypercannon fires up to 250 3/4" balls per minute at targets located around the outer edge of the playfield. No flippers. An alpha-numeric display in the lower playfield.
games.name: Hyperball

games.description: Original table, designed in 2019. Based on the Hanna-Barbera cartoon series of 1973. This custom pinball table is a modification of Genie by Gottlieb.
games.name: I Dream of Jeannie

games.description: Original table, designed in 2021. This is a Re-theme of the jpsalas Table Skateball. This table is inspired by Ice Age: A Mammoth Christmas, a 2011 animated television special and part of the Ice Age franchise, produced by Blue Sky Studios and directed by Karen Disher. It premiered on November 24, 2011
games.name: Ice Age Christmas

games.description: The lit return lane (alternates) lights the spinner for 10K per spin instead of 1K. Shooting it dominates all other strategies on the game. Base bonus goes up to 29K, scored by any lane. Bonus multiplier goes up to 5X for 145K maximum total. Three goals (a hat trick) increases the bonus multiplier one level. Shoot the drop targets in front of the captive ball to expose it, hit the captive ball to score a goal. Completing the top three I-C-E lanes lights one of them for an extra ball which scores 100K; the lit EB lane cycles with switch hits. Basic strategy is to do whatever it takes to light the spinner, then do whatever it takes to set up shots to it on the left flipper. Shatzing either way is a good way to do these.
games.name: Ice Fever

games.description: Original table, designed in 2015. This table is inspired by the TV show Impractical Jokers. Full from scratch recreation as a variant of the "Drink Absolut" table.
games.name: Impractical Jokers

games.description:
The Incredible Hulk pinball is one of the first to feature a licensed theme from Marvel Comics. Design credit goes to the visionary Ed Krynski, whith artwork by Gordon Morison. The machine was initially titled "Valkyrie" before adopting the Hulk theme, reflecting the evolving creative process behind its development.
As for the gameplay, players can activate the spinning target for bonus points, adding a layer of unpredictability. The 7-bank drop targets, when hit, reveal stand-up targets. Scoring is straightforward, with bonus multipliers rewarding completion of the drop target bank.
Up Top until you have the 5X bonus multiplier and base bonus at 20K, then nudge for either collect bonus chute [“A” or “B”]. Repeat. If Extra Balls are enabled, shoot the 1-2-3 targets to light the middle right lane, shoot it to collect your EB. Make the lit bonus multiplier advance lane at the top. Harder than it looks, and any plunges will fail to go in any lane, rattling off to either side.
games.name: Incredible Hulk, The

games.description:
Independence Day is a Pinball machine Made by Sega in 1996 based on the blockbuster film. This game brings the silver screen smash hit to life in true pinball fashion. Launch your ball to save the world from the invading aliens and claim your place at the top with an truly out of this world experience!
This pinball does not disappoint, featuring the voices of Jeff Goldblum, Will Smith and Bill Pullman, as well as two different multi-ball modes and stunning visuals on the playfield and display. It's no wonder that this table was regularly featured in the industry awards for Game of the Year in the UK!
games.name: Independence Day

games.description: Indianapolis 500 is a 1995 Licensed Pinball Table released by Williams Electronics under the Bally label. This table features original voicework by motorsports broadcaster Paul Page, retired racer Bobby Unser, and legendary Indianapolis Motor Speedway track announcer Tom Carnegie. Naturally, the game is a nonstop frenzy of speed as thirty-three racers compete to win the world-famous Indianapolis 500 auto race. As the table rumbles with the action, endure all two hundred laps, make your way past the other racers, and go for the Checkered Flag and the Victory Lap. Along the way, you'll collect spanners, complete waves, and pick up some souvenirs to boost your score. Complete the ten Speedway modes, Pass opponents to advance your Position, but watch out for Dueling Drivers or else you'll Hit The Wall. Go for the Speed Ramp and lock balls into the Turbo Boost, then make a quick in-and-out in the Pit to start two-ball multiball.
games.name: Indianapolis 500

games.description: Original table, designed in 2022. This is a RE-SKIN of the jpsalas Table Serious Sam 2. The biggest difference is that there are 5 battles before the wizard mode instead of 12. Defeat each of the demons to reach the final battle for the sacred jewel!
games.name: Inuyasha

games.description: Ipanema is a rare Brazilian-made pinball machine by LTD do Brasil, inspired by the vibrant beach culture of Rio de Janeiro. Released in the early 1980s, it blends tropical visuals, rhythmic gameplay, and colorful artwork, capturing the laid-back, sun-soaked spirit of Ipanema with a touch of vintage charm.
games.name: Ipanema

games.description: Iron Balls is a pinball machine manufactured by Cirsa-Unidesa in 1987. The looping captured ball feature holds four of the five captive balls.
games.name: Iron Balls

games.description: Notable Features: Multiball (3 ball), Two-level playfield, Flippers (4). Split-Level Playfield. Bonus Time at end of ball. Making the 1-2-3-4-5 drop targets in sequence lights the extra ball target while making the drop targets in reverse order lights the special target.
games.name: Iron Maiden

games.description: Iron Man Pinball features speech, art, and dot matrix display images of all of the popular characters, including Tony Stark, Iron Man, Whiplash, War Machine, Rhodey, Iron Monger, Pepper Potts, Black Widow and many more. Iron Man contains songs from the Iron Man movie score. Iron Man Pinball features two elevated ramps and lots of multi-ball action!
games.name: Iron Man

games.description:
Iron Mike Tyson is a fan-made VPX mod of the classic Stern “Ali” (1980) table repurposed with a boxing legend theme. it features:
 - Fully redesigned playfield graphics, bumpers, apron, plastics, and added “toy” elements like boxing gloves on the slings.
 - Adjusted physics for a more modern feel: increased ball speed, steeper table angle, and added outlane “cheat” options for smoother gameplay
 - A custom backglass with full-DMD matching the boxing theme
 - Updated lettering and rules card to reflect the Iron Mike Tyson branding.
games.name: Iron Mike Tyson

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2022. A Re-theme of the Oktoberfest table.

This table is inspired by IT, a 2017 American supernatural horror film directed by Andy Muschietti. It is the first of a two-part adaptation of the 1986 novel of the same name by Stephen King.
games.name: It Pinball Madness

games.description:
A classic Gottlieb drop target fest with great backglass artwork. Fun playing machine that has a unique pop bumper layout in the lower playfield that makes for some frantic nudging to keep from losing the ball.

The 2-player version is Gottlieb's 1973 'Jumping Jack'.
games.name: Jack In The Box

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2023. Help jack sparrow to complete the missions : there are 12 missions and one final mission.

Collect items to accumulate bonuses, block 3 ball is triggered the multiball, turn on some lights and multiply the bonus and playfied, find the extra ball, the mystery light, jackpots ect.
games.name: Jack Sparrow

games.description:
Features: 2 Flippers, 5 Pop bumpers, 3 Kick-out holes. Three slot machine type reels near the top of the playfield award points for certain combinations of symbols.

Same game as the 4-player Williams' 1971 'Gold Rush' but made for export. The 1-player version of this game is Williams' 1971 'Klondike'.
games.name: Jackpot

games.description:
In 5-ball play, the play opens with the "2 Jacks" lit on the progression ladder. Achieving each step on the ladder when lit resets all drop targets for the next step. However, when Royal Flush is lit, hitting the five red A-K-Q-J-10 drop targets for this not only resets all targets but a drop target trip coil mounted on the drop target chassis operates a trip arm having four trip arm wireforms to immediately drop the four black Q-J-K-Q targets, leaving only the five red A-K-Q-J-10 targets to complete for an All Targets Down Special.

In 3-ball play, the two Jack drop targets are spotted by the game and thus play begins with shooting for the three Queen drop targets. After scoring the Full House when lit and the bank resets, the drop target trip coil immediately drops the four black Q-J-K-Q targets, leaving only the five red A-K-Q-J-10 targets to complete for the All Targets Down Special.
games.name: Jacks Open

games.description: 'Jacks to Open' was a remake of the 1-player EM game Gottlieb's 1977 'Jacks Open'. Note that the order in which the drop targets stand is different from 'Jacks Open'
games.name: Jacks To Open

games.description: Discover Jake Mate, a 1-player electromechanical pinball by Spanish maker Petaco. Featuring card-themed targets and classic bumpers, it offers replay options. It's part of a trio of similar tables made in 1974–75: Jake Mate (1 player, replay only), Check (2 players), and Check Mate (4 players), each with slight variations in gameplay.
games.name: Jake Mate

games.description: Step into the vibrant world of Mexican tradition with Jalisco, a classic pinball machine by Recreativos Franco. Featuring colorful artwork inspired by mariachi culture and festive gameplay mechanics, players are challenged to hit targets, unlock bonus rounds, and keep the rhythm alive. With its charming design and catchy sound effects, Jalisco brings a fiesta to every game.
games.name: Jalisco

games.description: Original table, designed in 2021. It is based on Goldeneye from Sega in 1996. This table is a tribute to James Bond from 1962 to 2012.
games.name: James Bond

games.description: Gottlieb's James Bond 007 is a rare solid state pinball machine released in 1980. It is based off the James Bond 007 movie franchise during Roger Moore's stint as the worlds smoothest spy. This table boasts four flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, nine drop targets and three stand up targets, so there's certainly plenty to aim at whilst you get busy emulating the world's coolest secret agent.
games.name: James Bond 007

games.description: Jaws - 50th Anniversary is a Pinball recreation celebrating the 50th anniversary of Steven Spielberg's iconic film. The table pays homage with glitter-enhanced playfield art, brass-coated wireform ramps, and a bold “blood‑red” armor theme. It includes atmospheric details like motorized shark toys, animated lighting, immersive film audio, and a PupPack media option in development. Optimized for VR/MR setups, this polished, adrenaline-pumping design delivers a thrilling underwater hunt across a fast-paced, cinematic pinball experience.
games.name: Jaws - 50Th Anniversary

games.description:
Wax up your Jet Surf Board... in 1977 the waves were in outer space baby! With Spinner and Vari-Target, Jet Spin delivers the best sliverball features from the height of the Electro-Mechanical era - Extra-Ball too. Four Player Scoring tracks the competition.

The 2-player version is Gottlieb's 1977 'Super Spin'. Convertible to Add-A-Ball.
games.name: Jet Spin

games.description:
Originally designed in 2021, this custom table is inspired by Iron Maiden (Stern, 1981) and pays electrifying tribute to the legendary Jimi Hendrix.

With blazing riffs, iconic solos, and psychedelic energy, each game immerses you in the rebellious and creative world of one of the greatest guitarists of all time.
This is high-voltage pinball, where the music drives your shots and every mission feels like a wild, live performance.
games.name: Jimi Hendrix

games.description: John Rambo is a custom pinball table that throws players into the heart of the Rambo universe. Featuring rich HDR lighting, hybrid physics, redesigned ramps, and advanced Magna controls, it delivers an intense, cinematic experience. With thundering bass, chopper sounds, fog effects, searchlights, and immersive media, the table captures the grit and action of the iconic film series in a fast-paced and polished gameplay environment.
games.name: John Rambo

games.description: Johnny Mnemonic is a 1995 pinball machine based on the movie of the same name. The pinball follows the plot of the movie fairly well; you must accomplish various tasks, such as finding a cure for NAS, getting rid of the Yakuza, and getting various rewards from the Cyber Matrix, the interactive ball lock. It also features a pair of Data Gloves that captures the ball in mid-air and guides it with 4-way controls to the Cyber Matrix. When 3 balls are locked in the Cyber Matrix, they are launched into a Multiball frenzy.
games.name: Johnny Mnemonic

games.description:
Joker Poker is considered one of the classics of pinball's early solid-state era. The premise is simple enough, hit the various drop targets to assemble five poker hands of varying strengths, from a single ten up to four aces and a Joker. However, different targets must be hit depending on which ball is in play, testing the player's mastery of the entire board with ever-increasing difficulty. Successfully make the current target bank to light the 5x bonus multiplier, and get the top rollovers for an extra ball.

There are the version of this table:
- The Electro-mechanical (EM) table
- The Solid State Electronic (SS) table
games.name: Joker Poker

games.description:
Joker Poker is considered one of the classics of pinball's early solid-state era. The premise is simple enough, hit the various drop targets to assemble five poker hands of varying strengths, from a single ten up to four aces and a Joker. However, different targets must be hit depending on which ball is in play, testing the player's mastery of the entire board with ever-increasing difficulty. Successfully make the current target bank to light the 5x bonus multiplier, and get the top rollovers for an extra ball.

There are the version of this table:
- The Electro-mechanical (EM) table
- The Solid State Electronic (SS) table
games.name: Joker Poker

games.description: "Players play poker, you pick up the kitty" ; 5-ball novelty play only, no replays given. Shoot balls onto bingo-style playfield to fall in holes to light up poker hand in backglass.
games.name: Joker Wild

games.description: Jokerz! is a gambling themed pinball machine. Now the deck is stacked in your favor with classic card game fun. Discover imaginative pinball as Jokerz! brings to life a timeless theme with proven play appeal. Innovative features and bring-'em-back challenges, Jokerz! has it all. There's dynamic playfield kinetics combined with eye-catching graphics, original sounds, music and speech, and dazzling special effects for the kind of machine you've come to expect from the #1 pinball company in the world. Left and right ramps lead to small elevated playfield. Motorized center ramp raises for ball lock. Spinning wheel in backbox displays poker hand. 2 Multiball.
games.name: Jokerz!

games.description: This game can allow up to four balls in multiball as follows: The player shoots the ball in play into a wire "extra ball" ramp located in the center upper playfield which loops the ball up and around to a "teeter-totter" ball diverter. The diverter is slanted to roll the ball to the right and into a captive ball lane, "locking" the ball there and issuing another ball to play. The captive ball, if struck by the new ball in play, moves upward into a sinkhole, down a subway ramp, then is kicked out of the haunted house to join the ball in play as multiball. This sequence can be repeated until four balls are in simultaneous play. Only one ball at a time can "lock" in the captive ball lane. Whenever that lane has a ball in it, the diverter then slants to the left, sending any subsequent balls that are shot up the wire ramp to roll down on the raised mini-playfield.
games.name: Jolly Park

games.description: This game can allow up to four balls in multiball as follows: The player shoots the ball in play into a wire "extra ball" ramp located in the center upper playfield which loops the ball up and around to a "teeter-totter" ball diverter. The diverter is slanted to roll the ball to the right and into a captive ball lane, "locking" the ball there and issuing another ball to play. The captive ball, if struck by the new ball in play, moves upward into a sinkhole, down a subway ramp, then is kicked out of the haunted house to join the ball in play as multiball. This sequence can be repeated until four balls are in simultaneous play. Only one ball at a time can "lock" in the captive ball lane. Whenever that lane has a ball in it, the diverter then slants to the left, sending any subsequent balls that are shot up the wire ramp to roll down on the raised mini-playfield.
games.name: Jolly Park

games.description: First 4-player machine with an on/off switch, located in the now-familiar place underneath the front right corner of the cabinet.
games.name: Jolly Roger

games.description: Darling is the 2-player version of Jubilee, with the same central captive ball horseshoe and side slingshot design. What to do? Build your bonus, keep the ball alive; the points in the game other than bonus are trivial. Yawn. Bonus is earned by the top lanes (two when lit), by looping a captive ball to the opposite side, by the two small rollover buttons next to the bottom of the captive ball enclosure and by the outlanes. Bonus goes up to 20K. Bonus is doubled on last ball; double bonus cannot be earned on other balls. Because the game is so unbalanced towards bonus, you rarely see it in competition; a player with a big lead is all but impossible to catch.
games.name: Jubilee

games.description: The machine takes inspiration from the British Judge Dredd comic books that increased in popularity during the early 90s. Also featured in the machine was a rotating Deadworld model that could capture the ball, and a unique gameplay mechanic called "SuperGame" - featuring 4 unique modes, a unique 6-ball multi ball, and a 100 million Super Shot attainable within the latter.
games.name: Judge Dredd

games.description: The pop bumpers are near the lower flippers, making the pinball game a potential drain monster if your luck is bad. Jumping Jack and Jack in the Box are considered two of the sexiest pinball back-glasses ever made.The 4-player version is Gottlieb's 1973 'Jack In The Box'.
games.name: Jumping Jack

games.description:
Gottlieb's Jungle is a 4-player pinball manufactured by Gottlieb in 1972, designed by Ed Krynski and with artwork by Gordon Morison featuring a humorous Tarzan and Jane theme.
The 2-player version is Gottlieb's 1972 'Wild Life' and two single-player Add-a-ball versions also exist : Gottlieb's 1973 'Jungle King' and Gottlieb's 1972 'Jungle Life'.
Advancing bonus to top lights side rollovers alternately for Special scoring. The Right Rollovers open Ball Back Gate and the Left Rollovers open gate to the Recovery Kicker. Semi-enclosed Pop-Bumper lights to score 1000 points. Double bonus scoring to 20000 points.
games.name: Jungle

games.description: This game was made for the US market. The 2-player replay version is Gottlieb's 1972 'Wild Life' and the 4-player replay version is Gottlieb's 1972 'Jungle'.
games.name: Jungle King

games.description: This add-a-ball game was made for export to Italy. The 2-player replay version is Gottlieb's 1972 'Wild Life' and the 4-player replay version is Gottlieb's 1972 'Jungle'.
games.name: Jungle Life

games.description: Jungle Lord features a Tarzan influenced theme, a multi-level playfield and a magnetic ball saver ("Magna Save"). Williams had introduced Magna Save in the Black Knight pinball game in 1980; Jungle Lord was one of four further Magna Save games produced in 1981, along with Pharaoh, Solar Fire and Grand Lizard. One difference from the Black Knight design was that Jungle Lord incorporated a "self-contained mini bagatelle style 'chamber' playfield, found on the top left-hand corner." Jungle Lord also included an innovative scoring feature called Double Trouble, a drop target feature that engages when the player hits five special targets.
games.name: Jungle Lord

games.description: Convertible to Add-A-Ball. The 4-player version is Gottlieb's 1977 'Jungle Queen'.
games.name: Jungle Princess

games.description: Original table, designed in 2022. This is a recreation of an old Flash game. It's a simple, fairly easy table, but enjoyable nonetheless.
games.name: Jungle Quest

games.description: The playfield of Junk Yard contains different toys e.g. a crane with a wrecking ball - a pinball hanging from a chain, a toilet that flushes the ball and a doghouse with an attack dog. The player assumes the role of an inventor who is locked inside a junkyard after it has closed for the night and must find a way to escape. The goal is to collect pieces of junk and build various machines (shown on the blueprint in the center of the playfield), each of which enables a mode or mini-game when completed. Once all the modes have been played, the player can start one more mode involving a battle against the junkyard owner in outer space. A devil and angel give tips to the player on what to do. Slingshots are lit by controlled lights, so either the angel or devil can be lit. The game also contains modes featured in previous Williams pinball titles, such as the video mode from Attack from Mars.
games.name: Junk Yard

games.description: An original digital pinball inspired by Stern's Jurassic Park LE (2019). Battle escaped dinosaurs, trigger multiballs, and survive raptor attacks across fast-paced ramps, dynamic missions, and interactive modes. Includes intense sound effects, animated video integration (PUP Pack), and a faithful recreation of the chaotic Isla Nublar experience.
games.name: Jurassic Park Limited Edition

games.description: Jurassic Park is a 1993 pinball machine by Data East, based on the hit film of the same name. It follows the movie rather closely, showing the park's opening and its subsequent fall to the dinosaurs, with several separate modes recreating specific scenes, before the Wizard Mode, "System Failure", recreates the most famous moment of all: the park's power failing and the dinosaurs escaping and wreaking havoc. The game's main attraction is a toy T-Rex head that follows the ball, and if it lands in its designated saucer the T-Rex bends down to snatch it in its mouth, accompanied by a sound clip of a man panicking and screaming "No!"
games.name: Jurassic Park

games.description: Jurassic Park Pro LE is an original virtual pinball table inspired by Stern's 2019 Jurassic Park machine. Docked on Isla Nublar, players must rescue park staff and recapture escaped dinosaurs, from vicious Velociraptors to the towering T. Rex. Packed with fast-paced missions, dynamic island navigation, and thrilling multiball modes, it delivers a high-energy, dinosaur-packed adventure.
games.name: Jurassic Park Pro Le

games.description: Williams' Touchdown and Kickoff are electro-mechanical pinball machines released in 1967 with a football theme. Touchdown, released in November 1967, is a replay version with a production run of 2,253 units. Kickoff, released in December 1967, is the add-a-ball variant with 1,150 units produced.
games.name: Kickoff

games.description: Williams' Touchdown and Kickoff are electro-mechanical pinball machines released in 1967 with a football theme. Touchdown, released in November 1967, is a replay version with a production run of 2,253 units. Kickoff, released in December 1967, is the add-a-ball variant with 1,150 units produced.
games.name: Kickoff

games.description:
Kidnap is an electronic pinball machine manufactured by the Cic Play company on 1986 for 1 to 4 players. Hardware based on System IV from MAC SA.

Game features:
- Triple game system, individual board, progressive and sequential.
- Game self-control by detecting the level of the player who is playing the game.
games.name: Kidnap

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2022. This is a RE-SKIN of the jpsalas Table "IT", original OST.

Kill Bill (Volume 1) is a 2003 American martial arts film written and directed by Quentin Tarantino. It stars Uma Thurman.
games.name: Kill Bill

games.description: This original 2024 pinball table is based on Killer Instinct, the iconic 1994 arcade fighting game developed by Rare and published by Nintendo. Set in a dystopian future, the game centers around a brutal tournament organized by a powerful megacorporation. Blending fast-paced gameplay with classic arcade vibes, this table brings the fierce world of Killer Instinct to life in pinball form.
games.name: Killer Instinct

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2023. This is a RE-SKIN of the jpsalas Table Serious Sam 2.

After a heavy night of boozing you pass out and wake up in some other dimension between space and time. You have arrived at the Killers Hall of Fame! Can you defeat them all ?

Objective
- The game has 12 battles against the world's most famous killers, and a big final Wizard mode.
- Defeat all 12 killers to play the final Wizard Mode, Killer Mania! Surely a score frenzy awaits!
games.name: Killers Hall of Fame

games.description: Original table, designed in 2021. This is a tribute to Kim Wilde (born Kim Smith, 18 November 1960) an English pop singer.
games.name: Kim Wilde

games.description: King Kong is a 1990 pinball machine by Data East, themed around the titular giant ape reeking havoc atop the Sears Tower in Chicago. Due to licensing issues the machine was never widely manufactured, and only 9 finished tables are known to have been made, making it one of the rarest pinball machines.
games.name: King Kong (Data East)

games.description: King Kong is a 1978 solid-state pinball machine by LTD do Brasil, inspired by the legendary film icon. Featuring two flippers, drop targets, and vibrant artwork based on the 1976 movie poster, it delivers classic arcade action with a distinct Brazilian flair. While simple in design, its bold visuals and vintage charm make it a standout from the late '70s pinball era.
games.name: King Kong (LTD do Brasil)

games.description: Get the K-I-N-G letters to increase your bonus multiplier one step. The 4-player version of this game is Gottlieb's 1972 'King Rock'.
games.name: King Kool

games.description:
This is the last pinball machine from this manufacturer to use a silkscreened '1' for the thousands digit in the score. Subsequent games used a score reel in this position for higher scoring.

The add-a-ball version of this game is Gottlieb's 1967 'Diamond Jack'. The add-a-ball version for export to Italy was Gottlieb's 1967 'Solitaire'. The game was also produced in Spain as Petaco's 1967 'Rey de Diamantes'.
games.name: King of Diamonds

games.description: King Pin is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine, the game features a bowling theme with a playfield that includes four flippers, three pop bumpers, and ten rollover buttons arranged to represent bowling pins.
games.name: King Pin

games.description:
This Electromechanical machine witch has some unique mechanics. Firstly, this table has 4 flippers (something not unheard of, but tends to be rare for the most part), a ball gate and double and triple scoring!

The 2-player version of this game is Gottlieb's 1972 'King Kool'.
games.name: King Rock

games.description: King Tut (Shuffle Alley, Williams/United, 1979) is a fast-paced shuffle-bowler arcade game with classic Egyptian-themed artwork. Players slide a puck down the alley using two flippers to hit pins—achieving strikes earns extra points. It's a simple yet addictive blend of shuffleboard and bowling, wrapped in vibrant 1970s style and nostalgia.
games.name: King Tut (Williams)

games.description: King Tut (Shuffle Alley, Williams/United, 1979) is a fast-paced shuffle-bowler arcade game with classic Egyptian-themed artwork. Players slide a puck down the alley using two flippers to hit pins—achieving strikes earns extra points. It's a simple yet addictive blend of shuffleboard and bowling, wrapped in vibrant 1970s style and nostalgia.
games.name: King Tut (Williams)

games.description: Kingdom is a Spanish electro-mechanical pinball machine with a medieval fantasy theme. It features three flippers, drop targets, rollover stars, pop bumpers, and a unique right-side ramp feeding into an elevated return tube. Its gameplay mixes precision shots and dynamic ball movement, offering a challenging but rewarding vintage pinball experience.
games.name: Kingdom

games.description: Kingdom Planets is an original 2025 Visual Pinball, transforming the classic 1980 EM-style Kingdom table by J. Estoban into a vibrant, Solid-State format adventure. The table features a complete retheme with new playfield art, plastics, backglass, sound effects replacing chimes, and an atmospheric BGM. The central loop is redesigned to open new rear-table shots, offering a refreshed layout and immersive gameplay. It delivers a nostalgic yet dynamic Solid-State experience.
games.name: Kingdom Planets

games.description:
One of the all time great EM's - "Kings & Queens" is a truly iconic 1965 Gottlieb title. Featuring an innovative playfield design with sequential kick-out holes, challenging shot selection and classic Roy Parker artwork "Kings & Queens" has become one of the most desirable collector EM's of all time.

"Kings & Queens" was one of two Gottlieb pins featured in the 1975 movie "Tommy". Roger Daltrey played "Kings & Queens" while Elton John played "Buckaroo".
games.name: Kings And Queens

games.description:
Today's marketplace is your arena. Prepare for the challenge. Arm yourself with Kings of Steel.

In the new tradition of Eight Ball Deluxe and X's & O's, Kings of Steel heralds an improved version of the ever popular playing-card theme. Playfield features, sounds, graphics and quality construction give you a flipper game with superb "feel" and profit-making dependability. Compare its features, talk with your Bally Midway distributor and arm yourself with Kings of Steel. Then take on the marketplace.
games.name: Kings Of Steel

games.description: The game contains 2 flippers, 4 pop-bumpers that alternate +100 and +1000 points, 2 sling shots, a 4 target drop target bank, 8 stand up targets, and a 4x4 grid of lights where you must complete the rows. Complete 4 rows a second time to get Super Bonus. Complete a third time to get Colossal bonus.
games.name: Kiss

games.description:
The Add-a-ball version of this game is Williams' 1971 'Yukon'. The 4-player version of this game is Williams' 1971 'Jackpot'.

The flippers on 'Klondike' were placed a few inches below the slingshots, as was done five months previously on Williams' 1971 'Doodle Bug', but this time Williams closed the gaps by adding posts.
games.name: Klondike

games.description: Knight Rider is a fan-made digital pinball table inspired by the iconic 1980s TV series. Step into the role of Michael Knight and join forces with KITT, the AI-powered supercar, to battle crime across high-speed missions. With voice clips, music, and visuals pulled straight from the show, the table captures the thrill of the series through fast-paced ramps, mission modes, and multi-ball action.
