A tribute to justice, turbo boosts, and synthwave nostalgia—one flip at a time.
games.name: Knight Rider

games.description: Based on the 1983 Cult Classic Science Fantasy movie of the same name, this game casts the player as Prince Colwyn, who must defeat The Beast and his army of Slayers to rescue Princess Lyssa and liberate their world. Venture to the lair of the Crystal Spider in the upper level and knock down the target bank to enable the extra ball, then drop to the middle playfield and defeat the Slayers to enable the Transfer. Hit the center target banks to power up the Glave, then drop down to the lower-level playfield and challenge the Beast in the bowels of the Black Fortress.
games.name: Krull

games.description:
There was also a second table released in 1978 with a different set of plastics.

Top holes light the bumpers.
 - Hit the 3 holes to light the Bonus Score on the right lane.
 - Hit the 5 targets to light the Free Ball. Hit the target to collect.
games.name: Kung Fu

games.description: Lady Luck is a pinball machine released by Bally featuring a card and gambling theme. It includes three flippers, no ramps, and no multiball mode, only 500 units were produced, making it a rare collectible.
games.name: Lady Luck (Bally)

games.description: Lady Luck is a pinball machine released by Bally featuring a card and gambling theme. It includes three flippers, no ramps, and no multiball mode, only 500 units were produced, making it a rare collectible.
games.name: Lady Luck (Bally)

games.description: The "Last Lap" pinball machine, produced by Spanish manufacturer Playmatic in September 1978, is a solid-state, four-player game with an auto racing theme. The playfield features two versions: one with three flippers and one pop bumper, and another with two flippers and two pop bumpers. Both versions include a 10-bank drop target assembly, a kick-out hole, a spinning target, and a horseshoe lane.
games.name: Lap By Lap

games.description:
The replay version of this game is Gottlieb's 1969 'Wild Wild West'. The add-a-ball version for export to Italy is Gottlieb's 1969 'Western'.

Wild Wild West and Lariat, both released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1969, share the same playfield design but differ in reward systems. Wild Wild West is the replay version, where players can win replays by scoring points, while Lariat is an add-a-ball version that rewards players with extra balls instead of replays. Both machines, designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Art Stenholm, feature two vari-targets and are set in a Western theme.
games.name: Lariat

games.description: Laser Ball, released by Williams in 1979, is a solid-state, wide-body pinball machine featuring three flippers and no ramps or multiball options. Designed by Barry Oursler with software by Eugene Jarvis, it has a space-themed design and digital scoring displays.
games.name: Laser Ball

games.description: Williams Laser Cue is a four flipper game in 1984, and features an unusual “billiards in space”, science-fiction theme. The game is similar in layout to designer Ed Tomaszewski's release four years earlier, Alien Poker. Despite Laser Cue being released years after speech had been perfected by Williams Electronics for their games, it features no speech chip. Instead, the game is equipped with a bell that rings when billiard balls are collected or extra balls achieved. The main bank of drop targets are individually controlled, and must be collected in the indicated order to remain dropped. Extra ball play guarantees the player twenty-five seconds of play time, serving all lost balls within that time back to the shooter lane.
games.name: Laser Cue

games.description:
This table casts players as Jack Slater and Danny Madigan as they go through ten explosive events from the movie. Race to the Roof, Double your Bonus, chase mice with Whiskers the Cat, then Find Benedict and Save Danny to avoid the Big Mistake. Use the Super Crane to move balls around the table, and if you can endure Lt. Dekker's tirades, the quaking cabinet, and the ball-flinging magnets, you can earn your action-hero creds to attend the World Premiere for a six-ball M-ball bonanza accompanied by music from AC/DC, Queensrÿche, and Megadeth.
Although the movie performed poorly at the box office, the pin is highly praised by admirers, who laud its action-packed gameplay, diverse ruleset, and rich audio-visual package. Players who look past its license and Data East heritage have often called it one of the most overlooked and feature-loaded games of The '90s. The most frequent complaint against the game is for its translite, with an unimaginative montage of characters surrounding Arnold Schwarzenegger's oversized head.
games.name: Last Action Hero

games.description: The "Last Lap" pinball machine, produced by Spanish manufacturer Playmatic in September 1978, is a solid-state, four-player game with an auto racing theme. The playfield features two versions: one with three flippers and one pop bumper, and another with two flippers and two pop bumpers. Both versions include a 10-bank drop target assembly, a kick-out hole, a spinning target, and a horseshoe lane.
games.name: Last Lap

games.description: Original table, designed in 2020. This is a Re-theme of the jpsalas Table "Miraculous Pinball". This table is aimed at children (although adults might enjoy it too).
games.name: Last Unicorn, The

games.description:
League Champ Strikes It Big Game After Game!

Shuffle alley games have traditionally been big earning games. Now a shuffle alley coin-op classic is back as League Champ and redesigned to be an even bigger hit than the original. New software and a specially designed graphics package make this shuffle alley game perfect for the whole family.

New features:
• Redesigned backglass
• Optional ticket dispenser
• Now a 6-player game Tenth frame sudden death game
games.name: League Champ

games.description:
Stern's Lectronamo pinball machine from August 1978 was designed by Mike Kubin. It's Stern's first pinball with electronic sound, generated by the SB-100 sound board.
Pop the Bumpers to score 1000 points. Ball Kick-out Hole scores the lit value. Stationary Target lites Top Hole and Side Lane. Spinner lites when Bonus reaches 10000 points.
Every 4th turn on Spinner advances Bonus. Rollover in Turnaround scores 100 and lites Return Lane for 9000 points. 3 Drop Targets down score 6000 points and multiply Bonus by lit value. 5 Drop Targets down score 10000 points the first time, then lites Extra Ball lane, then scores Special for a replay.
games.name: Lectronamo

games.description: Original table designed by loadedweapon. The table is based on Roneys Pinball Medieval Castle.
games.name: Legend Of Zelda

games.description: Original LEGO themed table, designed in 2022. It is based on "Far Out" from Gottlieb in 1974.
games.name: Lego Pinball

games.description:
La table Les Dents de la Mer (Jaws) est une création originale de 2013, inspirée du célèbre film de 1975. Conçue par Rom, SLAMT1LT et RANDR, elle plonge les joueurs dans l'univers du thriller maritime où le requin rôde et menace.

Cette table recrée l'ambiance du film avec des éléments visuels et sonores immersifs, notamment la proue du bateau et des séquences interactives qui s'activent selon les bonus obtenus. Le gameplay met en avant des mécaniques dynamiques, avec des objectifs liés à la chasse au requin et des défis inspirés des moments clés du film.

Une version modifiée, JAWS Balutito MOD, a été publiée plus tard, intégrant des améliorations graphiques et de nouvelles règles de jeu. Elle propose également une expérience sonore enrichie, notamment pour les joueurs équipés du système SSF.

Si tu es fan du film et des flippers virtuels, cette table est un incontournable ! As-tu déjà eu l'occasion d'y jouer ?
games.name: Jaws

games.description: Original table based on Gottlieb's Fast Draw from 1975, this table is themed around the band Les Insus (formerly Téléphone).
games.name: Insus, Les

games.description: Original table, designed in 2022. It is based on "Supersonic" from Bally in 1979. The Mysterious Cities of Gold (French: Les Mystérieuses Cités d'Or) is an animated series that serves as a sequel to, and a continuation of, the original 1982 television series of the same name.nn
games.name: Mysterious Cities of Gold

games.description: Life Is But A Dream – Avenged Sevenfold is an Original table, built on the "Friday the 13th" JP Salas's table. Designed around A7X's concept album Life Is But a Dream, it features album-inspired artwork, embedded tracks that auto-play during mode progressions, and optional PupPack videos. With five selectable difficulty levels adjusting ball count, timers, and mode resets, plus DOF lighting and VR compatibility, it delivers a richly themed and immersive rock‑music pinball experience.
games.name: Life Is But A Dream

games.description: A fast double level game with a fantasy Norse god theme. It's got 3-ball multiball, speech and a timed bonus ball mode that you earn once you've reached a certain (adjustable) score. Extra ball is lit by shooting the drop target banks in sequence. The extra ball shot then moves between the 3 drop target banks by the hit of one of the four slingshots until you collect it. Your end of ball bonus is shown on an extra display in the playfield. It carries over between balls. It can be maxed at 99k and multiplied to a maximum of 5x. Bonus x also carries over ball to ball, unless you reach 5x. Then it resets to 1x on the next ball. Multiball enables the horseshoe for playfield multipliers to a maximum of 4x. This feature stays lit for the rest of the ball, even in one ball-play, until the maximum has been reached. Balls can be re-captured during multiball play, resulting in single ball play (without draining one of them). The spinner is lit for 1000 points via the horseshoe. It is lit for only one shot then goes back to 100 points. This means you can have 4x playfield and spinner lit for 4000/spin!
games.name: Lightning

games.description: This game features a Western theme and is equipped with two flippers, two pop bumpers, two slingshots, a standup target, and a kick-out hole. A unique aspect of Little Chief is its mid-field ball return gate, adding an extra layer of strategy to the gameplay.
games.name: Little Chief

games.description:
Little Joe is a pinball machine from August 1972, manufactured by Bally Manufacturing Co. and designed by Jim Patlad with the artwork by Christian Marche. The goal of the game is to help “Little Joe”, a broke gambler, get ahead in his dealings although the term "Little Joe" means rolling two two's in the dice game of craps.
The objective of the game is to keep the ball in play after making an initial plunger shot that gets you either 5000 points or a free ball coming through the scoring gate. In doing so, make sure you do it with a 1,2 or 3 lit white die so that an in-play combination of 4 will be possible and you'll have a chance to light and hit the free ball target. Three of the most challenging skill shots in pinball await you on the playfield when trying to shoot for the free ball target, the upper gate or the scoring kickout hole.
games.name: Little Joe

games.description: Loch Ness Monster was the last pinball machine created by Game Plan in 1985. The only real world version of the machine is the prototype. Making this machine extremely rare.
games.name: Loch Ness Monster

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2021. It is based on "Arena" from Gottlieb in 1987.

TABLE OBJECTIVES:
 
1. To escape the City of Domes and RENEW by lighting the lower white crystal located between the flippers (ie Extra Ball). This is accomplished by completing the ANHK drop targets as well as the red ESCAPE targets and then sinking the lit WHITE Skillshot!
2. To winning a SPECIAL by completing the NEW YOU red targets and then sinking the lit RED Skillshot!
3. To obtain the highest score!
 
Congratulations! You've found SANCTUARY!!
games.name: Logan's Run

games.id: Lord of the Rings Valinor Edition (Original 2022)(1.6)
games.description: Lord of the Rings – Valinor Edition is a high-end Visual Pinball remake of Stern's 2003 classic, faithfully reimagined by the VPW team. Featuring hand-drawn artwork, 3D-scanned figurines, and advanced lighting effects, the table captures the epic journey across Middle-earth. Players battle through major story arcs like Fellowship, Two Towers, and Return of the King, aiming to unlock the ultimate challenge: the Valinor Wizard Mode. With cinematic visuals and refined gameplay physics, this edition stands as one of the most immersive and faithful virtual pinball recreations to date.
games.name: Lord Of The Rings Valinor Edition

games.description: The Lord of the Rings is a 2003 pinball game designed by George Gomez and distributed by Stern Pinball. It is based on the The Lord of the Rings (film series), which was first released in 2001. It features the highest possible score multiplier in pinball to date: During a combined "Two Towers" and "Gollum" Multiball it is possible to achieve a 84x Jackpot (when scoring seven subsequent combo Jackpot shots, having the 2x scoring Elf gift and the Sméagol phase of Gollum Multiball running at once). This game was re-released in December 2009 as The Lord of the Rings: Limited Edition, which adds a shaker motor and updated software.
games.name: Lord Of The Rings, The

games.description:
Based on the hit movie adaptation of the classic television show Lost In Space.

Featuring three different kinds: Robot Multi-ball, Fighter Multi-ball and Condition Red Multi-ball - all will win you massive points!

Lost in Space also features a spinning magnetic disc that simulates the gravitational field of a gas giant, grabbing and tossing balls across the playfield.

Spell W-A-R-N-I-N-G to light the robot replica for unlimited super jackpots and slingshot around the outer planets on one of the smoothest ramps ever created!

This machine also features detailed replicas of the Jupiter 2, Major Don West's bubble fighter and our favourite robot!
games.name: Lost In Space

games.description: Lost In Space Retro is an original virtual pinball table (2022) based on Sega's 1998 Lost in Space machine. It re-skins the classic playfield with 1960s TV-series visuals, while keeping the beloved multiball modes and iconic gameplay including Robot B‑9's voice calls by Dick Tufeld. Ball action is fast and chaotic, featuring the original ramps, orbits, and a magnetic disc that grabs and flings balls to simulate a gravity field.
games.name: Lost In Space Retro

games.description: Lost World is a pinball machine released by Bally in 1978, not to be confused with the pinball machine Escape from the Lost World from 1987. Lost World is the first pinball machine that uses electronic sounds which replaces chimes. It is also the first machine that uses a photographic backglass creating a 3D illusion. With a fantasy theme, the machine features a simple gameplay with the goal of hitting the A-B-C-D-E-F targets repeatedly. The playfield contains very few other feature including three pop bumpers, two kickouts, a captive ball and a spinner. A sequel was also spawned in 1979 : Paragon. Artist Paul Faris depicted himself and his wife, as he did on Night Rider and Paragon.
games.name: Lost World

games.description:
The 4-player version of this game is Williams' 1973 'Dealer's Choice'. Same design as Williams' 1973 'High Ace', except that the locations of "Extra Ball" and "Special" have been switched.

Shoot the A-K-Q-J-10 standups from both the top and bottom right flippers; shoot the 1000/Special lane next to the upper flipper from the left flippers. You'll get the 1 through 9 center rollover disks shooting crosswise at the cards from the upper flipper, although if you just need one or two to finish the set, go ahead and use a bottom flipper.
games.name: Lucky Ace

games.description:
Game play opens with the "2 Jacks" lit on the progression ladder. Achieving each step on the ladder when lit resets all drop targets for the next step. However, when Royal Flush is lit, hitting the five red A-K-Q-J-10 drop targets for this not only resets all targets but a drop target trip coil mounted on the drop target chassis operates a trip arm having four trip arm wireforms to immediately drop the four black Q-J-K-Q targets, leaving only the five red A-K-Q-J-10 targets to complete to score a WOW.

Scoring the WOW resets all nine drop targets and again trips the four black ones to leave only the five red ones up, to score another WOW with them, and this pattern will repeat until the end of the game.

The replay version of this game is Gottlieb's 1977 'Jacks Open'. The Add-a-ball version for export to Italy is Gottlieb's 1977 'Lucky Card'.
games.name: Lucky Hand

games.description:
This game features a gambling theme, with slot machine-style reels under the playfield that change as players progress. Up top through the almost-useless spinner to advance bonus and change the reels. When reel value is high, shoot the drop targets to collect it.

The EM version of this game is Williams' 1977 'Lucky Seven'.
games.name: Lucky Seven

games.description:
GAMEPLAY & FEATURES :
- 2 Flippers (weaker coils than Japanese Taito models)
- 3 Pop Bumpers (custom "bowling pin" caps)
- 5-Bank Drop Targets (as bowling pins; manual reset)
- Spinning Disc ("Ball Return" with numbered sectors)
- Kick-Out Hole ("Strike Pocket" with mechanical eject)
games.name: Lucky Strike (Taito do Brasil)

games.description:
GAMEPLAY & FEATURES :
- 2 Flippers (weaker coils than Japanese Taito models)
- 3 Pop Bumpers (custom "bowling pin" caps)
- 5-Bank Drop Targets (as bowling pins; manual reset)
- Spinning Disc ("Ball Return" with numbered sectors)
- Kick-Out Hole ("Strike Pocket" with mechanical eject)
games.name: Lucky Strike (Taito do Brasil)

games.description: Brazilian machine from 1982 based on Williams's ALIEN POKER
games.name: Lunelle

games.description: Mac Jungle is a 1987 conversion kit for MAC S.A.'s 1986 'Mac's Galaxy'. The manufacturer reused the name 'Mac Jungle' on a subsequent game in 1995 having a different playfield and theme and which was not a conversion kit.
games.name: Mac Jungle

games.description: The game features a space-themed playfield equipped with two flippers, three pop bumpers, a four-bank drop target, and a captive ball.
games.name: Mac's Galaxy

games.description: Mach 2.0 Two is a 1995 aviation-themed pinball machine by Spinball (Spain). Players launch and lock up to three balls using toy models of a SAAB JAS 39 Gripen and an F‑111 Aardvark. The game's fast-paced rules include skill shots, multiball (up to 3 balls), jackpots, super jackpots, extra balls, and special modes—all triggered by hitting target banks, ramps, and the captive ball. With dynamic features like a moving ramp, million-point bumpers, and a "Crazy Switch" bonus multiplier, Mach 2.0 Two delivers an energetic aerial combat experience streamlined for Visual Pinball adaptations.
games.name: Mach 2.0 Two

games.description: Original table, designed in 2021. It is based on Twister from SEGA in 1996 and inspired by the movie with the same name.
games.name: Mad Max Fury Road

games.description: The game features four flippers, two pop bumpers, two standup targets, and two banks of drop targets—one with four targets and another with three.
games.name: Mad Race

games.description: With the artwork by Lorenzo Rimondini, Magic Castle in a fantasy-themed pinball revolving around vampires and features Dr. Zekyll, Zankenstein and Zaccula you can activate when 8 drop targets are hit. One drawbridge takes the ball past their rooms for a Red Special Score. Three drop targets increase the Oraneg Special and the 3 fixed targets advance the Bonus Multiplier. The Mystery Tunnel increases the scores and advances the Orange Special. One Moving target gives a surprise on the Orange Special.
games.name: Magic Castle

games.description: Magic City and Magic Town are two classic electro-mechanical pinball machines produced by Williams in 1967. While Magic City was the replay version, Magic Town was the add-a-ball variant. Both machines share a vibrant, city-themed playfield, with imagery showcasing Chicago's LaSalle Street and the Space Needle in Seattle.
games.name: Magic City

games.description: This game featured "Styling of the 60's" with a new cabinet design having anodized aluminum trim and tapered tubular chromium steel legs. A shelf with cigarette holder allowed for placement of drinks and increased the length by six inches. The plywood bottom was increased from 1/4-inch to 3/4 inch in thickness. Williams used this cabinet design on several games during 1960-1961.
games.name: Magic Clock

games.description: Magic: The Gathering is an original, fan-made virtual pinball game inspired by the legendary card game. Built on the layout of Bally's 1984 Black Pyramid table, this version reimagines the classic design within the Magic: The Gathering universe. Players become Planeswalkers, collecting mana and summoning allies to ultimately face Nicol Bolas. Featuring thematic visuals, sound, and gameplay enhancements.
games.name: Magic The Gathering

games.description: Magic City and Magic Town are two classic electro-mechanical pinball machines produced by Williams in 1967. While Magic City was the replay version, Magic Town was the add-a-ball variant. Both machines share a vibrant, city-themed playfield, with imagery showcasing Chicago's LaSalle Street and the Space Needle in Seattle.
games.name: Magic Town

games.description: Magnotron and Duotron are electro-mechanical pinball machines designed by Ed Krynski and released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1974. Magnotron is a four-player game, while Duotron is its two-player counterpart. Both machines feature similar gameplay mechanics, including two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, six standup targets, and a captive ball, offering a classic pinball experience with a focus on building bonuses and strategic shot placement.
games.name: Magnotron

games.description: The table is based on the graphics and music of the Spanish folk rock group Mägo de Oz.
games.name: Mago De Oz

games.description: Original table, designed in 2021. This is a Re-theme of the jpsalas Table "Diablo".
games.name: Manowar

games.description: Original table, designed in 2022. It is based on "Flash" from Williams in 1978. This game is a tribute to Marilyn Monroe.
games.name: Marilyn Monroe Tribute - Kiss Edition

games.description: Mariner and Sea Ray, both released by Bally in 1971, are closely related pinball machines that share the same gameplay mechanics but differ in their player capacity. Mariner is the four-player version, while Sea Ray supports two players. Designed by Ted Zale with artwork by Christian Marche, both machines feature a water sports and spear-fishing theme.
games.name: Mariner

games.description: Mars Attacks 2022 is a creative mod based on Attack from Mars, the iconic Bally pinball machine released in 1995. This tribute table to Tim Burton's cult film Mars Attacks! (released in December 1996) reimagines the original game with custom visuals, PupPack animations, and media inspired by the movie. While preserving the original gameplay—battles against Martians, flying saucer attacks, and chaotic multiball modes—this version adds a retro, cinematic twist to a pinball classic.
games.name: Mars Attacks 2022

games.description:
The Mars Trek pinball machine, released by Segasa-Sonic in 1977, is a space-themed electro-mechanical game known for its unique layout.

Features:
- Making targets "E" & "K" lites Double Bonus.
- Making targets "MARS" targets will score 10.000 points.
- Making targets "TREK" center target will score 10.000 points.
- Making "MARS TREK" will light SPECIAL.
- When Bonus score is at 50.000 points EXTRA BALL will light.
- Passing ball thru semi-circular lane when lit will give EXTRA BALL.
games.name: Mars Trek

games.description: Original table, designed in 2022. It is based on "Skateball" from Inder in 1980. Marsupilami is an animated series (in 2000) based on the original Marsupilami comics created by André Franquin.nn
games.name: Marsupilami

games.description: Martian Queen is a pinball machine from 1981, manufactured by LTD do Brasil Diversões Eletrônicas Ltda. Go for the Drop Target Banks. They light all the main table features. The Free Ball is a great feature, as all the lit lights stay on - even the left Outlane Free Ball light.
games.name: Martian Queen

games.description:
As expected, the game revisits key scenes from Victor Frankenstein's experiments to reverse death. Travel to Ingolstadt, collect body parts from the Graveyard, then raise the Voltage to reanimate The Creature. Lynch Justine, start Geneva Multiball, and endure the Stoning, and try to pick up an Extra Ball or Frankenstein Millions along the way. Players who can get to the Ice Cave in the North Pole might be able to complete the Creation and discover the game's final secrets — but watch out when the Creature begins throwing pinballs at you...
Among pinball players, Frankenstein is considered a difficult but impressive first table from Sega, with a feel that sets it apart from other manufacturers' games.
games.name: Mary Shelley's Frankenstein

games.description: Designed by Wally Welch with art by Kevin O'Connor, Medusa is inspired by the exciting tale of Greek mythology, a beautiful priestess who was cursed by the gods and transformed into a hideous Gorgon, a monster with glaring eyes and snakes for hair, who's look could turn men to stone. A gameplay with metamorphic drop targets, synchronized plunger skill shots, time locked flippers and many more challenging features you will need the skill of the gods to take on this Olympian feat as well as a row of red lights along top of playfield illuminate to reflect the bonus adding and subtracting.
games.name: Medusa

games.description: Sing Along and Melody, both released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1967, are nearly identical electro-mechanical pinball machines. Sing Along is the replay version, while Melody is the add-a-ball variant. Both games feature a lively music theme, with Melody incorporating caroling motifs.
games.name: Melody

games.description: The Memory Lane pinball machine is a solid-state game with a bowling theme. It features two flippers, two pop bumpers, three standup targets, and ten rollover buttons arranged like bowling pins. This machine was one of the last from Stern to use an electro-mechanical chime unit before moving to electronic sound boards in later models like Lectronamo.
games.name: Memory Lane

games.description: An original pinball table inspired by all three Men in Black movies. Packed with iconic sounds, visuals, and missions from the franchise, the table takes players through alien encounters, high-tech weaponry, and secret agent action. With dynamic lighting, animated elements, and carefully crafted gameplay, it delivers a fast-paced, immersive experience straight from the world of MIB.
games.name: Men in Black Trilogy

games.description: The "Mephisto" pinball machine, produced by Cirsa-Unidesa in 1987, is a solid-state, four-player game with a supernatural horror theme. The playfield features two flippers, three pop bumpers, and two ramps that players must navigate to initiate two or three-ball multiball modes.
games.name: Mephisto

games.description: The "Merry-Go-Round" is a two-player, electro-mechanical game. The machine features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, and three gobble holes.nnnnMaximum displayed point score is 1,999 points per player.
games.name: Merry-Go-Round

games.description: Metal Man, produced by Inder in 1992, is a solid-state pinball machine featuring a fantasy theme. The game accommodates up to four players and includes 4 Flippers, 5 Standup targets, 3-bank drop targets, Star rollover , Left outlane kickback, Left dual inlanes, Right crossover return lane. Elevated circular mini-playfield. Drop-down cabinet.nn
games.name: Metal Man

games.description: The game is centered on the world-famous Heavy Metal band Metallica and their music. Advance the Fuel Gauge to start Fuel mode for double scores, use the Hammer to smash pinballs into the Coffin underneath the playfield, then raise the Grave Marker and prove yourself the Master of Puppets. Get the band members' guitar picks, feed the Snake, then throw the switch on Sparky's electric chair to Ride the Lightning. Good players can spell METALLICA to bring Justice For All, great players will use prodigious reflexes to Seek and Destroy, but only the best will Crank It Up and reach the End of the Line, accompanied by over a dozen of the band's best songs and original quotes from Lars, James, Kirk, and Robert.
games.name: Metallica

games.description: Meteor is an arcade pinball machine designed by Steve Kirk of Stern Electronics, with artwork by George Obregon. It was a tie-in to the 1979 disaster movie of the same name, and was released a month after the film's theatrical debut. Like its namesake, Meteor requires the player to stop a five-mile-wide "meteor" from colliding with the Earth. This is done by firing three nuclear missiles at the menace; hitting a three-bank of drop targets for each missile advances it one step closer. Keeping all three missiles aligned lights WOW for all of them to increase scores, while spelling METEOR increases the bonus multiplier. Advancing all three missiles to the meteor gives the player a chance for a free game. The game also made good use of its solid-state design, resetting and remembering game states and drop targets for each player.
games.name: Meteor

games.description: Metropolis, produced by Maquinas Recreativas Sociedad Anonima, of Madrid, Spain [Trade Name: Maresa] in 1981, is a solid-state pinball machine featuring a Fantasy - Outer Space theme. The game is a single player and includes 2 Flippers, 2 Pop bumpers, 2 5-bank drop targets, 2 Kick-out holes, 3 Standup targets, Left and right dual inlanes.
games.name: Metropolis

games.description: Original table, designed in 2022. It is based on "Genesis" from Premier Technology (Gottlieb) in 1986.
games.name: Metropolis Reborn

games.description: MIBS is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine with a marbles theme. It includes two flippers, four pop bumpers, and a unique mechanical backbox animation that adds marbles as players progress.
games.name: MIBS

games.description: The "Michael Jordan" pinball machine by Data East, released in 1992, is a rare custom-built game with only seven units produced. Designed to raise money for charity, the game is based on the "Lethal Weapon 3" pinball framework and features basketball-themed elements, including a "Be Like Mike" music tie-in. The machine has two flippers, one ramp, and a three-ball multiball mode.
games.name: Michael Jordan

games.description: The "Michael Jordan" pinball machine by Data East, released in 1992, is a rare custom-built game with only seven units produced. Designed to raise money for charity, the game is based on the "Lethal Weapon 3" pinball framework and features basketball-themed elements, including a "Be Like Mike" music tie-in. The machine has two flippers, one ramp, and a three-ball multiball mode.
games.name: Michael Jordan

games.description: Original table, designed in 2022. It is based on "Speed Test" from Taito do Brasil in 1982.
games.name: Mickey Mouse Happy Chrismas

games.description: Original table, designed in 2022. It is based on "Speed Test" from Taito do Brasil in 1982.
games.name: Mickey Mouse Happy Halloween

games.description: Original table, designed in 2022. It is based on Circus from Brunswick in 1980. There is a real version of this table created by Craig Monyhan.
games.name: Mickey Mouse in Steamboat Willie

games.description: Middle Earth, released by Atari in February 1978, is a solid-state electronic pinball machine with a distinctive widebody design, with fantasy-themed artwork
games.name: Middle Earth

games.description: Original VPX table designed in 2024, based on the Atari 2600 game Midnight Magic. This reimagining transforms the minimalist 8-bit classic into a full-featured pinball experience with detailed visuals, smooth physics, and modern gameplay elements while preserving its retro charm.
games.name: Midnight Magic

games.description: An original pinball table that brings nostalgic fun from the classic 90s TV series. Featuring fan-favorite voiceovers from Alpha and Zordon, iconic Power Rangers music, dynamic illumination, and polished gameplay with smooth physics and sound effects. The table delivers bright visuals and energetic missions inspired by the original team, sure to make any player grin when the theme music kicks in.
games.name: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers

games.description: Polo and Mini Cycle are pinball machines manufactured by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1970. Both games share the same playfield design, with Polo being the four-player version and Mini Cycle the two-player variant. These machines feature two flippers, three pop bumpers, a vari-target, a kick-out hole, and a free ball return lane.
games.name: Mini Cycle

games.description: Mini Golf is an electromechanical “pitch-and-bat” style arcade pinball game for two players. Players must sink balls through nine numbered holes in order, with a limited number of shots per hole, simulating a mini‑golf course. Featuring a swinging manikin golfer, mechanical score reels for stroke tracking, and a simple but engaging nine‑hole layout, it delivers a charming, skill‑based experience reminiscent of miniature golf on a compact pinball machine.
games.name: Mini Golf

games.description: Target Pool and Mini Pool, both released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1969, are electro-mechanical pinball machines with billiard themes. Target Pool is a replay-type machine with 27 standup targets and one pop bumper, while Mini Pool is an add-a-ball version with similar gameplay.
games.name: Mini Pool

games.description:
Notable Features : 
3 outs or score of 100 runs ends game. Plexiglas playfield with light animation (players run bases). Depending on how far the player pivots the shooter knob before releasing it, a number 1 through 5 will illuminate above the shooter knob as a gauge, misspelled on the game as a "Skill Gage". A solid-state sound card provides crowd noises when any hit is made and/or only when a home run occurs (operator option). Cabinet has walnut formica with aluminum trim. The optional base contains a notice from the manufacturer recommending that the operator add 50 lbs weight to the inside to prevent tipping. Two bolts and washers attach the game to the base.
games.name: Mini-Baseball

games.description: Original table, designed in 2017, based on the movie Minions.
games.name: Minions

games.description:
This is an original table based on the characters from the tv-series Miraculous, the adventures of Ladybug & Cat-Noir. This is meant to be a children's table, and its layout is based on the Fireball home version.

The tv-series Miraculous is all about fighting, but this table is just for fun, like an old pinball table, and the goal is to score as high as possible and to get as many extra balls as you can.
games.name: Miraculous

games.description:
Miss World is a Conversion-Kit by Geiger-Automatenbau from Germany based on Bally "Kiss" and was released in 1982 with the artwork by Michele 'Mike' Martinelli from 1981. You could get a complete Machine (Komplett-Flipper) with the Parts set in a Bally-Cabinet or purchase the Components and convert it by yourself.
When you ordered a 'Komplett-Flipper' which means a complete Machine you could choose if you wanted the old Cabinet-Artwork to stay or to be hidden under a not Game-specific general Geiger-Design. Mr Geiger has stated that 150 Kits were sold and that most Operators just kept the Cabinet-Artwork of the former, converted machine.
games.name: Miss World

games.description:
Miss-O (1969) and Cue-T (1968) are electro-mechanical pinball machines produced by Williams Electronic Games Inc. Both share a billiards theme and a similar playfield layout. Miss-O is the replay version, while Cue-T is the add-a-ball variant.

The original name for this game was 'Miss Q' (a play on the billiards term 'mis-cue') but Williams learned the French translation of that was sexually derogatory, so they had to quickly alter the name. It is believed this change occurred before production started.
games.name: Miss-o

games.description: Original table, designed in 2022. It is a reboot of Bond and friday's 13th jpsalas table.
games.name: Mission Impossible - Limited Edition

games.description: The machine, according to the experts in pinball, is very difficult, since it is one of the so-called short flipper, that is, the flipper (the piece with which the ball is hit) is shorter than the standard.nnnnWith this there is more hole between the controls to snack the ball. That made up for it by including five balls per game instead of 3.
games.name: Mississippi

games.description: An original pinball table paying homage to Jean Giraud's legendary art as Moebius. Players embark on epic quests across mystical realms like Edena and Arzach to capture powerful crystals and attain magical enlightenment. As you follow illuminated guidance and on-screen DMD prompts, you'll face adventure-filled crusades toward the ultimate power of The Incal, but beware, mastering the Crystal is no easy feat
games.name: Moebius  - A Tribute

games.description: This is an American Football themed table based on the ABC Monday Night Football program. As such the playfield is shaped like an American Football stadium, including a raising goalpost and ramp. The table also feature voiceovers provided by Al Michaels, Frank Gifford and Dan Dierdorf.
games.name: Monday Night Football

games.description: Original table, designed by jpsalas in 2015. It is based on "Monopoly" from Stern in 2001 and inspired by World of Warcraft characters.
games.name: WOW Monopoly

games.description: In Monster Bash, your goal is to find and collect each of the Universal Monster characters (Dracula, The Mummy, Creature from the Black Lagoon, Frankenstein, Wolfman, and Bride of Frankenstein) and their instruments so they can jam out while you play a final multiball. Another great table. This one uses artwork and playfield toys to make the game more fun. It has an easy-to-learn ruleset and a layout that is good for players of all skill levels.
games.name: Monster Bash

games.description: This is an adaptation of Monster table from the game "Dream Pinball 3D" on Nintendo DS.
games.name: Monsters

games.description: Monte Carlo features a gambling and casino theme, with two flippers, two ramps, and a three-ball multiball mode. Notably, it includes a functional roulette wheel integrated into the gameplay, with a production run of 4,315 units, the machine captures the essence of casino excitement.
games.name: Monte Carlo (Premier)

games.description: Monte Carlo features a gambling and casino theme, with two flippers, two ramps, and a three-ball multiball mode. Notably, it includes a functional roulette wheel integrated into the gameplay, with a production run of 4,315 units, the machine captures the essence of casino excitement.
games.name: Monte Carlo (Premier)

games.description: Moon Light, produced by Inder in 1987, is a solid-state pinball machine featuring a space fantasy theme. The game accommodates up to four players and includes two flippers, three pop bumpers, and two rollunder spinners.
games.name: Moon Light

games.description: A 4‑player electro-mechanical sci-fi pinball. The playfield features two flippers, five pop bumpers, and outlane gates that can transform into inlanes when specific targets are hit. Players guide the ball through rocket lanes to build up scoring values, activate extra balls, and enjoy fast-paced bumper action. It shares its layout with the 2-player version Astronaut, released the same year, but features different backglass artwork. With its clever design and space-race theme, Moon Shot delivers a classic arcade experience.
games.name: Moon Shot (Chicago Coin)

games.description: Original table, designed in 2016. inspired by the arcade game Mortal Kombat 1
games.name: Mortal Kombat

games.description: Original table, designed in 2016. It inspired by the arcade game Mortal Kombat II
games.name: Mortal Kombat 2

games.description: Original table, designed in 2017. It inspired by Mötley Crüe, an American heavy metal band formed in Hollywood, California, in 1981 by bassist Nikki Sixx and drummer Tommy Lee, with guitarist Mick Mars and lead vocalist Vince Neil joining right after. The band has sold over 100 million records worldwide.
games.name: Motley Crue

games.description: Motor Show is a solid-state pinball machine released by Mr. Game in 1989, featuring a racing theme that integrates traditional pinball elements with video game modes. All targets are stationary even though they look like drop targets. Stereo sound. Uses a color video monitor in the lower, middle backbox as the display for scoring, credits, ball in play, etc., as well as for attract mode graphics and three video modes.
games.name: Motor Show

games.description: The Motordome pinball machine, released by Bally in 1986, offers a unique and fast-paced gameplay experience, characterized by its motorbike racing theme. Player selects one of three different skill levels before shooting first ball.
games.name: Motordome

games.description: The Moulin Rouge pinball machine, produced by Williams Electronic Games Inc. in May 1965, is an electro-mechanical, single-player game. Featuring a Parisian nightclub theme inspired by the famous Moulin Rouge, the game includes two flippers, three pop bumpers, six passive bumpers, and five kick-out holes.nnnnMaximum displayed point score is 9,999 points.
games.name: Moulin Rouge

games.description: The "Mr. & Mrs. Pac-Man" pinball machine, released by Bally in 1982, integrates traditional pinball with elements from the iconic video game. It features three flippers, 11 drop targets, six standup targets, and a unique 5x5 Pac-Maze grid on the playfield. Players collect 'moves' and navigate the Pac-Maze, replicating the classic Pac-Man chase.
games.name: Mr. & Mrs. Pac-Man Pinball

games.description: This table is a clone from the Bally's Mr. & Mrs. Pac-Man Pinball in 1982
games.name: Mr. & Mrs. Pec-Men

games.description: Mr. Black, produced by Taito do Brasil in 1984, is a solid-state pinball machine with a fantasy theme. The playfield layout closely mirrors that of Williams' 1982 'Defender,' featuring three flippers, two pop bumpers, two slingshots, multiple drop targets, a standup target, and a captive ball walker.
games.name: Mr. Black

games.description: Original table, designed in 2022. It is based on "Nautilus" from Playmatic 1984.
games.name: Muppets Tribute

games.description: The "Mustang" pinball machine, created by Stern in 2014, is a high-energy game celebrating 50 years of the iconic Ford Mustang. Designed with vibrant artwork by Camilo Pardo, known for his work on the Ford GT, this machine immerses players in the world of classic car racing with a fast-paced, dynamic playfield. Key features include a rotating turntable with a Mustang model, multiple ramps, and interactive targets that enhance the racing theme. The game also features narration by professional drag racer Tanner Foust and a soundtrack spanning five decades of hits from Sony Music, adding to the immersive experience​.
games.name: Mustang (Stern)

games.description: The "Mustang" pinball machine, created by Stern in 2014, is a high-energy game celebrating 50 years of the iconic Ford Mustang. Designed with vibrant artwork by Camilo Pardo, known for his work on the Ford GT, this machine immerses players in the world of classic car racing with a fast-paced, dynamic playfield. Key features include a rotating turntable with a Mustang model, multiple ramps, and interactive targets that enhance the racing theme. The game also features narration by professional drag racer Tanner Foust and a soundtrack spanning five decades of hits from Sony Music, adding to the immersive experience​.
games.name: Mustang (Stern)

games.description: The Mystery Castle pinball machine, produced by Alvin G. and Company in 1993, is a rare, horror-themed game with only 227 units made. Designed by Michael Gottlieb and Wally Welch, the game features three flippers, three ramps, two multiball modes, and six drop targets.nnnnThe words 'OF DOOM' are hidden in the backglass art under the 'Mystery Castle' title and can only be seen when illuminated during certain modes.
games.name: Mystery Castle

games.description: The Mystic pinball machine, produced by Bally in June 1980, is a solid-state game. The machine features a magic theme with elements inspired by mythology and cards.
games.name: Mystic

games.description:
Original table, designed in 2023. It is based on "Mephisto" from Unidesa in 1987. "Don't Toy with Me, Miss Nagatoro" is a Japanese web manga series written and illustrated by Nanashi, also known as 774, about a high-schooler and art club member who is frequently annoyed by his junior Nagato.

An anime television series adaptation produced by Telecom Animation Film aired from April to June 2021. A second season produced by OLM aired from January to March 2023.
games.name: Nagatoro Pinball

games.description:
Nairobi, produced by Maresa in 1966, is a electro-mechanical pinball machine featuring a Hunting - Safari theme. The game is a single player and includes 2 Flippers, 5 Pop bumpers, 2 Passive bumpers, 2 Slingshots, 2 Kick-out holes. Backglass light illumination (African wildlife light up).

This table has the same playfield design as Gottlieb's 1964 'North Star'. Maximum displayed point score is 1,999 points.
games.name: Nairobi

games.description:
The "NASCAR" pinball machine by Stern, released in 2005 features a dynamic racing theme. The gameplay revolves around a racetrack that loops around the playfield, creating an exciting, fast-paced experience.

Voice over by Allen Bestwick, NASCAR television analyst for NBC. Music tracks include recording artist Sammy Hagar's "I Can't Drive 55", a popular tune among NASCAR fans.
games.name: Nascar

games.description: This table is a Reskin of the Nascar Table from Stern in 2005 done by Jpsalas in 2015
games.name: Nascar Race

games.description: Nautilus is a solid-state pinball machine released by Playmatic in 1984. The game features three flippers, three pop bumpers, a slingshot, five star rollovers, two banks of four drop targets, three kick-out holes, and two standup targets.
games.name: Nautilus

games.description: The mechanical backbox animation consists of a flipper in the lower right part of the backbox and a basket on the far left side. The game controls the backbox flipper sometimes when points are scored. For instance, after a set amount of pop bumper hits, during multiball, and during the Egyptian Soda and Hot Dog Mania modes. The exception is Pizza Power Shots mode. In this mode, the player tries to score as many points as possible in the backbox basket. This is done by flipping the backbox flipper at the right moment. A basket shot can be worth 1, 2 or 3 points, depending on the amount shown in the score display at the moment of hitting the basket switch.
games.name: Nba Fastbreak

games.description: NBA Mac, produced by Maquinas Automaticas Computerizadas, S.A., of Madrid, in 1996, is a solid-state pinball machine featuring a Basketball theme. The game accommodates up to four players and includes 2 Flippers, 3 Pop bumpers, 2 3-bank drop targets, Spinning target, Captive ball with Newton rail, Dual inlanes.
games.name: Nba Mac

games.description: A sci-fi original pinball table with detailed playfield art, a slingshot replacing the top left bumper, a kicker, outlining lights, and cleaned-up playfield elements. Players navigate wire and lift ramps—the lift ramp alternates between ramp shots and multiball, while facing explosive robot targets. A hidden gate above the ramp adds strategic depth. The game delivers fast-paced, dynamic gameplay in an interstellar showdown.
games.name: Nebulon 3 - The Final Boss

games.description: Original table, designed in 2018. It is based on another Original table 'Minions'. This table is inspired by the game Need for Speed series
games.name: Need For Speed

games.description: Nemesis, released by Spanish manufacturer Peyper in 1986, is a solid-state pinball machine with a fantasy theme. The game features two flippers, two pop bumpers, four standup targets, two captive balls, two solitary drop targets, and a three-bank drop target. The backglass art is a rendition of "Flight of the Dragons" by Boris Vallejo.
games.name: Nemesis

games.description:
"Hit the Deck" and "Neptune" are two closely related pinball machines produced by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1978. "Hit the Deck" is a replay version, while "Neptune" is the Add-A-Ball variant.

"Hit the Deck" features a low production run of 375 units, making it a rare electro-mechanical (EM) machine, with unique mechanical score reels designed to mimic solid-state displays. "Neptune" was even rarer, with only 270 units produced, and it was notable for using black score reels with red letters to give it a more modern, digital appearance despite being an EM game.
games.name: Neptune

games.description: Original table, designed in 2021. This is a RE-SKIN of the jpsalas Table Serious Sam 2 and and inspired by "The NeverEnding Story", a 1984 fantasy film, co-written and directed by Wolfgang Petersen (in his first English-language film), based on the 1979 novel The Neverending Story by Michael Ende.
games.name: Neverending Story

games.description: An original pinball table inspired by the iconic punk rock album Never Mind the Bollocks, Here's the Sex Pistols, released on 28 October 1977 through Virgin Records in the UK and on 11 November 1977 through Warner Bros. Records in the US. The table features vibrant artwork, LED spinner arrows, and dynamic lighting effects. Players engage with unique playfield elements, including a record player target, band inlane roll-overs, and a safety pin lane multiplier. The game offers a fast-paced, anarchy-filled experience, capturing the rebellious spirit of the late 1970s.
games.name: Nevermind the Bollocks

games.description: New World and Conquest 200 are electro-mechanical pinball machines released by Spanish manufacturer Playmatic in October 1976. New World is the four-player version, while Conquest 200 is the single-player counterpart.
games.name: New World

games.description:
'New York' is a special add-a-ball version of the 2-player Gottlieb's 1976 'Pioneer' that was made in celebration of the 1976 lifting of the laws that had banned pinball in New York City.
The 4-player replay version is Gottlieb's 1975 'Spirit of 76'.

As this game was essentially a conversion of the replay game, the half-moon credit window is still present on the backglass but is decorated with stars, visible to the player.
games.name: New York

games.description: Night Moves by International Concepts, released in 1989, is a cocktail-style pinball machine. It was part of a brief resurgence of cocktail pinball machines in the late '80s. Manufactured by Premier/Gottlieb but sold under the International Concepts brand, the machine features System 80B boards with under-playfield parts typical of Gottlieb designs.
games.name: Night Moves

games.description: Original table, designed in 2018. It is based on "Out of Sight" from Gottlieb in 1974 and inspired by the movie Night of the Living Dead. a 1968 American independent zombie horror film directed, photographed, and edited by George A. Romero.
games.name: Night Of The Living Dead '68

games.description: The Night Rider pinball machine, produced by Bally, is notable for being released in both electro-mechanical (EM) in in 1976 and solid-state (SS) versions in in 1977. This game features a transportation theme centered around trucking. The game was among the last to use mechanical score reels before the transition to digital displays, marking a significant period in pinball history.
games.name: Night Rider

games.description: Nightmare Before Christmas is a fan-made digital pinball table inspired by Tim Burton's classic film. Featuring fast-paced gameplay, multiball modes, and atmospheric visuals, it captures the spooky charm of Halloween Town with vibrant animations, themed sounds, and a layout designed for thrilling combos and flow.
games.name: Nightmare Before Christmas

games.description: Original table, designed in 2023. It is based on the 2004 xbox game by Team Ninja / Tecmo.
games.name: Ninja Gaiden

games.description:
The "Nip-It" pinball machine by Bally, released in 1973, is renowned for its distinctive "Balligator" mechanism, a metal bar that grabs the ball from the playfield and directs it into a high-scoring lane.

Maximum displayed point score is 99,990 points per player.
games.name: Nip-It

games.description:
The Nitro Ground Shaker Pinball Machine marked a significant entry in the early solid-state era of pinball. Inspired by the thrilling world of drag racing, the machine captures the adrenaline of the sport through its vibrant theme and fast-paced gameplay. Designed by George Christian and featuring artwork by Dave Christensen, Nitro Ground Shaker became a notable release with a production run of 7,950 units. Interestingly, while the backglass prominently features "Nitro," the manufacturer's materials often refer to it simply as Ground Shaker. This machine quickly gained attention for its dynamic design and nostalgic appeal, becoming a favorite among enthusiasts of 70s and 80s pinball.
The gameplay revolves around hitting specific targets to activate features like the spinning target and saucer, each offering unique scoring opportunities. While the gameplay is straightforward, the speed of the ball and the need for precise timing add a layer of difficulty.
games.name: Nitro Ground Shaker

games.description: The "No Fear: Dangerous Sports" pinball machine, released by Williams in 1995, themed around extreme sports, in collaboration with the No Fear clothing brand. This game features a range of adrenaline-pumping sports, including skydiving, free climbing, water skiing, and car racing.
games.name: No Fear - Dangerous Sports

games.description: Original table, designed in 2016 based on the card game Cribbage
games.name: NOBS

games.description:
North Star, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1964, is an iconic electro-mechanical pinball machine. The machine is well-known for its winter and ice-themed artwork.

Maximum displayed point score is 1,999 points.
games.name: North Star

games.description: Original table, designed in 2023. Inspired by the movie "Nosferatu: A Symphony of Horror", a 1922 silent German Expressionist vampire film directed by F. W. Murnau from a screenplay by Henrik Galeen.
games.name: Nosferatu 1922

games.description:
Now is a 1971 electro-mechanical pinball machine produced by D. Gottlieb & Co. The game features a psychedelic theme, typical of its era, and offers four-player gameplay.

Maximum displayed point score 9,999 points per player.
games.name: Now

games.description: This is a redemption machine that has no flippers. You "nudge" the ball to roll over items for scoring.
games.name: Nudge-It

games.description: This is a redemption machine that has no flippers. You "nudge" the ball to roll over items for scoring.
games.name: Nudge-It

games.description:
The first flipper game by Bally was Bally's 1948 'Melody' in November 1947. Operators of this period would soon retrofit flipperless games, like Nudgy, and these new flippers often ended up in unusual places on the playfield.

This game was made in two versions: A standard cabinet version and a rolldown cabinet version. Both were made by the manufacturer without flippers. The rolldown version has a ball dispenser instead of a plunger.
games.name: Nudgy

games.id: Nuka Cola - Pop A Top Pinball (2024)(1.0)
games.description: An original post‑apocalyptic pinball machine that revives the ultra‑rare Nuka‑Cola promotional table from Red Rocket Fueling stations. Fully restored for modern play, it immerses players in a wasteland theme with vibrant art, thematic lighting, and Fallout-inspired audio. Skill shots on the Cappy and Bottle launch multiball, drop target banks offer 2× and 3× bonuses, and spinners rack up “Nuka‑Points”—but watch your shots or you'll lose your soda down the drain. A clever reproduction of a beloved treasure makes it available for bunker dwellers everywhere.
games.name: Nuka Cola - Pop A Top Pinball

games.id: Nuka Cola - Pop A Top Pinball (Clairvius 2024)(1.2)
games.description: An original post‑apocalyptic pinball machine that revives the ultra‑rare Nuka‑Cola promotional table from Red Rocket Fueling stations. Fully restored for modern play, it immerses players in a wasteland theme with vibrant art, thematic lighting, and Fallout-inspired audio. Skill shots on the Cappy and Bottle launch multiball, drop target banks offer 2× and 3× bonuses, and spinners rack up “Nuka‑Points”—but watch your shots or you'll lose your soda down the drain. A clever reproduction of a beloved treasure makes it available for bunker dwellers everywhere.
games.name: Nuka Cola - Pop A Top Pinball

games.id: Odds & Evens - Bud Spencer & Terence Hill (Original 2021)(1.0)
games.description: A lively pinball tribute to the classic 1978 action-comedy Odds and Evens, starring Bud Spencer and Terence Hill. Based on Bally's 1975 Captain Fantastic table, this original creation immerses players in the duo's slapstick universe with themed artwork, sound effects, and cinematic flair. It features fast-paced missions, four multiball modes, three wizard modes, and plenty of comedic chaos, bringing all the “slaps and beans” fans expect from Bud & Terence.
games.name: Odds & Evens - Bud Spencer & Terence Hill

games.description: Odin / Odin Deluxe, produced by the Spanish manufacturer Peyper in 1985, is a solid-state pinball machine inspired by Norse mythology and designed by Eulogio Pingarrón. The game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, a five-bank drop target, and two standup targets
games.name: Odin Deluxe

games.description: "Odisea Paris-Dakar" is a solid-state pinball machine released by the Spanish manufacturer Peyper in 1987. The game draws inspiration from the renowned Paris-Dakar Rally, featuring thematic artwork and playfield elements that reflect the adventurous spirit of the race. The playfield is equipped with two flippers, three pop bumpers, and two slingshots.
games.name: Odisea Paris Dakar

games.description:
Bally's Old Chicago is a 4-player pinball machine from April 1976 designed by Greg Kmiec with the art by Dave Christensen and John Youssi.
It has 7 advertised features. Multiple Chance Bonus where points are accumulated by shooting in the centerfield kickout. Spinner Gates can score either 10 or 100 for each spin advancing the bonus with each next spinner lit up. A Spelling challenge where each letter of "OLDCHICAGO" scores 1000 points. With Last-Inch Special Suspense, a special is scored when the ball exits via the left out-lane with adjacent Special signal lit. A special is also scored when 5 Drop Targets are dropped while centerfield Special signal is lit. The Double Out-Hole Bonus is obtained when the ball enters the out-hole when the Double Bonus signal is lit. An Extra Ball is obtained when a ball in play exits via the right out-lane while the signal is lit.
games.name: Old Chicago

games.description: "Old Coney Island!" was released by Game Plan in December 1979. This solid-state pinball machine was themed around the classic Coney Island amusement park, featuring elements like roller coasters and amusement rides. The game includes two flippers, three pop bumpers, a seven-bank drop target, and a spinning target.
games.name: Old Coney Island

games.description: "Olympics" and "Super Star" are electro-mechanical pinball machines released by Chicago Coin. Both games share a sports theme, with "Super Star" accommodating up to four players and "Olympics" designed for two players. The playfields feature two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, two standup targets, and two spinning targets.
games.name: Olympics (Chicago Coin)

games.description: "Olympics" and "Super Star" are electro-mechanical pinball machines released by Chicago Coin. Both games share a sports theme, with "Super Star" accommodating up to four players and "Olympics" designed for two players. The playfields feature two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, two standup targets, and two spinning targets.
games.name: Olympics (Chicago Coin)

games.description: Olympus, produced by Juegos Populares in 1986, is a 4 players solid-state pinball machine featuring a Greek Mythology theme and includes 3 Flippers, 2 Pop bumpers, 2 Slingshots, 5 Standup targets, 3-bank drop targets, Vari-target, Swivel target.
games.name: Olympus

games.description: On Beam features a space exploration theme, this electro-mechanical game accommodates a single player and includes a mechanical reel display for scoring. A total of 1,150 units were produced. The game is noted for its unique cabinet artwork, which was influenced by Bally's earlier machine Cosmos
games.name: On Beam

games.description: Op-Pop-Pop is a single-player, electro-mechanical game featuring a distinctive psychedelic art theme, it incorporates unique gameplay elements such as zipper flippers—flippers that close together to prevent the ball from draining—five mushroom bumpers, a bagatelle in the upper playfield, and a left drop lane.
games.name: Op-Pop-Pop

games.description:
Operation: Thunder is a Physical Pinball Table released by Gottlieb (under the "Premier" label) in 1992. Developed by Ray Tanzer with artwork by David Moore and Constantino and Jeanine Mitchell, it was Gottlieb's last game to use an alphanumeric score display.
The game puts the player in charge of a squadron of F-15 Eagles and Stealth Fighters, waging an unyielding air attack on the enemy such as destroying radar installations, strafing tank columns, and attacking the domed power plant. Light up the mountainous terrain with a barrage of bombs and missiles, but make sure you don't run out of fuel lest you crash and burn. Only the best pilots will make it through all eleven missions, and those who survive the Final Assault will be rewarded with a hero's welcome and a well-earned promotion.
games.name: Operation Thunder

games.description:
"Outer Space" and "The Orbit" pinball machines, released by Gottlieb in 1971, are nearly identical except for the number of players: Orbit supports four players, while Outer Space is a two-player version. Both games share the same playfield design, featuring three pop bumpers, a vari-target, a spinner, and two flippers. These machines focus on a space theme and were designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Gordon Morison.

Maximum displayed point score is 99,990 points per player.
games.name: Outer Space

games.description: OXO is a pinball machine released by Williams Electronics in August 1973. This electro-mechanical game is themed around the classic game of tic-tac-toe, with players aiming to light up X's and O's on the playfield to achieve three in a row.
games.name: Oxo

games.description:
The Pabst Brewing Company, makers of Pabst Blue Ribbon beer (“PBR”), partenered with Stern Pinball to create its new PBR-
Themed “Can Crusher” pinball machine.
The “Can Crusher” pinball machine captures the iconic nature of the PBR brand with a retro game design, dynamic eye-popping art by artist and pinball phenomenon Dirty Donny and music by hard-hitting heavy metal band Red Fang.
“To partner with Stern Pinball on the 'Can Crusher' and have a superstar artist like Dirty Donny and music from Red Fang was exactly what we set out to do when we wanted to make a pinball machine the PBR way. The game does a great job of capturing the essence of our brand,” said Pabst CMO Dan McHugh.
This pinball is a reissue of Stern's 2015 'Whoa Nellie! Big Juicy Melons' but with different artwork.
games.name: Pabst Can Crusher, The

games.description:
Paddock and its add-a-ball counterpart Post Time, both released by Williams Electronic Games in 1969, are electro-mechanical pinball machines with a horse racing theme. These games feature a racetrack motif formed by ten rollover buttons on the playfield.

Maximum displayed point score is 9,999 points.
games.name: Paddock

games.description:
Royal Guard and Palace Guard, both released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1968, are electro-mechanical pinball machines. Royal Guard is the replay version, while Palace Guard is the add-a-ball variant.

Maximum displayed point score is 9,999 points.
games.name: Palace Guard

games.description: "Panthera" is a pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in June 1980. It features a solid-state design with two flippers, no ramps, and no multiball mode. The game is part of the Gottlieb System 80 series. A total of 5,220 units were produced.
games.name: Panthera

games.description: Original Electro-mechanical table, designed by jpsalas in 2015. It is based on "Surfer" from Gottlieb in 1976 and inspired by Papa Smurf, one of the protagonists from the comic strip The Smurfs.
games.name: Papa Smurf

games.description: Paradise is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine. Set against a vibrant Hawaiian theme, it features a mechanical backglass animation of a hula girl that sways when certain targets are hit. Gameplay includes two flippers, four pop bumpers, two slingshots, five standup targets, and four kick-out holes. About 2,100 units were produced. Pleasure Isle is the add-a-ball variant of this game.
games.name: Paradise

games.description: In Bally's Paragon take your hand at taming the beast (watch out for his dangerous lair), visiting the Valley of Demons, traversing waterfalls, and going for the elusive super bonus. Fast, often brutal, and a true player's game.nnnn'Paragon' is the first widebody production game from this manufacturer.
games.name: Paragon

games.description: The Party Zone is a pinball table designed by Dennis Nordman, with artwork by Greg Freres and music and sound effects by Dan Forden. The Party Zone is centered on an interdimensional party under the watchful eyes of the wildly enigmatic Captain B. Zarr. Win the Door Prize, enter the Dance Contest with the Dancing Dummy, shoot the Rocket Ramp for the Ozone Bonus, and make sure to Eat, Drink, & B. Merry. Start up the Super Sonic Robotic Comic for a Laff Attack, and don't hesitate to Make a Request from the DJ. After all that, get the Party Animals, Party Monsters, and Party Dudes into the Cosmic Cottage, then start Happy Hour Multiball and try to collect enough Rock-It Fuel for the Big Bang jackpot — or get booted into the End Zone and out of the Party.
games.name: Party Zone

games.description: The Party Zone is a pinball table designed by Dennis Nordman, with artwork by Greg Freres and music and sound effects by Dan Forden. The Party Zone is centered on an interdimensional party under the watchful eyes of the wildly enigmatic Captain B. Zarr. Win the Door Prize, enter the Dance Contest with the Dancing Dummy, shoot the Rocket Ramp for the Ozone Bonus, and make sure to Eat, Drink, & B. Merry. Start up the Super Sonic Robotic Comic for a Laff Attack, and don't hesitate to Make a Request from the DJ. After all that, get the Party Animals, Party Monsters, and Party Dudes into the Cosmic Cottage, then start Happy Hour Multiball and try to collect enough Rock-It Fuel for the Big Bang jackpot — or get booted into the End Zone and out of the Party.
games.name: Party Zone

games.description:
"Pat Hand" and "Satin Doll" are two related electro-mechanical pinball machines released by Williams in 1975. "Pat Hand," is a four-player machine that features three flippers, two pop bumpers, and multiple rollovers and targets. It had a production run of 6,500 units, making it a popular game of its time. 

"Satin Doll" is the two-player version of "Pat Hand," sharing a similar playfield design but with four flippers and a slightly different scoring setup.
games.name: Pat Hand

games.description:
Paul Bunyan, produced by Gottlieb in 1968, is two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine featuring a Fantasy - Myth and Legend theme. Paul Bunyan is a giant lumberjack and folk hero in American and Canadian folklore.

The Italian version is Gottlieb's 1968 'Big Jack'.
games.name: Paul Bunyan

games.description: Original table, designed in 2021. Inspired by Peaky Blinders, a British period crime drama television series created by Steven Knight on 2013. Set in Birmingham, it follows the exploits of the Peaky Blinders crime gang in the direct aftermath of the First World War.
games.name: Peaky Blinders

games.description: Original table, designed in 2017. It is based on "Harlem Globetrotters On Tour" from Bally in 1979. Penthouse is a men's magazine combines urban lifestyle articles and softcore pornographic pictures of women that, in the 1990s, evolved into hardcore pornographic pictures of women.
games.name: Penthouse

games.description: Notable Features :nn- Two target banks left and right of the playfield disappear when hit by the ball, tus collecting points and changing the conditions of the game.nn- Two balls on the ramp and three upper rollovers allow extra balls, double bonusses and 50.000 points.nn- One lower rollover to obtain a special, according to the give combination.nn- Two rollovers, left and right, score and retain the ball in order to send it up to the corresponding flippers.nn- Two bumpers and two kickers of great efficiency keep the ball in constant movement aroung the playfieldnn- Each bonus obtained during the game scores doubles or triples at the end of each ball
games.name: Petaco

games.id: Phantom Of The Opera, The (Data East 1990)(1.25)
games.description: The Phantom of the Opera is a 1990 Physical Pinball Table released by Data East. It was designed by Ed Cebula and Joe Kaminkow, with artwork by Paul Faris. Though released during the Broadway musical's runaway success, the game is not based from it. It is instead based on the original 1911 novel by Gaston Leroux. As the Phantom, scurry across the Catwalk, walk behind the Magic Mirror, then arise from the Trap Door behind the stage. Choose between the Scorpion and the Grasshopper, play the Organ and activate its secret passage, then start the three-ball multiball and steel yourself against the sight of the Phantom's disfigured face.
games.name: Phantom Of The Opera, The

games.description: Decades, centuries, ages have passed like a whisper in the wind, sifting through the sands of time. With quiet strength, the Pharaoh's tomb has stood in solemn testimony to the mighty ruler of Egypt. A spectre haunts this monument, protector of the treasures within and of the soul of the Pharaoh. his voice defies, taunts, dares 20th century man to penetrate the age-old mysteries buried deep within the tomb of the Pharaoh!
games.name: Pharaoh

games.description: Original table, designed in 2019. It is based on "Pharaoh" from Williams in 1981. This table is more sinister version.
games.name: Pharaoh - Dead Rise

games.description: Phase II, produced by J. Esteban in 1975, is a 4 players electro-mechanical pinball machine featuring a Mystic theme. This table is a clone of the Gottlieb's 1975 'Spirit of 76'.
games.name: Phase 2

games.description: Phil Collins is a original, music-themed pinball experience, inspired by the world of the legendary musician. The table features stunning visuals, dynamic lighting, and a rich soundtrack filled with Phil Collins' greatest hits. With multiple shot paths and strategic gameplay, it offers an engaging and polished homage for both pinball and music fans.
games.name: Phil Collins

games.description:
Table with a bowling theme, featuring 10 drop targets. Players score by knocking down the lit target, which changes through rollovers on the playfield, the machine is a classic electro-mechanical game with four flippers, emphasizing skillful aiming and target strategy.

The replay version of this game is Gottlieb's 1973 'King Pin'. The Add-a-ball version for export to Italy is Gottlieb's 1973 'Ten-Up'.
games.name: Pin Up

games.description: Pinball Action is an early video-pinball arcade game released by Tehkan in 1985. Players can control two flippers and launch balls via a plunger, playing solo or with one other. The game features a central playfield that unlocks three themed bonus screens - bowling, poker, and slot machine - each offering unique challenges and extra-ball rewards. Players can also "shake" the table to influence ball movement. This classic blends straightforward pinball mechanics with diverse mini-game objectives, making it a standout in early arcade pinball.
games.name: Pinball Action

games.description: Zaccaria's first multi-level game, with two playfields. Four flippers (two on the main playfield, two on the upper transparent playfield). Timed "bonus ball". Elevated ball shooter lane. An audio jack located on the cabinet front underneath the ball shooter allows listening to the game via headphones.
games.name: Pinball Champ '82

games.description: Pinball Lizard is a solid-state pinball machine that stands out for its unique fantasy theme. The game features two flippers, two pop bumpers, and multiple drop target banks.
games.name: Pinball Lizard

games.description: After being banned from the real world, famous magician Matra Magna and her Society of Masters take over a pinball machine and challenge players to complete their tricks.
games.name: Pinball Magic

games.description: Pinball Pool is a classic game of pinball skill. Featuring Gottlieb's innovative “Remotrip” drop targets, this pool themed pinball would make a fantastic addition to any games room.
games.name: Pinball Pool

games.description: Original table, designed in 2021. This is a tribute to Pink Floyd, an English rock band formed in London in 1965. Gaining an early following as one of the first British psychedelic groups, they were distinguished by their extended compositions, sonic experiments, philosophical lyrics, and elaborate live performances, and became a leading progressive rock band.
games.name: Pink Floyd - The Wall

games.description: Pink Panther is a pinball game based on the popular comedy film series and cartoon character. It was designed by John Buras, illustrated by Jerry Simkus, and released by Gottlieb in 1981. The game's premise is a very loose adaptation of The Return of the Pink Panther; the Panther is pursuing an attractive female jewel thief through a dimly-lit mansion as she pilfers its collection of gems. Get the black diamonds to enable the Secret Passage, then light the flashlight and enter the Hidden Staircase. Lock two pinballs to explore them, then start three-ball multiball for a frantic chase to collect the blue diamonds scattered around the playfield. Players who can collect the most diamonds are rewarded with a free game. Pink Panther is noteworthy for being Gottlieb's first multi-ball pinball game.
games.name: Pink Panther

games.id: Pinvention's Night of the Living Dead (Original 2021)(1.0.0)
games.description: Pinvention's Night of the Living Dead is a fan-made virtual pinball table that reimagines the 1977 Gottlieb Super Spin as a tribute to George A. Romero's iconic 1968 zombie film. The table features a dark, atmospheric playfield and backglass, capturing the film's haunting black-and-white aesthetic. Gameplay includes unique elements like animated rain and lightning effects, enhancing the eerie ambiance. This table is a standout example of creative modding in the pinball community, offering a chilling and immersive experience for fans of both pinball and classic horror cinema.
games.name: Pinvention's Night of the Living Dead

games.description: A patriotic-themed electro-mechanical game. Celebrating the American Bicentennial, it features a striking red, white, and blue color scheme.nnnnThe 4-player version of this game is Gottlieb's 1975 'Spirit of 76'. A special 2-player Add-a-ball version, Gottlieb's 1976 'New York'.
games.name: Pioneer

games.description: A single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine. The game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two kick-out holes, and a distinctive horseshoe lane. The artwork showcases a pirate theme.
games.name: Pirate Gold

games.description: Pirates of the Caribbean is an arcade pinball game designed by Dennis Nordman and illustrated by Kevin O'Connor. It was released in 2006 by Stern Pinball, coinciding with the release of the second Pirates of the Caribbean movie, Dead Man's Chest. The game puts the player in the boots of Captain Jack Sparrow as he stumbles through various misadventures. Engage in sword fights, fire on Port Royal, collect your pirates, then play Liar's Dice and assemble a crew of 100 souls. Prove your mettle by shooting the pirate ship on the playfield and sinking it, then Fight Davy Jones, Destroy the Kraken, and use the Key to open the Dead Man's Chest. Along the way, you'll Catch the Wind and collect various bits of Treasure, but only the Pirate King will be able to complete the eight tasks and four points of the Compass to invoke Four Winds Multiball and come out on top of the Gauntlet of Pirates.
games.name: Pirates Of The Caribbean

games.description: Pistol Poker is a solid-state pinball machine with a unique Western and gambling theme. It combines traditional pinball mechanics with elements of poker, where players aim to create the best poker hand using the backglass display. It features three flippers, a ramp, and multiball functionality.
games.name: Pistol Poker

games.description:
Pit Stop is an electro-mechanical pinball machine with a car racing theme, this two-player game features a unique lap-scoring system where players accumulate laps using separate two-reel displays.

Maximum displayed point score is 9,999 points per player, and maximum displayed lap score is 99 laps per player.
games.name: Pit Stop

games.description: Original table, designed in 2021. It is based on "Solar Fire" from Williams in 1981. This game is a tribute to the first movie Planet of the Apes released in 1968.
games.name: Planet of the Apes

games.description:
This is an electro-mechanical game features a billiards theme, challenging players with two sets of seven drop targets that represent the solids and stripes in pool, along with a critical eight ball target.

This table is a version of Gottlieb's 1973 'Pro Pool' made for export to Italy.
games.name: Play Pool

games.description: In 1978, Bally released the first Playboy pinball machine. According to Pinside, this particular pinball has a production run of 18.250, making it the #4 most successful Flipper-Game of all time. The start-up and bonus score countdown music for the Playboy pinball machine is similar to the “Playboy's Theme” from the 1969 “Playboy After Dark” television show. This game's artwork was created by Paul Faris and the backglass features an illustration of Hugh Hefner with Playmates Patti McGuire and Sondra Theodore. Special Features on the Flyer: 5 Playboy Keys They open the door to specials, bonuses and giant Grotto scores. New Playmate Targets Hit all 5 and win specials, bonus advances, extra balls, games. Action Drop Targets Key to 25,000 outlane score when all are down. New Playboy Grotto Unique kickback lane advances bonus up to 30,000 depending on the number of Keys lit.
