This is a tribute to "Star Wars: The Bad Batch",  an American 3D animated television series created by Dave Filoni for the streaming service Disney+. It is part of the Star Wars franchise and a spin-off from Star Wars: The Clone Wars, continuing from the end of that series to depict the aftermath of Order 66 and the end of the Clone Wars.
games.name: Star Wars: The Bad Batch

games.id: Star Wars - The Empire Strikes Back (Hankin 1980)(1.4)
games.description: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back is a Pinball Table exclusively in Australia, and is believed to be the very first Star Wars licensed pinball game ever. The game depicts several key scenes from the movie, with particular focus on the Imperial assault on Hoth. Guide the Snowspeeders against the AT-ATs looming overhead, hit the Rebel insignias to increase the value of playfield targets, then shoot down the four TIE Fighter rollovers to increase the bonus multiplier. Hit the Darth Vader drop targets on the two sides of the playfield to raise the value for Dagobah and Bespin, then visit Yoda and Lando to claim the points.
games.name: Star Wars - The Empire Strikes Back

games.description: Original table, designed in 2021. It is based on Alien Poker from Williams in 1980. This is a triubte to the sage Star Wars
games.name: Star Wars - Tribute

games.description: Created in 2023, this original table pays tribute to the Star Wars universe through a dual inspiration. Its structure is based on the emblematic pinball machine Star Wars – The Empire Strikes Back designed by Hankin in 1980, while its visual theme draws from Star Wars Episode I, the futuristic pinball machine released by Williams in 1999. A bold blend of retro nostalgia and galactic modernity, offering a one-of-a-kind interstellar adventure.
games.name: Star Wars Episode 1

games.description: Inspired by the original Star Wars trilogy, this Pinball reimagines the classic saga in a fast, retro style. Players battle through iconic space and ground combat—deflecting TIE fighters, destroying Imperial wall targets, and powering up the Death Star trench run. With nostalgic 8-bit Star Wars music, crisp artwork by BorgDog, and enhanced spinner and sound effects, it offers a solid-state pinball feel infused with galactic charm.
games.name: Star Wars Redux

games.description: Star Wars Trilogy is an action-packed pinball machine that captures the excitement of the original Star Wars trilogy. Featuring iconic characters, fast-paced gameplay, and memorable scenes from Episodes IV to VI, it delivers a thrilling experience for fans and pinball enthusiasts alike.
games.name: Star Wars Trilogy

games.description: Stars is notable for its engaging and straightforward gameplay, this machine offers players a mix of drop targets and spinners, each increasing in value as targets are hit. Its space-themed playfield requires players to hit five star targets to activate a special mode, enhancing the game's strategic depth. Despite its simplicity compared to modern pinball machines, "Stars" is celebrated for its fast-paced action and skillful shot requirements.
games.name: Stars

games.description: While Starship Troopers might not be top tier 90s Sega, its pretty darn close. Great theme integration and some fun toys and mechs like the Brain Bug bash toy popup. Plays fast but can get a little grindy at times, and there isn't a ton of depth. If you enjoyed the movie Starship Troopers, you'll probably enjoy having this game in your collection for at least a short stint, if not longer.
games.name: Starship Troopers

games.description: "Straight Flush" and "3 Jokers" are two card-themed pinball machines. Straight Flush is the replay version, while 3 Jokers is the add-a-ball variant. Both machines feature a classic card game motif, making them popular among fans of pinball and card-based themes.
games.name: Straight Flush

games.description: Strange World is an electro-mechanical game features a distinctive outer space and fantasy theme, which includes artwork that depicts a surreal and colorful otherworldly landscape.
games.name: Strange World

games.description: Battle your way through Hawkins in this fast-paced pinball adventure! Shoot ramps to unlock episodes, hit drop targets to fend off Demogorgons, and activate Eleven's telekinetic multiball. With interactive toys, custom animations, and deep mission-based gameplay, every flip pulls you deeper into the Upside Down.
games.name: Stranger Things - Stranger Edition

games.description: Stranger Things 4 is an original fan-made pinball table inspired by Season 4 of the hit series, built on the layout of "Stranger Things - Stranger Edition". Join Eleven and the Hellfire Club as they battle Vecna across iconic storylines from the show. Packed with intense modes, multiballs, and immersive audiovisuals, the table plunges you into the heart of Hawkins—where every flip brings you closer to saving your friends from the Upside Down.
games.name: Stranger Things 4

games.description: Strato-Flite features an outer space theme, prominently displaying a 1960s military jet against a starry background on the backglass. The 2-player version of this game is Williams' 1974 'Super-Flite'.
games.name: Strato-Flite

games.description: Street Fighter II is an arcade pinball machine released by Gottlieb in 1993, a Pinball Spin-Off of the video fighting game. It was designed by Ray Tanzer and Jon Norris, with art by David Moore and Constantino and Jeanine Mitchell. The Street Fighter II pinball casts the player as a new challenger in the tournament, who must defeat each of the twelve opponents by making the appropriate shot when that opponent's light is lit. Along the way are various ancillary challenges, such as fighting off ninja attacks, participating in several multiball modes, and crunching the sports car beneath the playfield. Defeat all twelve fighters, and you will enter the Champion Challenge — if you can defeat all of the fighters again, you will be recognized as the new Master (along with numerous points and bonuses).
games.name: Street Fighter 2

games.description: Rack up the strikes in this shuffle alley game from Williams! A thrilling mix of bowling and arcade action, Strike Master features spectacular light effects, fast-paced gameplay, and dynamic digital animations with every shot. Perfect for retro vibes and friendly competition!
games.name: Strike Master

games.description: Striker features a unique layout with six flippers and a wide-body cabinet design. It includes 14 drop targets, four slingshots, and two spinners, offering a dynamic gameplay experience. Despite being released during a challenging time for pinball manufacturers, 910 units were produced. The game is known for its creative design and distinctive sound effects, including speech and cheering crowds.
games.name: Striker

games.description: Striker Xtreme combines the excitement of soccer with the engaging mechanics of pinball. The game challenges players to defeat various countries in a simulated soccer tournament. Machine put back into production with a football theme as Stern's 2001 'NFL'.
games.name: Striker Xtreme

games.description: Strikes N' Spares brings bowling to the pinball world with fast-paced, casual gameplay. Players compete in a full 10-frame game, using 1 or 2 balls per frame just like real bowling. The machine features two DMD displays: the upper one tracks frame and game progress, while the lower provides play information. Designed as a novelty game, it offers simplified rules, humorous callouts, and a single flipper layout, perfect for quick fun and lighthearted competition.
games.name: Strikes N' Spares

games.description: Strikes N' Spares brings bowling to the pinball world with fast-paced, casual gameplay. Players compete in a full 10-frame game, using 1 or 2 balls per frame just like real bowling. The machine features two DMD displays: the upper one tracks frame and game progress, while the lower provides play information. Designed as a novelty game, it offers simplified rules, humorous callouts, and a single flipper layout, perfect for quick fun and lighthearted competition.
games.name: Strikes N' Spares

games.description: Set in a lively Bavarian beer garden, Student Prince captures the carefree spirit of student life. Players toast to high scores with steins and spinners, navigating a festive playfield inspired by traditional German folklore. With its bright artwork and playful theme, this electro-mechanical classic offers nostalgic charm and light-hearted fun.
games.name: Student Prince

games.description: Sultan transports players into a world of Arabian legends and adventure. A rare Brazilian re-theme of Gottlieb's 1978 Sinbad, it features exotic new artwork while retaining the original's dynamic gameplay. With vivid visuals and a playfield full of action, Sultan offers a magical twist on a classic pinball experience.
games.name: Sultan

games.description: Summer Time is a beach‑themed, timed-play electromechanical pinball with two flippers, three pop bumpers, ten stand-up targets, and a kick-out hole, it challenges you to add time—rather than score points—by hitting target sets and shooting the clock saucer. A novelty variant of the Williasm's Travel Time, it lets you keep playing as long as the clock runs—no replay, just endless fun until time runs out.
games.name: Summer Time

games.description: Original table, designed in 2022. This is a RE-SKIN of the jpsalas Table "Serious Sam 2". This is a tribute to Sunset Riders, a side-scrolling run and gun video game developed and released by Konami as an arcade video game in 1991, it is set in the American Old West.
games.name: Sunset Riders Pinball

games.description: Super Bowl brings the excitement of American football to the pinball arena. This Italian-made machine is a conversion of Bally Midway's 1984 X's & O's, featuring new artwork and a sports-themed makeover. With fast-paced gameplay and goal-oriented targets, Super Bowl delivers a unique twist on classic pinball action.
games.name: Super Bowl

games.description: Super Mario Bros. Mushroom World is a Pinball Table based on the popular video game franchise, designed by Ray Tanzer and released by Gottlieb in 1992. Unlike Gottlieb's earlier Super Mario Bros. pinball, Mushroom World is expressly designed for younger players. The playfield cabinet is not as long as a conventional pinball machine, and the game could be equipped with shorter legs to lower its height. Operators could set the game to one of two difficulty modes, and it could be configured to reward redemption tickets. The game itself is a simplified version of Super Mario Bros. 3. Mario must travel through seven lands of Mushroom World and clear each one. Doing so opens up the eighth world, Dark Land, with lots of opportunities for players to score points (or tickets). Powerups provide Mario with fire, frog, and raccoon powers, while the Warp Whistle opens a ramp for hidden secrets.
games.name: Super Mario Bros. Mushroom World

games.description: Super Nova is a solid-state pinball machine with a space exploration theme, the game includes two flippers, three pop bumpers, and a unique "Space Lab" feature. This game was used in qualifying at the 1980 US Open Pinball tournament at the Hartford Civic Center in Hartford.
games.name: Super Nova

games.description: Super Orbit is a streamlined, space-themed solid-state pinball machine. It features two flippers, three pop bumpers, a spinner, spinning and vari-target shots, and rewards skillful orbit loops and bonus collection through the upper-right gate. It shares the same playfield layout as the EM games Orbit (1971) and Outer Space (1972), and is possibly the first Gottlieb game to produce a sound effect by pressing the flipper buttons during attract mode.
games.name: Super Orbit

games.description: Super Score and Hi-Score, both released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1967, are electro-mechanical pinball machines. Hi-Score is the 4-player version, while Super Score is a 2-player variant. Maximum displayed point score is 9,999 points per player.
games.name: Super Score

games.description: This electro-mechanical game features a soccer theme, the 2-player version of this game is Gottlieb's 1975 'Soccer'. The same cabinet artwork but in a different color can be found on Gottlieb's 1977 'Team One' and Gottlieb's 1977 'Kicker'.
games.name: Super Soccer

games.description: Super Spin features a distinctive spinning target and a variety of scoring opportunities through drop targets, bumpers, and rollovers. The 4-Player version is Gottlieb's 1977 'Jet Spin'. Convertible to Add-A-Ball.
games.name: Super Spin

games.description: Super Star and Olympics are electro-mechanical pinball machines released by Chicago Coin. Both games share a sports theme, with "Super Star" accommodating up to four players and "Olympics" designed for two players. The playfields feature two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, two standup targets, and two spinning targets.
games.name: Super Star (Chicago Coin)

games.description:
SUPER STRAIGHT - a new 4 player

With the following features:nn- Making 2 ACES lites DOUBLE BONUS lanes.
- Making 2 KINGS opens GATE.
- Making 1 QUEEN lites rollovers for 1000 points.
- Making 2 JACKS lites COLLECT BONUS eject hole.
- Making 2 TENS lites side BUMPERS for 1000 points.
- Making a STRAIGHT lites "EXTRA BALL".
- Making a STRAIGHT FLUSH lites "SPECIAL"lanes alernately.
games.name: Super Straight

games.description: Super-Flite features an outer space theme, prominently displaying a 1960s military jet against a starry background on the backglass. The 4-player version of this game is Williams' 1974 'Strato-Flite'.
games.name: Super-Flite

games.description:
Superman is an arcade pinball game designed by Steve Ritchie, with artwork by George Opperman and programmed by Eugene Jarvis. It was released by Atari in 1979.
As with other Pinball games of The '70s, Superman has a series of objectives but no overarching plot or goal beyond a high score. Light the top rollovers to raise the bonus multiplier, then hit the Metropolis dropdown targets to enable various bonuses. Shoot through the Fortress of Solitude or Luthor's Lair to return to the top of the board, and spell SUPERMAN to get extra points and light the Special.
games.name: Superman

games.description: Superman and The Justice League is an original virtuel pinball table where you join Superman on a mission to rebuild the Justice League. Complete 12 core missions, 3 boss battles, and 3 bonus quests while unlocking 4 multiball modes. The table features music and voiceovers from Superman films/series, immersive lighting, multiple jackpots, extra balls, and magnet controls for a cinematic pinball experience.
games.name: Superman and The Justice League

games.description: Supersonic celebrates the era of supersonic air travel, prominently featuring the Concorde on its backglass and playfield, this solid-state machine includes two flippers, three pop bumpers, five drop targets, and a spinner, among other elements. The playfield is identical in design to Bally's 1976 'Star Ship'.
games.name: Supersonic

games.description: This is the last game made with a half-moon credit window. The Add-a-ball version of this game is Gottlieb's 1976 'Bank Shot' which was exported to Italy as Gottlieb's 1976 'Spot Pool'.
games.name: Sure Shot

games.description: Surf Champ features a vibrant surfing theme. This electro-mechanical machine is notable for its wide release, with over 10,000 units produced. The 2-player version of this game is Gottlieb's 1976 'Surfer'.
games.name: Surf Champ

games.description: This 2-player electro-mechanical pinball machine, produced in 1,750 units, features four flippers, three pop bumpers, and two roto-targets. Players advance multipliers and earn bonuses by hitting standup targets. Alongside Gottlieb's 1967 Sea Side, it was among the first to feature illuminated coin entrance plates.
games.name: Surf Side

games.description: Surfer features a vibrant surfing theme. This electro-mechanical machine is notable for its wide release, with over 10,000 units produced. The 4-player version of this game is Gottlieb's 1976 'Surf Champ'.
games.name: Surfer

games.description: Swamp Thing plunges you into a moody Louisiana bayou via a reskinned table built on the jpsalas's layout "Serious Sam 2". Face off against swamp monsters, trigger fog, hear moody audio and vocal callouts, and dive into multi-stage “battle” modes in the glowing swamp—complete with VR support and immersive lighting effects.
games.name: Swamp Thing

games.description: Swashbuckler by Recel S.A. is a Spanish-made electro-mechanical pinball machine with a pirate adventure theme. Released in the late 1970s, it features classic gameplay elements like bumpers, slingshots, and targets, all set against a colorful high-seas backdrop.
games.name: Swashbuckler

games.description: Sweet Hearts is a one-player electro-mechanical pinball machine with a playing card theme, it includes two flippers, five pop bumpers, two slingshots, and the last Gottlieb-designed gobble hole a feature that awards replays but ends the ball when used.
games.name: Sweet Hearts

games.description: Sweet Sioux is a four-player electro-mechanical pinball machine, the game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, two gobble holes, two bullseye targets, two standup targets, and a roto-target. The backglass carries Gottlieb's famous phrase: Amusement Pinballs, as American as Baseball and Hot Dogs!
games.name: Sweet Sioux

games.description: Swing-Along is a 1963 electro-mechanical pinball machine by Gottlieb, themed around a fun and lively dance party. This single-player game features colorful artwork, animated backglass elements, and classic gameplay with bumpers, slingshots, and rollovers. Its playful theme and charming design capture the spirit of the early '60s.
games.name: Swing-Along

games.description:
Swords of Fury is a thrilling, non-stop adventure through the mysterious Ogres Alley, a Titan Tunnel and Magical Arena of play that's a cut above the rest. A fantastic world of heroes and villains, of scary creatures and bold lions where the player must seek to free the Titans. Multiball play doubles or triples the scoring and lights a roving lamp in the magic drop target mini-playfield arena for a progressive jackpot that can reward 4 million points. The Lionman Bonus center ramp directs play from 100k points to 1 million points. Spelling AVENGER by hitting the targets and the double spinner horseshoe shots trigger specials as well.
Trivia : The left outlane insert shows the misspelled word "sheild". We don't know if this was corrected at any time during the production run.
games.name: Swords Of Fury

games.description: T.K.O. was the last single-player electro-mechanical (EM) wedgehead game produced by the company, this boxing-themed game features three pop bumpers, two kick-out holes, and two 3-inch flippers.nnnnMaximum displayed point score is 199,990 points.
games.name: T.K.O.

games.description: Tag-Team Pinball is featuring a wrestling theme. The game has three flippers, no ramps, and a three-ball multiball mode, it is part of the Gottlieb System 80B series, with a production run of 1,220 units.
games.name: Tag-Team Pinball

games.description:
Similar to its namesakes, the Crypt game is centered on twelve frightful "Creature Features". As the cabinet shakes with the souls of previous players, Crack some Skulls, rob the Crypt, dodge the Guillotines, then try to select a Door Prize (but avoid the hangman!). Hit the Keeper's eyeballs, pound on the Tombstone, then confront the Werewolf and Play the Organ. Complete all twelve Features, then sit in the Electric Chair and fire it up for the Crypt Jam — all while the Crypt Keeper cackles away with his nonstop barrage of horror(-ble) puns...
Although some found the theme a bit lowbrow (true to its inspiration), Tales of the Crypt is widely regarded as one of Data East Pinball's best pins ever, a fast and balanced game with a lot of variety and challenge for expert players. Complaints against this pinball tend to focus on either the art, the theme, or the Crypt Keeper's annoying cackle, though admittedly they're all part of the license. The table itself even made a cameo in the episode "Oil's Well That Ends Well" where the Crypt Keeper played it in the opening.
games.name: Tales From The Crypt

games.description: In Tales of the Arabian Nights, you are trying to complete the 7 different Tales of the Arabian Nights. You also have to battle an evil genie, which makes for a fun bash toy at the center of the table. From a rules and layout perspective, it is very similar to other games from this period by Popadiuk, like Cirqus Voltaire and Theatre of Magic. Strong theme immersion, fun flowy shots, and pretty approachable for most beginners.
games.name: Tales Of The Arabian Nights

games.description: Target Alpha is a four-player reimagining of Gottlieb's classic one-player wedgehead El Dorado. Contrary to El Dorado's old west theme, Target Alpha features a science fiction theme complete with flying machines, laser guns and space helmets. A few features are stripped away from the original El Dorado ruleset, and a few are added to compliment the multi-player operation. The game features fifteen drop targets, including a massive row of ten that runs across the top of the playfield. Gottlieb also released Solar City, the same design with new art and two player operation, the same year.
games.name: Target Alpha

games.description: Target Pool and Mini Pool are electro-mechanical pinball machines with billiard themes. Target Pool is a replay-type machine with 27 standup targets and one pop bumper, while Mini Pool is an add-a-ball version with similar gameplay.
games.name: Target Pool

games.description: Taxi is Williams' first game to display 4-player scores using only two alpha-numeric 16-character displays. Compared to other Pinball games of the time, Taxi is deceptively simple. As a taxi driver, pick up a crazy cast of characters — including former Soviet Leader Mikhail Gorbachev (Gorbie), Dracula, and Santa Claus — then take them to the airport and collect the jackpot. The longer you play, the more tips you'll put on the meter, so take the Express Lane and loop the airport for an even bigger score. The first games in production were made with a blonde 'Marilyn' taxi passenger as well, a likeness of Marilyn Monroe. This was changed during production to be a darker-haired 'Lola', ostensibly a likeness of no one famous. Designed by Mark Ritchie with art by Python Anghelo.
games.name: Taxi

games.description: A school-themed pinball. The rules are simple. Lite all letters in name (Spell "Teacher's Pet) and drop the targets Score Special. Roll-over lanes 1, 2 and 3, when made, open Free Ball Gate. Remains open until made, even game to game. Three roll-over buttons raise drop targets for additional score.
games.name: Teacher's Pet

games.description: Team One features a magic and sorcery theme and includes two flippers, five pop bumpers, ten drop targets, and a unique center target mechanism that increases bonus value. The replay version of this game is Gottlieb's 1975 'Abra Ca Dabra' but with different artwork. The Add-a-ball version for export to Italy is Gottlieb's 1977 'Kicker'.
games.name: Team One

games.description:
Taking place on a tropical island, Tee'd Off casts the player as a golfer spending a day on the links. However, he's badgered by Gunther Gopher, who's out to enjoy himself by distracting the player with a barrage of dances, taunts, and insults. Go through 36 holes around the island and beneath the volcano, Slice through the coconut trees, Hook around the Dog Leg, then try for a Hole-In-One up the center lane. For more points, play the Skins Game, try for the Pitch 'n Putt, and peek into a hole and try to Find the Gopher. Spin the Gopher Wheel to build up the Go-Fore-Par-Tee, then celebrate after nine holes with some Multiball or a Lightning Storm scoring frenzy.
Designed by Ray Tanzer and Jon Norris with artwork by Constantino, Jeanine Mitchell and David Moore.
games.name: Tee'd Off

games.description:
Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles is a 1991 pinball machine based off the multi-media franchise of the same name (more specifically the 80's cartoon), made by Data East. It was designed by Ed Cebula and Joe Kaminkow, with artwork by Kevin O'Connor and Paul Faris.
It has a number of somewhat interesting features, such as a spinning pizza ala Whirlwind, two prominent ramps, and a sewer shot that caused the ball to momentarily disappear under the playfield.
games.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

games.description: Ten Stars is an electro-mechanical pinball machine with a space exploration theme. The game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, four drop targets, three standup targets, and a kick-out hole.
games.name: Ten Stars

games.description: This is a 2003  Benchmark Games Inc. Ten Strike Classic mannequin bowling game. You aim the mannequin bowler man with flipper keys and pull back and throw the ball with the plunger.nnnnReproduction of the original Williams 1958 'Ten Strike' bowler game.
games.name: Ten Strike Classic

games.description: The Terminator 2 : Judgement Day pinball was developed from the famous sci-fi Terminator movie and designed by Steve Ritchie. It's also one of the first Williams to make use of a DMD and the first to feature a video mode. Unsurprisingly, the game rode the movie's popularity to become the best-selling pinball machine of 1991 by a landslide. Instead of trying to replicate the plot of the film, the pinball instead opts to recreate the emotional highlights with a whirlwind of nonstop action. Shoot the two Cyberdyne ramps to raise the Security Levels, repeatedly hit the Chase Loop for progressive bonuses, then fire the ball over the left loop and Escape into the saucer to collect more rewards. Hit the dropdown target below the T-800's skull, then load the swinging cannon and shoot the HK-Aerial across the playfield to start multiball. But to score the Super Jackpot among all the chaos will require the cool demeanor of a robot... It also eschews the traditional plunger for an automatic plunger (in the form of a gun), and features a ball-firing cannon on the right side of the playfield.
games.name: Terminator 2 - Judgment Day

games.description: Terminator 3: Rise of the Machines is themed around the movie of the same name. The game features a variety of exciting elements including a Rocket Propelled Grenade launcher in the backglass, three all-steel ramps, and a unique backbox animation where a cannon shoots balls at targets​.
games.name: Terminator 3 - Rise of the Machines

games.description: Original table, designed in 2018. This is a RE-SKIN of the jpsalas Table Serious Sam 2. This is a tribute to Terminator Salvation, a 2009 American military science fiction action film that is the fourth installment of the Terminator franchise, serving as a sequel to Terminator 3: Rise of the Machines (2003). It is directed by McG. It is the only Terminator film to date not to feature Arnold Schwarzenegger
games.name: Terminator Salvation

games.description: Terrific Lake pinball machine, produced by Spanish manufacturer Sportmatic in December 1986, is a solid-state, four-player game featuring a horror theme. The playfield is equipped with two flippers, three pop bumpers, and three drop targets.
games.name: Terrific Lake

games.description: Table feature a Wild West law enforcement theme. This is the italian export version of the 2-player Gottlieb's 1971 'Lawman' and the 4-player Gottlieb's 1971 'Sheriff'. A single-player Spanish version is Maresa's 1972 'Dakota'.
games.name: Texas Ranger

games.description: The game features a four flipper layout including numerous Lawlor staples, such as the shot through the bumpers, and the upper-flipper ramp shot. The game has many uniquely notable features including an animatronic hand with a built in magnet that will grab and lock pinballs for multiball, as well as a computer controlled mini flipper that, using artificial intelligence programming, learns to shoot a tricky cross-playfield shot with remarkable consistency. This game is also frequently credited with popularizing the "wizard mode" (despite not being the first game to have one). A true success for Bally/Williams, Addams Family holds an important place in pinball history, and well deserves its sought after status.
games.name: Addams Family, The

games.description: The game features a four flipper layout including numerous Lawlor staples, such as the shot through the bumpers, and the upper-flipper ramp shot. games.description: Original table, designed by jpsalas in 2022. It is Re-skin of "Spider-Man" from Stern in 2007.
games.name: Amazing Spider-Man Classic Edition, The

games.description: Original table, designed in 2021. This is a RE-SKIN of the jpsalas Table Black Pyramide. This is a tribute to "The BeastMaster". a 1982 American-West German sword and sorcery film directed by Don Coscarelli and starring Marc Singer, Tanya Roberts, John Amos and Rip Torn. The film is about a man who can communicate with animals, and who fights an evil wizard and his army.
games.name: BeastMaster, The

games.description: Original table, designed 2023. It is based on "Seawitch" from Stern in 1980. This is a triubte to "The Blues Brothers", a 1980 American musical action comedy film directed by John Landis. It stars John Belushi as "Joliet" Jake Blues and Dan Aykroyd as his brother Elwood, characters developed from the recurring musical sketch "The Blues Brothers" on NBC's variety series Saturday Night Live.
games.name: Blues Brothers, The

games.description: Original table, designed in 2020. It is based on "Roman Victory" from Taito do Brasil in 1984. This a tribute to "The Conjuring", a 2013 American supernatural horror film directed by James Wan. It is the inaugural film in The Conjuring Universe franchise.
games.name: Conjuring, The

games.description: Original table, designed in 2023. This is a tribute to The Exorcist, a 1973 American supernatural horror film directed by William Friedkin. The film stars Ellen Burstyn, Max von Sydow, Jason Miller, and Linda Blair, and follows the demonic possession of a young girl and the attempt to rescue her through an exorcism by two Catholic priests.
games.name: Exorcist, The

games.description: n 1994, Williams released pinball machine based on the live-action theatrical film adaptation of The Flintstones. This game also featured speech provided by John Goodman, Rick Moranis and Harvey Korman reprising their respective roles, as well the theme song from the television series. This game had a unique feature called smart ramps, this allowed the game to decide which flipper to feed the ball two through a plastic loop at the bottom. When the game is first started, the player is greeted with a skill shot. The skill shot on the machine is the light up the correct light in the "DIG" rollovers at the top of the playfield in which the ball will fall through by using the flippers to move the one lit light back and forth. A few extra million points are awarded when the skill shot is achieved and this amount goes up the more times it is attained.
games.name: Flintstones, The

games.description:
The Incredible Hulk pinball is one of the first to feature a licensed theme from Marvel Comics. Design credit goes to the visionary Ed Krynski, whith artwork by Gordon Morison. The machine was initially titled "Valkyrie" before adopting the Hulk theme, reflecting the evolving creative process behind its development.
As for the gameplay, players can activate the spinning target for bonus points, adding a layer of unpredictability. The 7-bank drop targets, when hit, reveal stand-up targets. Scoring is straightforward, with bonus multipliers rewarding completion of the drop target bank.
Up Top until you have the 5X bonus multiplier and base bonus at 20K, then nudge for either collect bonus chute [“A” or “B”]. Repeat. If Extra Balls are enabled, shoot the 1-2-3 targets to light the middle right lane, shoot it to collect your EB. Make the lit bonus multiplier advance lane at the top. Harder than it looks, and any plunges will fail to go in any lane, rattling off to either side.
games.name: Incredible Hulk, The

games.description: Original Electro-mechanical table, designed 2018. It is based on "Big Shot " from Gottlieb in 1971 and inspired by the game "The Last Ninja", one of the hit action game of the eighties which in 1987 conquered home computers and became a classic on C64 and then Amiga.
games.name: Last Ninja, The

games.description: Original table, designed in 2018. This is a RE-SKIN of the jpsalas Table  Pokémon Pinball. This is a tribute to The Last Of Us, a 2013 action-adventure game developed by Naughty Dog and published by Sony Computer Entertainment on PS3. Players control Joel, a smuggler tasked with escorting a teenage girl, Ellie, across a post-apocalyptic United States.
games.name: Last Of Us, The

games.description:
The Lost World: Jurassic Park is a 1997 pinball machine by John Borg and Sega Pinball, being a sequel to Data East's Jurassic Park and themed after the movie of the same name. It has the player going through five modes, each recreating a scene from the movie, before reaching the Wizard Mode: San Diego, where the T-Rex rampages and any major shot scores an increasing value, and any target increases the value.
One of its main gimmicks is the large T-Rex egg that breaks steadily, ultimately revealing the baby T-Rex inside. It also had an optional topper replicating the film's logo, and a curvy 3D backglass.
games.name: Lost World Jurassic Park, The

games.description:
The Machine: Bride of Pinbot was the second game in the Pin-Bot series. The game is known for the female robot (aka The Machine) that rotates into different stages throughout the game. The game is also famous for the 1 Billion point shot, which can be awarded from the Big Wheel and collected at the center ramp.
In the game, the player must assist in the construction of "The Machine", a massive female humanoid robot. The player does this by first shooting a ball into her mouth (enabling her to speak), then shooting two balls into her eye sockets (so she can see). With the Machine complete and fully operational, the job would be done, except an influx of human DNA causes the Bride to undergo an unexpected metamorphosis...
games.name: Machine: Bride of Pin·bot, The

games.description: Original table, designed in 2023. This is a tribute to The Mandalorian, an American space Western television series created by Jon Favreau for the streaming service Disney+. It is the first live-action series in the Star Wars franchise and begins five years after the events of the film Return of the Jedi (1983). It follows a lone bounty hunter who protects a Force-sensitive child, Grogu, from remnant Imperial forces.
games.name: Mandalorian, The

games.description: Original table, designed in 2023. This is a tribute to The Matrix, a 1999 science fiction action film written and directed by the Wachowskis. It is the first installment in the Matrix film series, starring Keanu Reeves, Laurence Fishburne, Carrie-Anne Moss, Hugo Weaving, and Joe Pantoliano. It depicts a dystopian future in which humanity is unknowingly trapped inside the Matrix, a simulated reality created by intelligent machines.
games.name: Matrix, The

games.description: Original table, designed in 2021. This is a tribute to The Office, an American mockumentary sitcom television series, the show depicts the everyday work lives of office employees at the Scranton, Pennsylvania, branch of the fictional Dunder Mifflin Paper Company, and aired from March 24, 2005, to May 16, 2013, with a total of nine seasons consisting of 201 episodes.
games.name: Office, The

games.description: The Police is an original, music-themed pinball table based on Gottlieb's 1985 "Rock" layout. Featuring hits from the iconic 80s band, players light up songs, spell P–O–L–I–C–E, and chase down criminals for big jackpots and bonuses. A fast-paced tribute to classic rock and vintage pinball action!
games.name: Police, The

games.description: Original table, designed in 2022. This is a RE-SKIN of the jpsalas Table Serious Sam 2. Inspired on the 5 movies and 2 TV series.
games.name: Purge, The

games.description: Raid is a solid-state, four-player game featuring an aviation and combat theme. The playfield is equipped with three flippers, three pop bumpers, a slingshot, a 4-bank and a 3-bank of drop targets, three standup targets, a kick-out hole, a ball kicker, and a horseshoe.
games.name: Raid, The

games.description: Original table, designed in 2022. It is based on "Speed Test" from Taito do Brasil in 1982. This is a tribute to The Rocky Horror Picture Show, a 1975 independent musical comedy horror film produced by Lou Adler and Michael White, directed by Jim Sharman, and distributed by 20th Century Fox.
games.name: Rocky Horror Picture Show, The

games.description: The Rolling Stones features music from the iconic band and combines classic pinball elements with a modern twist. It includes two flippers, two ramps, and a four-ball multiball mode.
games.name: Rolling Stones, The

games.description: The Shadow is an arcade pinball game designed by Brian Eddy with art by Doug Watson and based on the 1994 film of the same name. It features custom voice clips from stars Penelope Ann-Miller (Margo Lane), John Lone (Shiwan Khan), and Tim Curry (Farley Claymore). Alec Baldwin was unable to provide lines, so you'll have to settle with Williams alumni Tim Kitzrow to voice The Shadow himself. As with the movie, Lamont Cranston is a Rich Idiot With No Day Job who is secretly The Shadow, a vigilante with psychic powers. Battling crime in 1930s New York City, The Shadow must stop the evil Shiwan Khan, who's out to detonate an atomic bomb and destroy the city as part of his plan to conquer the world. As The Shadow, the player must Punish the Guilty, defuse the Beryllium Sphere, Discover Hotel Monolith, and perform other tasks from the movie to stop Khan's forces. Use your mental powers to control the playfield Diverters, then seek Vengeance on Khan and engage him in the Final Battle.
games.name: Shadow, The

games.description: The Spellcast Machine is a psychedelic, original pinball table where you control a mystical device that forges real spells. Complete magical tasks like crafting wands, casting charms, and mining crystals to unlock powerful wizard modes and trigger the ultimate "Spellstorm" multiball.
games.name: Spellcast Machine, The

games.id: The Table With The Least Comprehensible Theme Ever (Original 2016)(1.1g)
games.description: Original table, designed in 2016. Yes !!!, that's the name. "The Table With The Least Comprehensible Theme Ever".
games.name: Table With The Least Comprehensible Theme Ever, The

games.description:
Stern's The Walking Dead is an arcade pinball machine based on the popular Zombie Apocalypse live-action television series. It was designed by John Borg, illustrated by Greg Freres and Kevin O'Connor. Helped dramatically by Lyman's deep rules, it has tons of different ways to play this game, which rewards explorative play. Some interesting shot geometry mixed with classic bash toys and satisfying ramp shots.
In this game, the player joins Rick Grimes and his group of survivors as they try to make it in a Crapsack World overrun with zombies. Collect Food, Weapons, and First Aid supplies, visit Woodbury, the Prison, and the Tower, then load up on various weapons in case a Riot breaks out. Venture to the Arena, Cell Block C, the CDC, and the Tunnel, battle the Prison Walkers and the bloated Well Walker. Load up the unfolding crossbow and shoot it at targets across the playfield, then start a Multikill spree for maximum damage.
games.name: Walking Dead, The

games.name: Web, The

games.id: The Who's Tommy Pinball Wizard (Data East 1994)(1.1)
games.description:
The Who's Tommy Pinball Wizard, is based on the rock musical "Tommy" by The Who. This pinball machine features an immersive experience with 21 songs from the musical performed by the original Broadway cast members.

The machine includes unique features like "blinders," which cover the flippers to simulate the main character's blindness, and a six-ball multiball mode.
games.name: Who's Tommy Pinball Wizard, The

games.description:
First game from this manufacturer to have the lift-up playfield glass. The manufacturer produced the backglasses in both crystal glass and Plexiglas.

The left drop lane has a single metal pin in its path which may or may not deflect the dropping ball out of the outlane and to the left flipper. This factory-installed pin may have been removed, or replaced with a post or mini-post, by an operator or game owner.
games.name: Wiggler, The

games.description: Original table, designed in 2022. It is based on "Cosmic Gunfight" from Williams in 1982. This game is a tribute to The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt, a 2015 action role-playing game developed and published by CD Projekt. It is the sequel to the 2011 game The Witcher 2: Assassins of Kings and the third game in The Witcher video game series.
games.name: Witcher, The

games.description: Designed in 2021, this original electro-mechanical table is based on Gottlieb's 1975 "Abra Ca Dabra" and inspired by The Wizard (1989), a film about a young video game prodigy on a journey to a major tournament. The movie is known for its Nintendo product placement and the North American debut of Super Mario Bros. 3.
games.name: Wizard, The

games.description: Ticket Tac Toe by Williams is a redemption-style pinball machine that combines classic tic-tac-toe gameplay with fast-paced mechanical action. Players aim to light up spaces on a digital grid by hitting specific targets, racing against time to complete lines and win tickets. Bright lights, catchy sounds, and intuitive rules make it a fun and accessible game for all ages.
games.name: Ticket Tac Toe

games.description: Tiger is an electro-mechanical, single-player game with a production run of 1,100 units, Tiger was primarily distributed in Italy. It features a circus theme and includes two flippers, three pop bumpers, a spinning target, and an upper right return ball rollunder.
games.name: Tiger

games.description: Original table, designed in 2021. A mid century retro atomic adventure filled with beautiful women, partying aliens, exotic animals, and fiery volcanos. AKA Tiki Bob's Exotic Beach Party.
games.name: Tiki Bob's Atomic Beach Party

games.description: Original Electro-mechanical table, designed in 2021. It is based on "Space Walk" from Gottlieb in 1979.
games.name: Tiki Time

games.description: Time Fantasy featuring a unique fantasy and time-travel theme. the game operates on the Williams System 7 platform. It includes two flippers, no ramps, and does not have a multiball mode. With only 600 units produced, it is a rare find for collectors.
games.name: Time Fantasy

games.description: Time Line is featuring a sci-fi and time-travel theme. It has a wide body cabinet with four flippers, no ramps, and does not include a multiball mode. It is part of the Gottlieb System 80 series with 3,167 units produced.
games.name: Time Line

games.description: Original table, designed in 2023. This game is based on an original story stemming from two fellahs spitballing ideas and try to make each other laugh. When you venture into the bizarre world of Kevin, aka Q-Man you have to remember that would much rather hang out in seedy bars with dodgy chicks than take control of the Universe.
games.name: Time Lord

games.description: Time Machine is an early Physical Pinball Table from Data East released in 1988. It was designed by Ed Cebula and Joe Kaminkow, with music by David Thiel and art by Kevin O'Connor and Margaret Hudson. The game's premise is a simple one: fire up your time-travelling sports car for an interdimensional tour. Shoot the ramps and rollovers to spell STARWARP, then hit the center ramp transporter and beam yourself across the playfield for a million points. Travel from The '80s back to The '70s, The '60s, and The '50s, locking a pinball in each era, then unleash them for a three-ball multiball and a shot at the Jackpot. For more nostalgia, go to The '50s and the table turns into an old-fashioned electro-mechanical pinball, complete with old-school chimebox sound effects.
games.name: Time Machine (Data East)
