games.description: "The Time Tunnel" was an American TV show that broadcasted on the ABC-TV network from 1966-1967. Production of this 1971 pinball machine was stopped due to name copyright problems with the TV network. It was later made as Bally's 1972 'Space Time' (4 players) and Bally's 1973 'Time Zone' (2 players) with the tunnel unit moved below the playfield. Skill shot from plunger collects flashing Tunnel value. Tunnel value can also be collected by center target and left kickback lane.
games.name: Time Tunnel

games.description: Time Warp features a mythology and world history theme. This solid-state electronic game includes two flippers, five pop bumpers, two kick-out holes, and multiple drop target banks. Notably, many units of "Time Warp" were equipped with distinctive banana-shaped flippers, adding a unique twist to gameplay.
games.name: Time Warp

games.description: Title Fight featuring a boxing theme. The game has five flippers, no ramps, and a two-ball multiball mode. It is part of the Gottlieb System 3 series. Only 1,000 units were produced, making it relatively rare.
games.name: Title Fight

games.description: Toledo and Valencia are two closely related pinball machines produced by Williams Electronic Games Inc. in 1975. Toledo features a two-player setup with four flippers, two pop bumpers, slingshots, button targets, rollover buttons, standup targets, and a kick-out hole. A total of 3,001 units were produced, and the game is known for its unique button targets, which were not commonly used in other pinball machines of the time​. Valencia, the four-player version of Toledo, was a prototype that was ultimately canceled and never went into full production.
games.name: Toledo

games.description: A game of cat and mouse!, Remember coming home after school, or sitting in front of the TV on Saturday morning with your favorite bowl of cereal and watching this classic? It's been almost 80 years since this hilarious cat and mouse duo debuted, and they've finally made their way to VPX! Now, you can "play" the cartoon and re-live all of those fond memories right at your fingertips!
games.name: Tom & Jerry

games.description: Tomb Raider is an original pinball creation released in 2025, inspired by the Lara Croft adventure franchise. It supports 1–4 players with 3 or 5 balls and includes optional glowing “light balls”. The table evokes classic Tomb Raider exploration with relic hunts in an under cave playfield, surprise gameplay surprises, rich audiovisuals, and nostalgic call‑outs from Lara, capturing the thrill of relic-seeking from the original PS1 era
games.name: Tomb Raider

games.description: Original Electro-mechanical table, designed in 2021. It is based on "Abra Ca Dabra" from Gottlieb in 1975 and inspired by Tommy Boy, a 1995 American buddy comedy film directed by Peter Segal and starring soon-to-be former Saturday Night Live castmates and close friends Chris Farley and David Spade.
games.name: Tommy Boy

games.description: Top Card and Royal Pair are two electro-mechanical pinball machines released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in 1974. "Top Card," introduced in August, is a single-player game with a card and gambling theme, featuring two flippers, three pop bumpers, four slingshots, and thirteen standup targets. it had a production run of 3,100 units and is known for its straightforward gameplay. "Royal Pair," released in October as the add-a-ball version for export to Italy, shares the same design and features but focuses on awarding additional balls to extend gameplay.
games.name: Top Card

games.description: Top Dawg Shuffle Alley by Williams (1988) is an arcade shuffle bowling game where players slide pucks to score points, simulating bowling with a shuffleboard twist. Known for its colorful graphics and rare cabinet design, it runs on the Williams System 11B and is popular among collectors and digital pinball fans.
games.name: Top Dawg

games.description: Top Hand features a card game theme with four banks of drop targets representing the suits in a deck of cards, emphasizing target shooting accuracy. This is a version of Gottlieb's 1974 'Capt. Card' made for export to Italy.
games.name: Top Hand

games.description: Top Score features a bowling theme. This electro-mechanical game is a two-player version. The 4-player version of this game is Gottlieb's 1975 "300".
games.name: Top Score

games.description: Torch features a sports theme with two flippers, no ramps, and does not have a multiball mode, it has a production run of 3,880 units.
games.name: Torch

games.description: An all original design, this table is an homage to the sooner state in the form of a modern Electro-Mecanical table. Hit the ramps and the targets and feed the whale to spell out OKIES and release the multi-ball. If the score rolls over 9999 an indicator star light will appear below the score! (up to 4 stars earnable)
games.name: Tornado Rally

games.description: Torpedo Alley features a naval combat theme with three flippers, two ramps, and a three-ball multiball mode. The game is notable for its stereo sound and animated playfield feature. it had a limited production run of 1,002 units.
games.name: Torpedo Alley

games.description: Torpedo!! is an electro-mechanical pinball machine accommodates a single player and features two flippers, one pop bumper, two slingshots, two standup targets, a vari-target, a kick-out hole, and a spinning target. Petaco was the name used for domestic games. The same company made the export version as Recel's 1976 'Torpedo!!'.
games.name: Torpedo!!

games.description: The game's focus is on the pinball action, which centers around starting, overheating, and destroying nuclear reactors (in that order). Shooting the scoop activates them, hitting the grid drop targets heats them up, and shooting the game's sole pop bumper will finally explosively overload it. Repeating this process will ultimately result in the titular total nuclear annihilation. This stripped-down approach results in a rather difficult but deceptively simple game that is well-suited for competitive play.
games.name: Total Nuclear Annihilation

games.description: Gottlieb's 1979 Totem is distinguished by its asymmetrically placed flippers, a novel concept that challenges player expectations and adds a level of skill-building not often found in contemporaries. The vari-target on the left playfield captures attention for its strategic depth and contribution to scoring mechanics. Meanwhile, Morison's artwork transforms the machine into a vivid canvas of cultural expression, celebrated for its aesthetic appeal while occasionally critiqued for verging on dated or culturally insensitive themes. The gameplay revolves around mastering its asymmetrical flippers and capitalizing on scoring opportunities provided by the drop targets and vari-target. The scoring system offers bonus multipliers tied to these elements, encouraging players to develop unique strategies aimed at maximizing points. Players often delight in the challenge presented by targeting specific shots to activate bonus modes.
games.name: Totem (Gottlieb)

games.description: Gottlieb's 1979 Totem is distinguished by its asymmetrically placed flippers, a novel concept that challenges player expectations and adds a level of skill-building not often found in contemporaries. The vari-target on the left playfield captures attention for its strategic depth and contribution to scoring mechanics. Meanwhile, Morison's artwork transforms the machine into a vivid canvas of cultural expression, celebrated for its aesthetic appeal while occasionally critiqued for verging on dated or culturally insensitive themes. The gameplay revolves around mastering its asymmetrical flippers and capitalizing on scoring opportunities provided by the drop targets and vari-target. The scoring system offers bonus multipliers tied to these elements, encouraging players to develop unique strategies aimed at maximizing points. Players often delight in the challenge presented by targeting specific shots to activate bonus modes.
games.name: Totem (Gottlieb)

games.description: Touchdown is a fast-paced American football-themed pinball machine where players score points by completing passes, making field goals, and driving toward the end zone. With vibrant artwork and action-packed gameplay, it captures the excitement of a classic gridiron showdown. It was also released as an add-a-ball version, Williams' 1967 Kickoff.
games.name: Touchdown (Williams)

games.description: Touchdown is a fast-paced American football-themed pinball machine where players score points by completing passes, making field goals, and driving toward the end zone. With vibrant artwork and action-packed gameplay, it captures the excitement of a classic gridiron showdown. It was also released as an add-a-ball version, Williams' 1967 Kickoff.
games.name: Touchdown (Williams)

games.description: Trade Winds is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine. The game features a nautical theme, capturing the adventurous spirit of sea exploration. The playfield includes two flippers, five pop bumpers, two passive bumpers, two slingshots, and a kick-out hole.
games.name: Trade Winds

games.description: Trailer, produced by Playmatic in 1985, is a solid-state pinball machine featuring a trucking and transportation theme. The game accommodates up to four players and includes four flippers, two pop bumpers, a four-bank drop target, a three-bank drop target, three standup targets, three kick-out holes, and a spinning target.
games.name: Trailer

games.description: Get ready boys, Avoid a pair of drunk trailer park supervisors and help Ricky, Julian, and Bubbles find their missing stash. This is a ReSkin of "Indiana Jones Last Movie" table.
games.name: Trailer Park Boys - Pin-Ballers

games.description:
Transformers is a 2011 Licensed Pinball Table designed by George Gomez for Stern Pinball. It is a tie-in to the live-action Transformers film series by Michael Bay, particularly Transformers: Dark of the Moon. The game begins by throwing you into the fray, requiring you to choose a side to ally with; thus aligned, you must then assemble the five members of your selected faction by completing the Battle Modes for all of them, then lead your forces to engage the turncoat Sentinel Prime. Defeat Sentinel, then take the fight to the members of the opposite side, and fight through them all for a chance to settle the eons-old conflict in the Battle For Cybertron.
In addition to the standard ("Pro") model, it was available in Autobot, Decepticon, or "Combo" Limited Editions, with different backbox translite and cabinet art, color-coded and laser-etched metalwork, support for a shaker motor, and additional playfield toys, features, and rules.
games.name: Transformers Pro

games.description:
Transformers is a 2011 Licensed Pinball Table designed by George Gomez for Stern Pinball. It is a tie-in to the live-action Transformers film series by Michael Bay, particularly Transformers: Dark of the Moon. The game begins by throwing you into the fray, requiring you to choose a side to ally with; thus aligned, you must then assemble the five members of your selected faction by completing the Battle Modes for all of them, then lead your forces to engage the turncoat Sentinel Prime. Defeat Sentinel, then take the fight to the members of the opposite side, and fight through them all for a chance to settle the eons-old conflict in the Battle For Cybertron.
In addition to the standard ("Pro") model, it was available in Autobot, Decepticon, or "Combo" Limited Editions, with different backbox translite and cabinet art, color-coded and laser-etched metalwork, support for a shaker motor, and additional playfield toys, features, and rules.
games.name: Transformers Pro

games.description: Original table, designed in 2018. It is based on Transformers Generation 1 cartoons.
games.name: Transformers G1

games.description: Travel Time is notable for its unique gameplay mechanism where players earn extra time instead of additional balls, making the length of the game dependent on hitting specific targets to extend play. The Replay version of this game is Williams' 1972 'Summer Time'.
games.name: Travel Time

games.description: Treff is a vintage German tabletop coin-operated game—more of a gambling device than a pinball. Players drop coins (10 Pfennig) and use a plunger-like mechanism to launch them up into numbered pockets. Depending on which pocket the coin lands in, players are rewarded with coins dropped back through the playfield. Filling specific pockets can either clear the field and win big—or lose your stake when coins fall into the reserve gutter. The game ends when you run out of coins—or hit the rare jackpot by emptying all pockets. It's a charming relic of post-war gaming culture, recently revived digitally via Visual Pinball X
games.name: Treff

games.description: Tri Zone is a classic 1979 pinball machine by Williams, combining three distinct playfield zones—each with unique rules and challenges. Players aim for high scores by mastering bumpers, spinners, and drop targets, all backed by vibrant artwork and early solid-state sound effects. A fast-paced game blending skill and strategy.
games.name: Tri Zone

games.description: Trick Shooter inspired by Sharp Shooter from Game Plan (1979), reimagined with a Western and sharpshooting theme. Players take on the role of a skillful gunslinger aiming for high scores by hitting targets, drop banks, and lanes across a colorful playfield. While retaining the basic layout and gameplay of its American counterpart, Trick Shooter features localized artwork and mechanical tweaks suited to LTD's production style, making it a rare and distinctive collectible in Latin American pinball history.
games.name: Trick Shooter

games.description: Trident has an aquatic theme, with the backglass showing a mighty green monster, an octopus and of course the three-pronged Trident in an undersea setting. It features a programmable drop target bank which becomes increasingly more difficult to knock down and includes a bonus multiplier, paying off in the outhole and two Play-More posts deflecting the ball towards the flippers. Two spinning targets with cumulative scoring that lead to sweeping return lanes to top of the playfield, a Kick-Out hole keyed to the bonus multiplier and there is no outlane on the left side of playfield.
games.name: Trident

games.description: Triple Action (Williams, 1974) is a classic electro-mechanical pinball machine that captures the thrill of fast-paced gameplay with a three-ball multiball feature. Players aim to light up all three bumpers, triggering higher scores and dynamic play. With vibrant artwork and smooth mechanics, Triple Action delivers an exciting and strategic pinball experience, perfect for both casual players and seasoned fans of vintage machines.nnnnTriple Action is convertible to Add-a-ball or Novelty Play. The Add-a-ball only version is Williams' 1973 'Star Action'.
games.name: Triple Action

games.description: Triple Strike is a classic electromechanical pinball machine themed around bowling. Up to four players can compete to knock down virtual pins by hitting specific targets and rollovers. With colorful artwork and smooth gameplay, Triple Strike delivers the charm of a 1970's bowling alley, offering skill-based shots, strategic play, and a touch of nostalgia.
games.name: Triple Strike

games.description: This table is based on Tic-Tac-Toe game, the 4-player version of this game is Williams' 1973 'OXO'.
games.name: Triple X

games.description: TRON: Legacy is a pinball based on the movie of the same name. It was designed by John Borg of Stern Pinball, illustrated by John Youssi, and released in August 2011. The game casts the player as Sam Flynn, who has inadvertently entered the digital world of The Grid while searching for his missing father Kevin. Not only does Sam find his dad and the ISO Quorra, but he's also attracted the attention of Clu and his mysterious enforcer, Rinzler. To escape, Sam and Quorra must now make their way through Clu and his followers, race light cycles, dodge Recognizers, and survive the Disc Battles to reach the Portal and return to the real world. The pinball itself was released in four different editions, each distinguished by different translite displays on the backbox and has been quietly popular for a long time, thanks in part to its killer soundtrack (hello, Daft Punk machine!), theming and fast flowing gameplay.
games.name: Tron Legacy

games.description: Tropic Fun is a vibrant, beach-themed pinball machine that transports players to a sun-soaked island paradise. Navigate surfboards, dodge coconuts, and ride the wave to high scores with exciting ramps, tropical sound effects, and fast-paced gameplay. Perfect for capturing the laid-back thrill of a beach getaway—pinball style!
games.name: Tropic Fun

games.description:
In this game, you are in the Twilight Zone TV show from the 1950s/early 1960s. You will interact with different people and things from the show while trying to get awards. The goal is to complete modes, filling in spaces on the Twilight Zone door in the center of the table in order to reach the final wizard mode.
It is a busy game, and if you like Pat Lawlor tables, it is probably the most complex version of his work that you will find. There is a gumball machine, magnetic flippers on an upper mini-playfield, a working analog clock, and all the weird shot geometry you can handle. Legend says it was the most over-budget machine made at the time, and we believe it.
games.name: Twilight Zone

games.description: Calypso has recruited you to join his little game with tantalizing promises beyond your wildest dreams. The only thing you need to do to be granted any wish imaginable is only survive Twisted Metal. Start a battle by shooting the middle ramp, complete each battle and destroy your opponents to face Sweet Tooth in the final fight to the death to win the Twisted Metal Tournament.
games.name: Twisted Metal

games.description: Based on the 1996 motion picture of the same name, the Twister pinball features a real mounted fan on top of the machine that starts/stops depending on the current mode. It also features a top lane magnet for lightning fast turbo-pop action, a spinning ball-catching magnet that, during multiball, grabs the balls and throws them out with the fury of a real tornado, an automatic Ball Shooter allowing Skillshot to the spinning magnet at the start of each ball and a Memory Drop Target which prevents the twister from striking when reached.
games.name: Twister

games.description: Step into a futuristic world of teleportation and mystery! In TX-Sector, players activate glowing portals and harness energy beams to transport balls across the playfield. With its sci-fi theme, dynamic sound effects, and innovative ball teleportation feature, this machine delivers a unique and immersive pinball experience straight from another dimension.
games.name: TX-Sector

games.description: U-Boat 65 is a solid-state pinball machine released by Nuova Bell Games, an Italian manufacturer, in June 1988. The game features a naval warfare theme, with the playfield equipped with two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, 14 standup targets, a kicker lane, and a vertical up-kicker.
games.name: U-Boat 65

games.description: Underwater, released by Spanish manufacturer Recel S.A. in June 1976, is a four-player electro-mechanical pinball machine with an underwater adventure theme. Recel is the name used for export games. The same company made a domestic version as Petaco's 'Underwater'.
games.name: Underwater

games.description: Universe, produced by the Italian manufacturer Zaccaria in November 1977, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine with a space exploration theme. The game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, and a variety of standup targets.
games.name: Universe

games.description: V.1 is a solid state machine with the theme being based on Outer Space and Fantasy. It has a cool sound to it in a cute and addicting way.
games.name: V.1

games.description: Vampire plunges players into a gothic horror setting filled with bats, fangs, and eerie suspense. The playfield features fast-paced action with multiple pop bumpers, kick-out holes, and stand-up targets designed to test players' reflexes and precision. Scoring relies on hitting key targets to light up bonuses and rack up points, while the haunting backglass art and classic chime sounds enhance the thrilling, retro horror vibe.
games.name: Vampire

games.description: Original table, designed in 2020. It is based on "Straight Flush" from Williams in 1970. This game is a tribute to "Vasco da Gama", a sports club based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. Although originally a rowing club and then a multi-sport club, Vasco is mostly known for its men's football team.
games.name: Vasco da Gama

games.description: Vector offers a rich and dynamic gameplay experience characterized by its futuristic sports arena theme. Designed to compete with the emerging video game market, the machine features multiple playfield levels, including an upper playfield with its own flipper and ball lock. Key features include a "Flip-O-Meter" that measures ball speed on the upper ramp, a series of drop targets, and a unique ball lock mechanism. The game also integrates extensive voice interaction and sound effects, which were advanced for its time.
games.name: Vector

games.description: Original table, designed in 2021. It is based on the first table "field" in the "Vector Pinball" mobile game by Dozing Cat Software.
games.name: Vector Pinball

games.description: Verne's World is a widebody pinball machine inspired by the adventures of Jules Verne. The game features three flippers, two ramps, and a four-ball multiball, offering players an engaging and varied gameplay experience. The playfield is adorned with thematic elements reflecting Verne's literary works, including a prominent octopus figure, adding to the game's immersive appeal.
games.name: Verne's World

games.description: Viking is known for its detailed Viking theme and engaging gameplay, this machine features two flippers, four pop bumpers, two kick-out holes, two stand-up targets, a spinning target, and both a 3-bank and a 4-in-line drop target setup. A unique feature of this machine is the bounce-back outlanes, which allow players to nudge a draining ball back into play through gates.
games.name: Viking

games.description: Viking King is a solid-state pinball machine featuring a norse history theme. Compare playfield layout to Gottlieb's 1976 'Pioneer'.
games.name: Viking King

games.description: Viper is a wide-body pinball machine featuring a solid-state design and digital displays. It includes three flippers, no ramps, and supports multiball play with up to three balls. Only 438 units were produced, making it a rare find.
games.name: Viper

games.description: Viper Night Drivin' is designed around a neon-lit street racing theme. It features two flippers, three ramps, and a four-ball multiball mode. The game includes unique lighting effects, such as glow-in-the-dark features and a soundtrack that adds to the nighttime driving atmosphere, with music contributions from Brian Schmidt and Slash.
games.name: Viper Night Drivin'

games.description: Volcano features a wide-body design and is part of the Gottlieb System 80 series. It includes three flippers, one ramp, and a three-ball multiball feature. The game is themed around volcanic eruptions and disaster scenarios.
games.name: Volcano

games.description: Your goal is to complete orders for metals and alloys while retaining as much of the Volkan's profits. To complete an order, you will need Coal (saucer) to stoke the Blast Furnace (upper left VUK) and raise the temperature. You will also need a certain amount of Steam and Electricity for each order to run the factory. And, of course, the necessary ores needed for each order: Iron, Copper, Tin, and Zinc bumpers & Carbon standup. Plus, Volkan's secret element: Strontium drop targerts. Once everything is collected for each order, the Blast Furnace door opens in the upper center. A successful shot completes the order.
games.name: Volkan Steel and Metal

games.description: Volley features a tennis theme. This single-player electro-mechanical game challenges players with its distinctive three-bank drop target arrangement, where completing each set of targets is essential to progressing and scoring high points.
games.name: Volley

games.description: Operate whimsical lab equipment to open gateways to parallel dimensions. Explore the multiverse and bring back relics from unknown realms. Six quest modes, six mini game modes, two multiball modes, a wizard mode, and 8 unlockable gadgets. The spiritual sequel to the table "Experiments of Alchemical Chaos", Vortex Plunder expands the objective of “studying an alternate universe” to be “explore as many parallel dimensions as possible.”
games.name: Vortex Plunder

games.description:
Vulcan is a classic electro-mechanical game. This four-player machine features a mythological theme centered around the Roman god Vulcan, known for his association with fire and metalworking.

The 2-player version of this game is Gottlieb's 1977 'Fire Queen'.
games.name: Vulcan

games.description: Vulcan IV, produced in Brazil by Rowamet Indústria Eletrometalúrgica. Copying the classic 1977 Gottlieb “Vulcan” EM, this version features a fiery mythological theme with a refreshed backglass showcasing a bold female figure. Players aim to complete target banks, capture the kick-out hole, and rack up bonus points by triggering combos and lighting lanes. The mix of drop-target strategy and fast-action bumpers delivers an engaging blend of skill and excitement in a visually striking cabinet.
games.name: Vulcan IV

games.description: Wallace and Gromit is an unofficial but lovingly crafted digital pinball experience based on Aardman's beloved duo. Featuring six themed game rounds, including multiball and a climactic “ultimate round,” it offers either three or five balls per game. The table is packed with charming animated toys, custom art, and richly themed modes—all complemented by the voice of Peter Sallis as Wallace. It delivers a whimsical, cartoon‑style gameplay that celebrates the quirky inventor and his loyal dog.
games.name: Wallace and Gromit

games.description: Warlok is a solid-state pinball machine with a medieval fantasy theme. It features two flippers, no ramps, and no multiball, making it a straightforward but challenging game. only 412 units were produced. Compare playfield layout to Williams' 1980 'Blackout', the rules and sounds of Warlok are very similar to Stern's 1979 'Meteor'.
games.name: Warlok

games.description: Original table, designed in 2019. It is based on the 1986 graphic novel by Alan Moore and Dave Gibbons, published by DC Comics.
games.name: Watchmen

games.description: WaterWorld is based on the film of the same name, a 1995 American post-apocalyptic action film, directed by Kevin Reynolds and co-written by Peter Rader and David Twohy. It was distributed by Universal Pictures.
games.name: WaterWorld

games.description: Original table, designed in 2021. It is based on "Radical!" from Bally in 1990 and isppired by the movie wayne's world released in 1992, a comedy film franchise, based on the popular Saturday Night Live sketch of the same name. The franchise follows the adventures of two slacker friends, Wayne Campbell and Garth Algar, as they host their public-access television show and navigate the ups and downs of life in Aurora, Illinois.
games.name: Wayne's World

games.description: Whirlwhind is a really great and fun game. The sounds are wonderful, with some very catchy music and callouts. Classic Pat Lawlor design. Arguably, its "toy" (a fan!) is still the most well integrated device in a game ever seen in pinball. You'll never get tired of it. “Looks like rain” will be forever stuck in your head after playing this game.
games.name: Whirlwind

games.description: Whirlwhind is a really great and fun game. The sounds are wonderful, with some very catchy music and callouts. Classic Pat Lawlor design. Arguably, its "toy" (a fan!) is still the most well integrated device in a game ever seen in pinball. You'll never get tired of it. “Looks like rain” will be forever stuck in your head after playing this game.
games.name: Whirlwind

games.description:
In White Water, you are navigating a river with Wet Willie as your guide. You will encounter whirlpools, secret caves, and navigate river hazards. You will also have run-ins with a large animatronic Big Foot. It's pure 90s pinball, and would be difficult to pull off today.
This table has a lot going on. There are two playfields (upper and lower), three flippers, and a left outlane kicker. It also has multiple ramps that are fun to shoot. It tends to feel cramped and fast, but that really only adds to its appeal. Art package and sound design are especially good for this era.
games.name: Whitewater

games.description: Who Dunnit offers a unique blend of pinball gameplay with a murder mystery theme set in a 1940s-style casino and includes immersive animations​​. Players take on the role of a detective solving five different murder cases, each involving a series of suspects. The game integrates thematic elements such as a slot machine, roulette wheel, and elevator ramp, enhancing the interactive experience.
games.name: WHO dunnit

games.description: Original table, designed in 2021. It is based on "Black Knight 2000" from Williams in 1989. This game is a tribute "Who Framed Roger Rabbit", a 1988 American fantasy comedy film directed by Robert Zemeckis from a screenplay written by Jeffrey Price and Peter S. Seaman. It is loosely based on the 1981 novel Who Censored Roger Rabbit by Gary K. Wolf. The film stars Bob Hoskins, Christopher Lloyd, Stubby Kaye, and Joanna Cassidy
games.name: Who Framed Roger Rabbit

games.description: Whoa Nellie! Big Juicy Melons pinball takes players on a journey through the Mellon Family farm renowned for abundant produce. Players score points on the farm operated by the lovely Melony Mellon and her twin sisters while avoiding the wrath of their over-protective shotgun-wielding father.
games.name: Whoa Nellie! Big Juicy Melons

games.description: Whoa Nellie! Big Juicy Melons pinball takes players on a journey through the Mellon Family farm renowned for abundant produce. Players score points on the farm operated by the lovely Melony Mellon and her twin sisters while avoiding the wrath of their over-protective shotgun-wielding father.
games.name: Whoa Nellie! Big Juicy Melons

games.id: Whoa Nellie! Big Juicy Melons (Stern 2015)(Nude Mod 2011)
games.description: Whoa Nellie! Big Juicy Melons pinball takes players on a journey through the Mellon Family farm renowned for abundant produce. Players score points on the farm operated by the lovely Melony Mellon and her twin sisters while avoiding the wrath of their over-protective shotgun-wielding father.
games.name: Whoa Nellie! Big Juicy Melons

games.description: This is the last single-player EM game made by this manufacturer. Backglass shows a replay window. This game is convertible to add-a-ball play, and novelty play.
games.name: Wild Card

games.description: With two sets of drop targets and great artwork, Wild Fyre is the Chariot themed thriller from the early days of digital scoring. Spinner target and Pop Bumper triangle keep the action hot, four player scoring increases competition.
games.name: Wild Fyre

games.description: Jungle, Wild Life, and Jungle King are pinball machines produced by D. Gottlieb & Co. in the early 1970s. These machines share a jungle theme and feature similar gameplay mechanics, including rollovers that advance the bonus, a kickback in the left outlane, and a gate at the right outlane. The main differences lie in their player capacities and bonus rules: Jungle is a four-player game produced in 1972 with a focus on doubling bonuses on the last ball; Wild Life is a two-player version with similar rules; and Jungle King is a single-player "add-a-ball" version released in 1973, allowing for bonus doubling on every ball under specific conditions.
games.name: Wild Life

games.description: Wild Wild West and Lariat share the same playfield design but differ in reward systems. Wild Wild West is the replay version, where players can win replays by scoring points, while Lariat is an add-a-ball version that rewards players with extra balls instead of replays. Both machines feature two vari-targets and are set in a Western theme.
games.name: Wild Wild West

games.id: Willy Wonka & The Chocolate Factory (Jersey Jack Pinball 2019)(3.5)
games.description:
The Sweetest Game in Pinball !
Jersey Jack Pinball presents a world of pure imagination !
Find the Golden Ticket and enter Wonka's Chocolate Factory for an unforgettable pinball adventure full of fun, surprises, and magic around every corner !
games.name: Willy Wonka & The Chocolate Factory

games.description: Original table designed in 2021. It is based on "Devil's Dare" from Gottlieb in 1982.
games.name: Willy's Wonderland

games.description: This table is a clone of Gottlieb's Volley of 1976.
games.name: Wimbledon

games.description: Wizard! is a notable entry in pinball history. It features the likenesses of Ann-Margret and Roger Daltrey from the movie Tommy, making it one of the first licensed pinball machines. "Wizard!" was Bally's highest production flipper game at the time, with over 10,000 units made. The machine is distinguished by its unique "flip flags" on the playfield, a feature rare among pinball games.
games.name: Wizard!

games.description: Wolf Man, produced by the Spanish manufacturer Peyper in 1987, is a solid-state pinball machine featuring a horror theme centered around the werewolf legend. The game is equipped with two flippers, three pop bumpers, a four-bank drop target, and two captive balls. A distinctive feature of Wolf Man is the inclusion of round knobs on each side of the cabinet, allowing players to physically move the playfield forward, backward, right, and left, adding a unique interactive dimension to the game.
games.name: Wolf Man

games.description: Wonderland is a single-player, electro-mechanical game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, one kick-out hole, and one gobble hole.
games.name: Wonderland

games.description: World Challenge Soccer features a soccer theme with three flippers, one ramp, and a three-ball multiball mode. Part of the Gottlieb System 3 series. Playfield similar to Premier's 1991 'Car Hop'.nnnnA total of 1,470 units were produced.
games.name: World Challenge Soccer

games.description: World Cup was notable for being the first Williams pinball game to feature electronic sounds instead of traditional chimes, marking a significant technological shift for the company. The game has a soccer theme and includes features like two flippers, pop bumpers, rollover buttons, kick-out holes, standup targets, and a spinning target.
games.name: World Cup

games.description: The playfield's most prominent mechanic includes a soccer goal defended by an articulating goalkeeper and aided by a spinning soccer ball which awards the player 10 million points once scored. To re-light the goal, players must either light four rollover buttons in the center of the playfield or shoot into the free kick zone just below the goal, which shoots the ball directly into the goal after a flipper input.The main progression path for the game is through multi-ball jackpots, each of which representing a different city whose team the player must defeat. There are 15 ranks total, with Germany ranked first. Players must re-engage multi-ball in order to proceed to the next jackpot.
games.name: World Cup Soccer

games.description: JP's World Joker Tour (jpsalas) is a creative mod of Stern's 2006 World Poker Tour machine, reskinned with a Joker-themed twist. In this version, the Joker hijacks the World Poker Tour, turning it into a chaotic, villain‑driven spectacle. The table features entirely new Joker-inspired artwork, neon plastics, LED upgrades, color DMD, and even custom animations like the Joker “eating” the ball—all while retaining the original game's rules and mechanics.
games.name: World Joker Tour

games.description: World Poker Tour is a poker-themed game incorporates features from the popular TV show, including the voices and images of commentators Vince Van Patten and Mike Sexton, as well as host Courtney Friel. This pinball machine aims to capture the excitement of playing Texas Hold 'Em, with a playfield that includes a dot matrix display showing players' hole cards and community cards as they progress through the game.
games.name: World Poker Tour

games.description: World Series and Grand Slam are baseball-themed electro-mechanical pinball machines. Both games share similar features, including two flippers, two pop bumpers, three kick-out holes, three roto-targets, and two slingshots, simulating the experience of a baseball game. Grand Slam is the replay version, rewarding players with replays for achieving certain scores, and had a production run of 3,600 units​. World Series is the "add-a-ball" version, designed for locations where replay games were restricted, and instead allows players to earn extra balls for extended play.
games.name: World Series

games.description: Original table, designed by jpsalas in 2015. It is based on "Monopoly" from Stern in 2001 and inspired by World of Warcraft characters.
games.name: WOW Monopoly

games.description:
Goal of the game is to defeat all monsters and gods.
• Main features 3 holes, 1 vuk, 2 bumpers, 6 flippers, 4 ramps, 2 spinners, 13 targets, 1 kickback, 1 captive ball and 1 elevated playfield.
• 3 balls per play.
• 20 second ball save timer on each ball, excluding any earned extra balls.
• Up to four players.
games.name: Wrath Of Olympus

games.description: WWF Royal Rumble captures the excitement of professional wrestling. This machine features many of the iconic wrestlers from the 1990s WWF era, such as Hulk Hogan and The Undertaker.
games.name: WWF Royal Rumble

games.description:
The X-Files is a Licensed Pinball Table based on the popular television series of the same name and released by Sega in 1997.
The game primarily revolves around the titular X-Files (collected in a cabinet in the middle of the playfield); spelling FBI lights one of eight episodes (based on actual episodes of the series) for completion. Completing all eight gives you a shot at the Wizard Mode. There's also two different multiballs (one achieved by hitting the cabinet enough times, and “The Truth” – wherein you unscramble a message by making the right shots), as well as a choice between Mulder and Scully (who make it easier to start the regular and Truth multiballs, respectively).
games.name: X Files, The

games.description:
The X-Files is a Licensed Pinball Table based on the popular television series of the same name and released by Sega in 1997.
The game primarily revolves around the titular X-Files (collected in a cabinet in the middle of the playfield); spelling FBI lights one of eight episodes (based on actual episodes of the series) for completion. Completing all eight gives you a shot at the Wizard Mode. There's also two different multiballs (one achieved by hitting the cabinet enough times, and “The Truth” – wherein you unscramble a message by making the right shots), as well as a choice between Mulder and Scully (who make it easier to start the regular and Truth multiballs, respectively).
games.name: X Files, The

games.description: X's & O's is a stone age theme and the successor of "OXO" which was already very successful in 1973. The game revolves around the Tic Tac Toe matrix in the middle of the field. The player controls what happens in the matrix by hitting different targets. In the upper half of the pitch, this edition brings some changes with it. Among other things a third pinball finger, with which the player must hit the upper 3 Drop Targets. The player must bring the ball into play in such a way that it touches the contact at the top edge and then neither runs downwards. The player gets an extra ball by reaching the upper left corner with the ball several times. At the top right of the playing field is a closed area with 2 lanes, which can be reached via the left outer lane. However, this is only possible via the right outer lane. The pinball machine stores the bonus for the following balls and so the player can increase the bonus and collect the points.
games.name: X's And O's

games.description:
In X-Men, the player must assemble eight of Professor Xavier's X-Men, then lead them to triumph against their various enemies. Catch Nightcrawler as he teleports around the field, ricochet pinballs against Gambit's playing cards, then slide down Iceman's ramp and brawl with Wolverine. Start Magneto Multiball and get past his magnetic defenses to challenge the Brotherhood, then go up against the Hellfire Club, Sabretooth, the Shadow King, Omega Red, the Juggernaut, and the Sentinels. Chain your teammates together in powerful Combos, then test their mettle in the Danger Room and against Dark Phoenix in a point-scoring frenzy.
In addition to the basic "Pro" table, X-Men was also available in Wolverine Blue and Magneto Red Limited Editions. Along with custom backbox translite art and color-coordinated metalwork, these games included a magnetic spinning disc and a swing-out Ice Slide that sends balls across the playfield.
games.name: X-Men

games.description: Xenon is an arcade pinball game released by Bally in 1980. It was designed by Greg Kmiec with art by Paul Faris, and electronic musician Suzanne Ciani provided the voice and music. The game itself centers around Xenon, the supercomputer at the heart of a futuristic society. Build up the Mota Special and the Bonus multiplier, then spell XENON to advance the Super Bonus. When you've collected three X's from the top saucer, shoot through the tube to interface with Xenon and start multiball for faster scoring. Xenon has the distinction of being Bally's first solid-state pinball game with multiball. And although it was not the first talking pinball ever, Xenon was also Bally's first game with speech, using Ciani's digitized and processed voice instead of the Machine Monotone of earlier games.
games.name: Xenon

games.description: At the time of its release, video games were already in the mainstream, but the simple addicting challenge of the game had caught the hearts of many children and became one of the most popular Japanese electromechanical style games. For this reason, the game can still be found in the corners of many Japanese candy stores & arcades and has since been rediscovered as a challenging representative of "reggae" (Japanese retro games). Today, modern players have reembraced their nostalgia for this classic title, hosting tournament challenges, and adding new competitive rules & scoring to the original “simple” game objective.
games.name: Yamanobori

games.description: Original Electro-mechanical table, designed in 2020. It is based on "Speakeasy" from Playmatic in 1977 and inspired by the movie Yellow Submarine (also known as The Beatles: Yellow Submarine), a 1968 animated jukebox musical fantasy adventure comedy film inspired by the music of the Beatles, directed by animation producer George Dunning.
games.name: Yellow Submarine

games.description: Original table, designed in 2021. It is based on "Eclipse" from Gottlieb in 1982 and inspired by the movie with the same name, a 1974 American comedy horror film directed by Mel Brooks. The screenplay was co-written by Brooks and Gene Wilder.
games.name: Young Frankenstein
Yukon

games.description: This is a copy of Bally's 1980 'Xenon'. All parts were made by LTD in Campinas, São Paulo, Brazil.
games.name: Zephy

games.description:
Zip-A-Doo is an electro-mechanical pinball machine that has a fun park theme and features two flippers, a mechanical reel display, and a two-player setup. The manufacturer produced the backglasses in both crystal glass and Plexiglas.

Maximum displayed point score is 99,990 points per player.
games.name: Zip-a-doo

games.description:
Playmatic's Zira is a fantasy-themed pinball involving science-fiction elements, such as a mysterious alien world and mystical creatures.
Dropping the 7 drop targets on the top, each one will score: the 1st time 10.000 points and the next times, 3 bonus, 10.000 points, 5 bonus, 30.000 points and prepares special by the targets located in the middle of the playfield. Dropping the 4 drop targets at the bottom, each one scores, the 1st time 10.000 points, the 2nd time 20.000 points and the 3rd time special. The central targets multiply bonus X3, X4, X5. Passing the 4 captive balls the player will get an extra ball.
Lighting A, B, C, D, E, F the bottom right hand corridor will score 100.000 points. Kick-out hole prepares special by the captive balls corridor. The central targets prepare special by the out lanes.
games.name: Zira

games.description: Original table, designed in 2022. It is based on "Tiger" from Gottlieb in 1975. This table is modeled after the table in the Wes Anderson movie The Life Aquatic. The real machine is in Bar Luce' in Italy.
games.name: Zissou - The Life Aquatic

games.description: This table was a re-themed table made by Belgamko, Belgian Gaming Company, for Zonderik. It was based on the Seawitch table by Stern from 1980
games.name: Zonderik Pinball

games.description: Original table, designed in 2023. It is based on the Zone mode in the Playstation 3 game Wipeout HD. In Zone Fury, the goal is to get to as high a Zone as you possibly can. The table starts out at Zone 0 (Sub-Venom), and you advance Zones by making ramp shots, orbit shots, completing ZONE, and accruing 10,000 in bonus during the current ball. You progress through the Zones as in the original game.
games.name: Zone Fury

games.description: In Theatre of Magic, you are trying to complete a series of magic tricks before getting to the final wizard mode at the end of the game. This game features great theme integration, callouts, and an iconic magic trunk mech that rotates for different mode shots and has a magnet to start multiballs with. There is a lot of flow to this game and getting a high score is satisfying and can be difficult depending on how the game is set up.
games.name: Theatre Of Magic

games.description:
In Medieval Madness, your goal as pinball wizard is to destroy the castles of a group of evil feudal overlords. On your way to the big bad, you may start a peasant riot, encounter Merlin, and fight some trolls.
Medieval Madness is often cited as one of the best pinball games ever made. It is a lot of fun to play and has great theme integration. The castle destruction shot is one of the most fun shots in all of pinball, and the rules are straight forward but the game can still be challenging to master.
games.name: Medieval Madness

games.description: Stargate is a Licensed Pinball Table released in 1995 by Gottlieb (under the Premier label). It was designed by Ray Tanzer and Jon Norris, with artwork by David Moore and Constantino and Jeanine Mitchell. Based on the 1994 sci-fi action movie starring James Spader and Kurt Russell, this pinball has players recreate the events of the film. Activate the Transporter, trade Quartz for various awards, then make it through the Sandstorm and attack Ra's Temple. Collect the White Pyramids, lead the miners in a rebellion, use the Sarcophagus to raise the dead, then slip under the floating Guardian statues. Levitate the Pyramid and attack the flying Glidercraft, collect the seven Segments to activate the Stargate, then activate the Eye of Ra and prove yourself the master of Abydan.
games.name: Stargate

games.id: Pirates Life -The Revenge of Cecil Hoggleston (Original 2024)(1.0)
games.name: Pirates Life
